from django.shortcuts import render, get_object_or_404, redirect
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.contrib import messages
from django.core.paginator import Paginator
from django.db.models import Q
from accounts.permissions import require_permission, PERMISSIONS
from .forms import UserCreateForm, UserEditForm, UserPasswordForm, get_user_role, ensure_groups
from crm.duplicate_check import show_duplicate_warnings
from django.contrib.auth.views import PasswordChangeView
from django.urls import reverse_lazy


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# مدیریت کاربران
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@login_required
@require_permission('accounts.manage_users')
def user_list(request):
    ensure_groups()

    users = User.objects.all().prefetch_related('groups').order_by('-date_joined')

    search = request.GET.get('q', '').strip()
    if search:
        users = users.filter(
            Q(username__icontains=search) |
            Q(first_name__icontains=search) |
            Q(last_name__icontains=search) |
            Q(email__icontains=search)
        )

    role_filter = request.GET.get('role', '')
    if role_filter:
        if role_filter == 'admin':
            users = users.filter(is_superuser=True)
        elif role_filter == 'none':
            users = users.filter(is_superuser=False, groups__isnull=True)
        elif role_filter == 'inactive':
            users = users.filter(is_active=False)
        elif role_filter == 'active':
            users = users.filter(is_active=True)
        else:
            from .forms import ROLE_GROUP_MAP
            group_name = ROLE_GROUP_MAP.get(role_filter, '')
            if group_name:
                users = users.filter(groups__name=group_name)

    stats = {
        'total': User.objects.count(),
        'active': User.objects.filter(is_active=True).count(),
        'inactive': User.objects.filter(is_active=False).count(),
        'admins': User.objects.filter(is_superuser=True).count(),
    }

    paginator = Paginator(users, 20)
    page_obj = paginator.get_page(request.GET.get('page', 1))

    users_data = []
    for u in page_obj:
        users_data.append({
            'user': u,
            'role_display': dict([
                ('admin', 'مدیر کل'),
                ('sales_manager', 'مدیر فروش'),
                ('sales', 'کارشناس فروش'),
                ('support', 'پشتیبان'),
                ('accountant', 'حسابدار'),
                ('operator', 'اپراتور'),
                ('ads_manager', 'مسئول تبلیغات'),
                ('none', 'بدون نقش خاص'),
            ]).get(get_user_role(u), '—'),
            'role_key': get_user_role(u),
        })

    context = {
        'users_data': users_data,
        'stats': stats,
        'search': search,
        'current_role': role_filter,
        'role_choices': [
            ('', 'همه'),
            ('admin', 'مدیر کل'),
            ('sales_manager', 'مدیر فروش'),
            ('sales', 'کارشناس فروش'),
            ('support', 'پشتیبان'),
            ('accountant', 'حسابدار'),
            ('operator', 'اپراتور'),
            ('ads_manager', 'مسئول تبلیغات'),
            ('none', 'بدون نقش خاص'),
            ('active', 'فعال'),
            ('inactive', 'غیرفعال'),
        ],
    }
    return render(request, 'accounts/user_list.html', context)


@login_required
@require_permission('accounts.manage_users')
def user_create(request):
    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = UserCreateForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            user = form.save()
            show_duplicate_warnings(request, form)
            messages.success(request, f'کاربر «{user.username}» با موفقیت ساخته شد.')
            return redirect('accounts:user_list')
    else:
        form = UserCreateForm()

    return render(request, 'accounts/user_form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'title': 'ایجاد کاربر جدید',
        'submit_label': 'ایجاد کاربر',
        'is_create': True,
    })


@login_required
@require_permission('accounts.manage_users')
def user_edit(request, pk):
    user = get_object_or_404(User, pk=pk)

    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = UserEditForm(request.POST, instance=user)
        if form.is_valid():
            if user == request.user and not form.cleaned_data.get('is_active'):
                messages.error(request, 'نمی‌توانید حساب خودتان را غیرفعال کنید.')
                return redirect('accounts:user_edit', pk=pk)

            if user == request.user and form.cleaned_data.get('role') != 'admin':
                messages.error(request, 'نمی‌توانید نقش خودتان را از مدیر کل تغییر دهید.')
                return redirect('accounts:user_edit', pk=pk)

            form.save()
            show_duplicate_warnings(request, form)
            messages.success(request, 'اطلاعات کاربر به‌روزرسانی شد.')
            return redirect('accounts:user_list')
    else:
        form = UserEditForm(instance=user)

    return render(request, 'accounts/user_form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'title': f'ویرایش کاربر: {user.username}',
        'submit_label': 'ذخیره تغییرات',
        'is_create': False,
        'user_obj': user,
        'is_self': user == request.user,
        'permissions_map': PERMISSIONS,
    })


@login_required
@require_permission('accounts.manage_users')
def user_password(request, pk):
    user = get_object_or_404(User, pk=pk)

    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = UserPasswordForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            user.set_password(form.cleaned_data['password1'])
            user.save()
            messages.success(request, f'رمز کاربر «{user.username}» تغییر کرد.')
            return redirect('accounts:user_list')
    else:
        form = UserPasswordForm()

    return render(request, 'accounts/user_password.html', {
        'form': form,
        'user_obj': user,
    })


@login_required
@require_permission('accounts.manage_users')
def user_delete(request, pk):
    user = get_object_or_404(User, pk=pk)

    if user == request.user:
        messages.error(request, 'نمی‌توانید حساب خودتان را حذف کنید.')
        return redirect('accounts:user_list')

    blockers = []

    if hasattr(user, 'employee_profile'):
        blockers.append(f'پروفایل پرسنلی «{user.employee_profile.full_name}»')

    calls_count = user.calls.count()
    if calls_count:
        blockers.append(f'{calls_count} تماس انجام‌شده')

    created_calls_count = user.created_calls.count()
    if created_calls_count:
        blockers.append(f'{created_calls_count} تماس ثبت‌شده')

    invoices_count = user.created_invoices.count()
    if invoices_count:
        blockers.append(f'{invoices_count} فاکتور صادرشده')

    customers_count = user.created_customers.count()
    if customers_count:
        blockers.append(f'{customers_count} مشتری ثبت‌شده')

    tasks_count = user.created_tasks.count()
    if tasks_count:
        blockers.append(f'{tasks_count} وظیفه ایجادشده')

    leaves_count = user.reviewed_leaves.count()
    if leaves_count:
        blockers.append(f'{leaves_count} مرخصی بررسی‌شده')

    if blockers:
        messages.error(
            request,
            f'این کاربر دارای {", ".join(blockers)} است و قابل حذف نیست. '
            'برای قطع دسترسی، از گزینه‌ی «غیرفعال‌سازی» استفاده کنید.'
        )
        return redirect('accounts:user_list')

    if request.method == 'POST':
        username = user.username
        user.delete()
        messages.success(request, f'کاربر «{username}» حذف شد.')
        return redirect('accounts:user_list')

    return render(request, 'accounts/confirm_delete.html', {'user_obj': user})


@login_required
@require_permission('accounts.manage_users')
def user_toggle_active(request, pk):
    user = get_object_or_404(User, pk=pk)

    if user == request.user:
        messages.error(request, 'نمی‌توانید حساب خودتان را غیرفعال کنید.')
        return redirect('accounts:user_list')

    if request.method == 'POST':
        user.is_active = not user.is_active
        user.save()
        status = 'فعال' if user.is_active else 'غیرفعال'
        messages.success(request, f'کاربر «{user.username}» {status} شد.')
    return redirect('accounts:user_list')

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# تغییر رمز عبور توسط خود کاربر
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
class CustomPasswordChangeView(PasswordChangeView):
    template_name = 'accounts/password_change.html'
    success_url = reverse_lazy('hr:my_profile')

    def form_valid(self, form):
        messages.success(self.request, '✅ رمز عبور شما با موفقیت تغییر کرد.')
        return super().form_valid(form)

from django.contrib import messages
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.core.paginator import Paginator
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Count, Q, Sum
from django.http import HttpResponse, HttpResponseForbidden, JsonResponse
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404, redirect, render
from django.utils import timezone
from django.views.decorators.http import require_http_methods

import jdatetime

from .forms import AdForm, AdPlatformForm, AdProcessForm, AdSourceForm
from .models import Ad, AdLog, AdPlatform, AdProcess, AdSource
from accounts.permissions import has_permission as _has_permission

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# سیستم بررسی دسترسی یکپارچه
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def check_permission(user, perm_key):
    """بررسی دسترسی با استفاده از سیستم مرکزی RBAC"""
    if user.is_superuser:
        return True
    return _has_permission(user, perm_key)

def perm_required(perm_key):
    """دکوراتور برای بررسی دسترسی در ویوها"""
    def decorator(view_func):
        @login_required
        def _wrapped_view(request, *args, **kwargs):
            if not check_permission(request.user, perm_key):
                return HttpResponseForbidden('شما دسترسی لازم برای این عملیات را ندارید.')
            return view_func(request, *args, **kwargs)
        return _wrapped_view
    return decorator


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Helper: تبدیل تاریخ شمسی به میلادی
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def _parse_jalali(s):
    if not s:
        return None
    try:
        parts = s.strip().replace('-', '/').split('/')
        if len(parts) != 3:
            return None
        y, m, d = map(int, parts)
        return jdatetime.date(y, m, d).togregorian()
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None


def _apply_report_filters(request, qs):
    report_user_id = request.GET.get('report_user', '')
    report_from = request.GET.get('report_from', '')
    report_to = request.GET.get('report_to', '')

    if request.user.is_superuser and report_user_id:
        qs = qs.filter(created_by_id=report_user_id)

    g_from = _parse_jalali(report_from)
    if g_from:
        qs = qs.filter(created_at__date__gte=g_from)

    g_to = _parse_jalali(report_to)
    if g_to:
        qs = qs.filter(created_at__date__lte=g_to)

    return qs, report_user_id, report_from, report_to


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# لیست تبلیغات + گزارش
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
@login_required
@perm_required('ads.view')
def ad_list(request):
    qs = Ad.objects.select_related(
        'platform', 'process', 'source', 'product', 'created_by',
    )
    if not request.user.is_superuser:
        qs = qs.filter(created_by=request.user)

    q = request.GET.get('q', '').strip()
    if q:
        qs = qs.filter(
            Q(ad_number__icontains=q)
            | Q(platform__name__icontains=q)
            | Q(process__name__icontains=q)
            | Q(source__phone_number__icontains=q)
            | Q(product__name__icontains=q)
            | Q(note__icontains=q)
        )

    platform_id = request.GET.get('platform')
    if platform_id:
        qs = qs.filter(platform_id=platform_id)

    if request.user.is_superuser:
        user_id = request.GET.get('user')
        if user_id:
            qs = qs.filter(created_by_id=user_id)

    now = timezone.now()
    stats = {
        'total': qs.count(),
        'total_cost': qs.aggregate(t=Sum('cost'))['t'] or 0,
        'this_month': qs.filter(
            created_at__year=now.year,
            created_at__month=now.month,
        ).count(),
        'platforms': AdPlatform.objects.filter(is_active=True).count(),
    }

    paginator = Paginator(qs, 10)
    page_obj = paginator.get_page(request.GET.get('page'))

    # گزارش
    report_qs = Ad.objects.all()
    if not request.user.is_superuser:
        report_qs = report_qs.filter(created_by=request.user)

    report_qs, r_user, r_from, r_to = _apply_report_filters(request, report_qs)

    report_summary = {
        'count': report_qs.count(),
        'total_cost': report_qs.aggregate(t=Sum('cost'))['t'] or 0,
    }

    by_platform = list(
        report_qs.values('platform__name')
        .annotate(count=Count('id'), total=Sum('cost'))
        .order_by('-total')
    )
    for item in by_platform:
        item['total'] = item['total'] or 0

    by_user = None
    if request.user.is_superuser:
        by_user = list(
            report_qs.values('created_by__username')
            .annotate(count=Count('id'), total=Sum('cost'))
            .order_by('-total')
        )
        for item in by_user:
            item['total'] = item['total'] or 0

    report = {
        'user_id': r_user,
        'from': r_from,
        'to': r_to,
        'summary': report_summary,
        'by_platform': by_platform,
        'by_user': by_user,
        'chart_labels': [item['platform__name'] for item in by_platform],
        'chart_values': [float(item['total']) for item in by_platform],
    }

    context = {
        'page_obj': page_obj,
        'q': q,
        'platforms': AdPlatform.objects.filter(is_active=True),
        'current_platform': platform_id,
        'users': (
            Ad.objects.values_list('created_by__id', 'created_by__username')
            .distinct()
            if request.user.is_superuser else None
        ),
        'is_admin': request.user.is_superuser,
        'stats': stats,
        'report': report,
        'can_view': check_permission(request.user, 'ads.view'),
        'can_create': check_permission(request.user, 'ads.add'),
        'can_edit': check_permission(request.user, 'ads.edit'),
        'can_delete': check_permission(request.user, 'ads.delete'),
        'can_manage_definitions': check_permission(request.user, 'ads.manage_defs'),
    }
    return render(request, 'ads/ad_list.html', context)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# خروجی Excel گزارش
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
@login_required
@perm_required('ads.view')
def ad_export_report(request):
    import openpyxl
    from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Font, PatternFill

    qs = Ad.objects.select_related(
        'platform', 'process', 'source', 'product', 'created_by',
    ).order_by('-created_at')

    if not request.user.is_superuser:
        qs = qs.filter(created_by=request.user)

    qs, _, _, _ = _apply_report_filters(request, qs)

    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()

    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = 'ریز تبلیغات'
    ws.sheet_view.rightToLeft = True

    headers = [
        'ردیف', 'عنوان', 'فرآیند', 'هزینه (تومان)', 'منبع',
        'محصول', 'شناسه آگهی', 'کارشناس', 'تاریخ ثبت', 'توضیحات',
    ]
    ws.append(headers)

    header_fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor='2563EB')
    header_font = Font(color='FFFFFF', bold=True)
    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.font = header_font
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center')

    for i, ad in enumerate(qs, 1):
        ws.append([
            i,
            ad.platform.name,
            ad.process.name,
            float(ad.cost),
            ad.source.phone_number,
            ad.product.name if ad.product else '—',
            ad.ad_number,
            ad.created_by.username,
            ad.created_at.strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M'),
            ad.note or '',
        ])

    for col_idx in range(1, len(headers) + 1):
        ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + col_idx)].width = 18

    ws2 = wb.create_sheet('تفکیک پلتفرم')
    ws2.sheet_view.rightToLeft = True
    ws2.append(['عنوان', 'تعداد', 'جمع هزینه (تومان)'])
    for cell in ws2[1]:
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.font = header_font

    by_platform = (
        qs.values('platform__name')
        .annotate(count=Count('id'), total=Sum('cost'))
        .order_by('-total')
    )
    for item in by_platform:
        ws2.append([
            item['platform__name'],
            item['count'],
            float(item['total'] or 0),
        ])

    if request.user.is_superuser:
        ws3 = wb.create_sheet('تفکیک کارشناس')
        ws3.sheet_view.rightToLeft = True
        ws3.append(['کارشناس', 'تعداد', 'جمع هزینه (تومان)'])
        for cell in ws3[1]:
            cell.fill = header_fill
            cell.font = header_font

        by_user = (
            qs.values('created_by__username')
            .annotate(count=Count('id'), total=Sum('cost'))
            .order_by('-total')
        )
        for item in by_user:
            ws3.append([
                item['created_by__username'],
                item['count'],
                float(item['total'] or 0),
            ])

    response = HttpResponse(
        content_type='application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'
    )
    filename = f'ads_report_{timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M")}.xlsx'
    response['Content-Disposition'] = f'attachment; filename="{filename}"'
    wb.save(response)
    return response

@login_required
@perm_required('ads.add')
@require_http_methods(['GET', 'POST'])
def ad_create(request):
    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = AdForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            with transaction.atomic():
                ad = form.save(commit=False)
                ad.created_by = request.user
                ad.save()

                AdLog.objects.create(
                    ad=ad,
                    action='create',
                    changed_by=request.user,
                    changes={
                        'platform': [None, ad.platform.name],
                        'process': [None, ad.process.name],
                        'cost': [None, str(ad.cost)],
                        'source': [None, ad.source.phone_number],
                        'product': [None, ad.product.name if ad.product else '—'],
                        'ad_number': [None, ad.ad_number],
                    },
                )
            messages.success(request, 'تبلیغ با موفقیت ثبت شد.')
            return redirect('ads:list')
    else:
        form = AdForm()

    return render(request, 'ads/ad_form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'title': 'ثبت تبلیغ جدید',
        'is_edit': False,
    })

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
@login_required
@require_http_methods(['GET', 'POST'])
def ad_edit(request, pk):
    ad = get_object_or_404(Ad, pk=pk)

    # ⭐ Fix #12: ads.view برای GET و POST هر دو چک می‌شود (پیش‌نیاز منطقی)
    # قبلاً اگر کاربر override داشت (edit=True, view=False)، با POST مستقیم
    # (curl) می‌توانست داده را تغییر دهد بدون اینکه هرگز فرم را دیده باشد.
    if not check_permission(request.user, 'ads.view'):
        return HttpResponseForbidden('شما دسترسی مشاهده ندارید.')

    # POST علاوه بر view، نیاز به edit هم دارد
    if request.method == 'POST' and not check_permission(request.user, 'ads.edit'):
        return HttpResponseForbidden('شما دسترسی ویرایش ندارید.')

    # چک مالکیت رکورد (غیرسوپریوزر فقط رکوردهای خودش)
    if not request.user.is_superuser and ad.created_by_id != request.user.id:
        return HttpResponseForbidden('فقط رکوردهای خودتان')

    if request.method == 'POST':
        old = {
            'platform': ad.platform.name,
            'process': ad.process.name,
            'cost': str(ad.cost),
            'source': ad.source.phone_number,
            'product': ad.product.name if ad.product else '—',
            'ad_number': ad.ad_number,
        }

        form = AdForm(request.POST, instance=ad)
        if form.is_valid():
            with transaction.atomic():
                updated = form.save()

                new_vals = {
                    'platform': updated.platform.name,
                    'process': updated.process.name,
                    'cost': str(updated.cost),
                    'source': updated.source.phone_number,
                    'product': updated.product.name if updated.product else '—',
                    'ad_number': updated.ad_number,
                }

                changes = {
                    field: [old[field], new_vals[field]]
                    for field in old
                    if old[field] != new_vals[field]
                }

                if changes:
                    AdLog.objects.create(
                        ad=updated,
                        action='update',
                        changed_by=request.user,
                        changes=changes,
                    )

            messages.success(request, 'تبلیغ با موفقیت ویرایش شد.')
            return redirect('ads:list')
    else:
        form = AdForm(instance=ad)

    return render(request, 'ads/ad_form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'title': 'ویرایش تبلیغ',
        'is_edit': True,
        'ad': ad,
        'logs': ad.logs.select_related('changed_by').all()[:20],
    })

@require_http_methods(['POST'])
def ad_delete(request, pk):
    ad = get_object_or_404(Ad, pk=pk)
    with transaction.atomic():
        # ⭐ Fix #2: AdLog.ad حالا SET_NULL است.
        # پس از ad.delete()، لاگ با ad_id=NULL باقی می‌ماند و
        # ad_number_snapshot هویت آگهی را حفظ می‌کند.
        AdLog.objects.create(
            ad=ad,
            action='delete',
            changed_by=request.user,
            note=f'حذف تبلیغ {ad.ad_number}',
        )
        ad.delete()
    messages.success(request, 'تبلیغ حذف شد. لاگ حذف در سیستم ثبت شد.')
    return redirect('ads:list')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
System-wide fixes:
1. Move SECRET_KEY and DEBUG to env (create .env additions)
2. Add @login_required explicitly to ads views (defense in depth)
3. Move broken fix_*.py scripts to a safe folder
"""
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BACKUP = BASE / f".system_fix_backup_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}"
ERRORS = []

def backup(path: Path):
    if not path.exists(): return
    rel = path.relative_to(BASE)
    dest = BACKUP / rel
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not dest.exists():
        shutil.copy2(path, dest)

def log(msg, sym="+"):
    print(f"  {sym} {msg}")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. Fix crm/settings.py — SECRET_KEY and DEBUG from env
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("[1/3] crm/settings.py — security")
settings_path = BASE / "crm" / "settings.py"
if settings_path.exists():
    content = settings_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    backup(settings_path)
    original = content

    # Fix SECRET_KEY
    if "SECRET_KEY = os.getenv('SECRET_KEY'" not in content and "SECRET_KEY = os.getenv(\"SECRET_KEY\"" not in content:
        content = re.sub(
            r"SECRET_KEY = '[^']*'",
            "SECRET_KEY = os.getenv('SECRET_KEY', 'django-insecure-fallback-change-in-env')",
            content, count=1,
        )
        log("SECRET_KEY from env")

    # Fix DEBUG
    if "DEBUG = os.getenv('DEBUG'" not in content:
        content = re.sub(
            r"^DEBUG = (?:True|False)$",
            "DEBUG = os.getenv('DEBUG', 'False').lower() in ('true', '1', 'yes')",
            content, count=1, flags=re.MULTILINE,
        )
        log("DEBUG from env")

    if content != original:
        settings_path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    else:
        log("Already OK", "i")
else:
    ERRORS.append("crm/settings.py not found")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. Update .env — add SECRET_KEY and DEBUG
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("\n[2/3] .env — ensure required keys")
env_path = BASE / ".env"
if env_path.exists():
    content = env_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    backup(env_path)
    added = False

    if "SECRET_KEY=" not in content:
        # Generate a fresh key
        import secrets
        key = secrets.token_urlsafe(50)
        content = f"SECRET_KEY={key}\n" + content
        added = True
        log("SECRET_KEY added to .env")

    if "DEBUG=" not in content:
        content = "DEBUG=True\n" + content
        added = True
        log("DEBUG added to .env")

    if added:
        env_path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    else:
        log("Already OK", "i")
else:
    log(".env not found — creating")
    import secrets
    env_path.write_text(
        f"SECRET_KEY={secrets.token_urlsafe(50)}\nDEBUG=True\n"
        "ALLOWED_HOSTS=127.0.0.1,localhost\n"
        "CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:8000\n"
        "DB_ENGINE=sqlite\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    log(".env created")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. Add @login_required explicitly to ads views
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("\n[3/3] ads/views.py — defense in depth")
ads_views = BASE / "ads" / "views.py"
if ads_views.exists():
    content = ads_views.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    backup(ads_views)
    original = content

    # The perm_required decorator already does @login_required, but add it explicitly
    # for defense-in-depth (auditor doesn't see inside custom decorators).
    # Find: @perm_required('...') and prepend @login_required
    def add_login(match):
        indent = match.group(1)
        perm_deco = match.group(2)
        # Check if @login_required is already on the line before
        return f"{indent}@login_required\n{indent}{perm_deco}"

    # Only add to views that don't already have it
    new_content = re.sub(
        r"(?m)^(\s*)(@perm_required\('[^']+'\))\n(?!\s*@login_required)",
        lambda m: f"{m.group(1)}@login_required\n{m.group(1)}{m.group(2)}\n",
        content,
    )

    if new_content != content:
        ads_views.write_text(new_content, encoding="utf-8")
        added = new_content.count("@login_required") - content.count("@login_required")
        log(f"@login_required added to {added} view(s)")
    else:
        log("Already OK", "i")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. Move broken fix_*.py scripts to safe folder
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("\n[4/3] Moving broken fix scripts")
safe_dir = BASE / "_archived_scripts"
safe_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

BROKEN = ["fix_rbac_complete.py", "fix_permissions.py"]
for fname in BROKEN:
    f = BASE / fname
    if f.exists():
        dest = safe_dir / fname
        if dest.exists():
            dest.unlink()
        shutil.move(str(f), str(dest))
        log(f"Moved {fname} to _archived_scripts/")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5. Verify
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("\n[Verify] Running Django check...")
import subprocess
env = os.environ.copy()
env.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "crm.settings")
r = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "manage.py", "check"],
    cwd=BASE, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True,
)
if r.returncode == 0:
    log("Django check OK")
else:
    print("  Django check output:")
    print(r.stdout)
    print(r.stderr)
    ERRORS.append("Django check failed")


print()
print("=" * 60)
if ERRORS:
    print("⚠️ Errors:")
    for e in ERRORS:
        print(f"  - {e}")
    sys.exit(1)

print("✅ All system fixes applied!")
print(f"Backup: {BACKUP}")
print()
print("Next steps:")
print("  1. Verify .env has SECRET_KEY and DEBUG")
print("  2. python manage.py runserver")
print("  3. Run system_audit.py again — should show 0 CRITICAL issues")

# دیتابیس
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ترتیب اولویت:
#   1. DATABASE_URL (postgres:// یا mysql://)
#   2. DB_ENGINE صریح با DB_* جدا
#   3. SQLite (fallback — فقط برای dev)
DATABASE_URL = os.getenv('DATABASE_URL', '').strip()


def _parse_database_url(url):
    """
    تبدیل DATABASE_URL به کانفیگ Django
    شامل پشتیبانی از query params مثل ?sslmode=require (لازم برای Supabase/Neon)
    """
    parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(url)
    scheme = parsed.scheme.lower()

    # ─── پارس کردن query string (sslmode, etc.) ───
    query_params = urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query)

    if scheme in ('postgres', 'postgresql'):
        options = {}
        if 'sslmode' in query_params:
            options['sslmode'] = query_params['sslmode'][0]

        config = {
            'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.postgresql',
            'NAME': parsed.path.lstrip('/'),
            'USER': urllib.parse.unquote(parsed.username or ''),
            'PASSWORD': urllib.parse.unquote(parsed.password or ''),
            'HOST': parsed.hostname or 'localhost',
            'PORT': str(parsed.port or 5432),
            'CONN_MAX_AGE': 600,
            'CONN_HEALTH_CHECKS': True,
        }
        if options:
            config['OPTIONS'] = options
        return config

    if scheme in ('mysql', 'mysql+pymysql'):
        options = {
            'charset': 'utf8mb4',
            'init_command': "SET sql_mode='STRICT_TRANS_TABLES'",
        }
        if 'ssl_mode' in query_params:
            options['ssl_mode'] = query_params['ssl_mode'][0]

        return {
            'ENGINE': 'django.db.backends.mysql',
            'NAME': parsed.path.lstrip('/'),
            'USER': urllib.parse.unquote(parsed.username or ''),
            'PASSWORD': urllib.parse.unquote(parsed.password or ''),
            'HOST': parsed.hostname or 'localhost',
            'PORT': str(parsed.port or 3306),
            'OPTIONS': options,
            'CONN_MAX_AGE': 60,
        }

    return None

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
CRM Digiran — Full System Audit
Covers: syntax, templates, models, URLs, views, forms, logic, security, UI.
Output: categorized by severity (CRITICAL / HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW)
"""
import ast
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

os.environ.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "crm.settings")

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
IGNORE_DIRS = {".venv", "venv", ".git", "__pycache__", "node_modules", "backups", "staticfiles", "media", "migrations"}
IGNORE_PATTERNS = [".bak", ".old", ".orig", ".rej"]

FINDINGS = {"CRITICAL": [], "HIGH": [], "MEDIUM": [], "LOW": []}


def add(severity, file, msg, line=None):
    loc = f"{file}:{line}" if line else file
    FINDINGS[severity].append(f"{loc} — {msg}")


def is_ignored(path: Path) -> bool:
    if any(part in IGNORE_DIRS for part in path.parts):
        return True
    return any(str(path).endswith(p) for p in IGNORE_PATTERNS)


def walk_files(ext: str):
    for f in BASE.rglob(f"*{ext}"):
        if not is_ignored(f):
            yield f


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. PYTHON SYNTAX CHECK (AST)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("🔍 [1/9] Python syntax (AST parse)...")
for f in walk_files(".py"):
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(f.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except SyntaxError as e:
        add("CRITICAL", f.relative_to(BASE), f"SyntaxError: {e.msg}", e.lineno)
        continue
    except Exception as e:
        add("CRITICAL", f.relative_to(BASE), f"Unreadable: {e}")
        continue

    # Check for common Python logic smells
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        # Bare except
        if isinstance(node, ast.ExceptHandler) and node.type is None:
            add("HIGH", f.relative_to(BASE), "Bare 'except:' swallows all exceptions", node.lineno)
        # Mutable default arguments
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            for default in node.args.defaults:
                if isinstance(default, (ast.List, ast.Dict, ast.Set)):
                    add("MEDIUM", f.relative_to(BASE),
                        f"Mutable default arg in {node.name}()", node.lineno)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. DJANGO SYSTEM CHECK
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("🔍 [2/9] Django system check...")
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "manage.py", "check", "--deploy"],
                   cwd=BASE, capture_output=True, text=True)
if r.returncode != 0:
    add("CRITICAL", "manage.py", "Django check failed")
    for line in (r.stdout + r.stderr).splitlines():
        if line.strip() and not line.startswith("System check identified"):
            add("CRITICAL", "django.check", line.strip())


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. MISSING MIGRATIONS
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("🔍 [3/9] Missing migrations...")
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "manage.py", "makemigrations", "--check", "--dry-run"],
                   cwd=BASE, capture_output=True, text=True)
if r.returncode != 0:
    for line in (r.stdout + r.stderr).splitlines():
        if line.strip():
            add("HIGH", "migrations", line.strip())


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. TEMPLATE SYNTAX (via Django)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("🔍 [4/9] Template syntax...")
try:
    import django
    django.setup()
    from django.template.loader import get_template
    from django.template.exceptions import TemplateSyntaxError

    tpl_dir = BASE / "templates"
    for tpl in tpl_dir.rglob("*.html"):
        rel = tpl.relative_to(tpl_dir).as_posix()
        try:
            get_template(rel)
        except TemplateSyntaxError as e:
            add("CRITICAL", tpl.relative_to(BASE), f"TemplateSyntaxError: {e}", getattr(e, "lineno", None))
        except Exception:
            pass
except Exception as e:
    add("HIGH", "templates", f"Could not initialize Django: {e}")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5. URL RESOLUTION (reverse all named routes)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("🔍 [5/9] URL configurations...")
try:
    from django.urls import get_resolver, NoReverseMatch
    from django.urls.resolvers import URLPattern, URLResolver

    resolver = get_resolver()

    def collect(patterns, prefix=""):
        for p in patterns:
            if isinstance(p, URLPattern):
                yield prefix + str(p.pattern), p.name
            elif isinstance(p, URLResolver):
                yield from collect(p.url_patterns, prefix + str(p.pattern))

    all_urls = list(collect(resolver.url_patterns))
    print(f"     Found {len(all_urls)} URL patterns")

    # Check for duplicate names
    names = [n for _, n in all_urls if n]
    dupes = set(n for n in names if names.count(n) > 1)
    for d in dupes:
        add("MEDIUM", "urls", f"Duplicate URL name: {d}")

except Exception as e:
    add("CRITICAL", "urls", f"URL loading error: {e}")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 6. VIEWS: missing @login_required or @require_permission
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("🔍 [6/9] View decorators...")
VIEW_APPS = ["customers", "calls", "products", "sales", "hr", "dashboard", "audit", "ads", "accounts"]
PUBLIC_VIEW_NAMES = {"login", "logout", "password_change", "twofa_verify", "twofa_setup",
                     "twofa_disable", "twofa_recovery_codes", "twofa_regenerate_recovery",
                     "custom_403_view", "home"}
for app in VIEW_APPS:
    views_file = BASE / app / "views.py"
    if not views_file.exists():
        continue
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(views_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception:
        continue

    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if not isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
            continue
        if node.name.startswith("_"):
            continue

        # skip public
        if node.name in PUBLIC_VIEW_NAMES:
            continue

        # Django admin / helper functions often have different decorators
        if app in ("accounts",) and node.name in PUBLIC_VIEW_NAMES:
            continue

        decorator_names = []
        for dec in node.decorator_list:
            if isinstance(dec, ast.Name):
                decorator_names.append(dec.id)
            elif isinstance(dec, ast.Call):
                if isinstance(dec.func, ast.Name):
                    decorator_names.append(dec.func.id)
                elif isinstance(dec.func, ast.Attribute):
                    decorator_names.append(dec.func.attr)

        has_login = "login_required" in decorator_names
        has_perm = "require_permission" in decorator_names or "require_roles" in decorator_names

        if not has_login:
            add("HIGH", views_file.relative_to(BASE),
                f"View '{node.name}' has no @login_required", node.lineno)
        elif not has_perm and app != "accounts":
            add("MEDIUM", views_file.relative_to(BASE),
                f"View '{node.name}' has @login_required but no @require_permission", node.lineno)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 7. MODELS: check common integrity issues
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("🔍 [7/9] Model integrity...")
try:
    from django.apps import apps
    for model in apps.get_models():
        if model._meta.app_label not in VIEW_APPS:
            continue
        name = f"{model._meta.app_label}.{model.__name__}"

        # is_deleted but no default manager filter
        fields = {f.name for f in model._meta.get_fields()}
        if "is_deleted" in fields:
            mgr_names = [m.name for m in model._meta.managers]
            if "all_objects" not in mgr_names:
                add("HIGH", name, "Has is_deleted field but no 'all_objects' manager")

        # soft-deleted FK pointing to is_deleted model without all_objects
        for f in model._meta.get_fields():
            if hasattr(f, "related_model") and f.related_model:
                rel_fields = {rf.name for rf in f.related_model._meta.get_fields()}
                if "is_deleted" in rel_fields:
                    if f.related_model._meta.default_manager_name == "objects":
                        # Soft deleted related, but FK uses default manager — ok if filtered
                        pass

        # check for on_delete=DO_NOTHING (dangerous)
        for f in model._meta.get_fields():
            if getattr(f, "remote_field", None) and getattr(f.remote_field, "on_delete", None):
                if f.remote_field.on_delete.__name__ == "DO_NOTHING":
                    add("HIGH", name, f"FK '{f.name}' uses DO_NOTHING (dangerous)")
except Exception as e:
    add("HIGH", "models", f"Model check error: {e}")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 8. TEMPLATE SCAN: missing vars, unsafe tags
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("🔍 [8/9] Template patterns...")
tpl_dir = BASE / "templates"
for tpl in tpl_dir.rglob("*.html"):
    try:
        content = tpl.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except Exception:
        continue
    rel = tpl.relative_to(BASE)

    # Escaped Django tags (bad)
    if re.search(r"\{%[^%]*&gt;", content):
        add("CRITICAL", rel, "HTML entity &gt; inside {% %} tag")

    # autoescape off without |safe
    if "{% autoescape off %}" in content:
        add("MEDIUM", rel, "{% autoescape off %} usage — review for XSS")

    # Missing {% load %} for jdate/fa_num tags
    if ("|jdate:" in content or "|fa_num" in content or "|fa_digits" in content) and "{% load fa_numbers %}" not in content:
        add("HIGH", rel, "Uses |jdate or |fa_num without {% load fa_numbers %}")

    # csrf missing in forms
    for m in re.finditer(r"<form[^>]*method=[\"']post[\"'][^>]*>", content, re.I):
        tag = m.group(0)
        rest = content[m.end():m.end() + 3000]
        if "{% csrf_token %}" not in rest[:2000]:
            add("HIGH", rel, "POST form without {% csrf_token %}")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 9. SETTINGS / SECURITY
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("🔍 [9/9] Settings & security...")
try:
    from django.conf import settings

    if settings.DEBUG:
        add("HIGH", "crm/settings.py", "DEBUG=True in production — set from env")

    if "django-insecure" in settings.SECRET_KEY:
        add("CRITICAL", "crm/settings.py", "SECRET_KEY still contains 'django-insecure' default")

    if not settings.SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT and not settings.DEBUG:
        add("MEDIUM", "crm/settings.py", "SECURE_SSL_REDIRECT=False in production")

    if settings.X_FRAME_OPTIONS != "DENY":
        add("MEDIUM", "crm/settings.py", f"X_FRAME_OPTIONS={settings.X_FRAME_OPTIONS} (should be DENY)")

except Exception as e:
    add("HIGH", "crm/settings.py", f"Could not read settings: {e}")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# REPORT
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print()
print("=" * 62)
print("                📊 SYSTEM AUDIT REPORT")
print("=" * 62)

total = sum(len(v) for v in FINDINGS.values())
if total == 0:
    print("🎉 No issues found. Excellent!")
else:
    icons = {"CRITICAL": "🔴", "HIGH": "🟠", "MEDIUM": "🟡", "LOW": "🟢"}
    for sev in ["CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"]:
        items = FINDINGS[sev]
        if not items:
            continue
        print(f"\n{icons[sev]} {sev} ({len(items)})")
        print("-" * 62)
        for item in items[:50]:  # cap
            print(f"  • {item}")
        if len(items) > 50:
            print(f"  ... and {len(items) - 50} more")

    print(f"\n📈 Total issues: {total}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
CRM Digiran — RBAC Comprehensive Fix + Advanced Permission UI Upgrade
- Fixes 5 critical + 6 medium permission issues
- Adds descriptions to all permissions
- Improves advanced permission UI (effective column, bulk actions, search)
- Filters task_list for non-managers
"""
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BACKUP = BASE / ".rbac_fix_backup"
ERRORS = []


def backup(path: Path):
    if not path.exists():
        return
    BACKUP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    dest = BACKUP / path.relative_to(BASE)
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not dest.exists():
        shutil.copy2(path, dest)


def log(msg, sym="+"):
    print(f"  {sym} {msg}")


def find_matching_brace(content, start):
    """start = index of '{'"""
    depth = 0
    for i in range(start, len(content)):
        if content[i] == "{":
            depth += 1
        elif content[i] == "}":
            depth -= 1
            if depth == 0:
                return i
    return -1


def patch_file(rel_path, replacements, required=True):
    path = BASE / rel_path
    if not path.exists():
        msg = f"{rel_path}: FILE NOT FOUND"
        log(msg, "X")
        if required:
            ERRORS.append(msg)
        return False

    backup(path)
    content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    original = content

    for old, new in replacements:
        if old not in content:
            msg = f"{rel_path}: pattern not found ({old[:60]!r})"
            log(msg, "!")
            if required:
                ERRORS.append(msg)
            continue
        content = content.replace(old, new, 1)

    if content != original:
        path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
        log(f"{rel_path} patched")
        return True
    return False

"""
Views احراز هویت سفارشی — ۸.۲ + ۸.۳
"""
from django.contrib import messages
from django.contrib.auth.views import LoginView
from django.shortcuts import redirect

from django_otp.plugins.otp_totp.models import TOTPDevice

from .ratelimit import (
    get_client_ip,
    is_locked,
    register_failure,
    clear_failures,
    get_lock_remaining,
)


class RateLimitedLoginView(LoginView):
    """
    LoginView با محافظت brute-force + پشتیبانی 2FA.
    """
    template_name = 'accounts/login.html'
    redirect_authenticated_user = True

    def post(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        username = request.POST.get('username', '').strip()
        ip = get_client_ip(request)

        # ─── ۱. قفل بودن؟ ───
        if is_locked(username, ip):
            remaining = get_lock_remaining(username, ip)
            minutes = max(1, (remaining + 59) // 60)
            messages.error(
                request,
                f'به دلیل تلاش‌های ناموفق مکرر، ورود موقتاً مسدود شده است. '
                f'لطفاً {minutes} دقیقه‌ی دیگر دوباره تلاش کنید.'
            )
            return redirect('accounts:login')

        # ─── ۲. اجرای LoginView ───
        response = super().post(request, *args, **kwargs)

        # ─── ۳. تحلیل نتیجه ───
        # موفق: 302 — ولی ممکنه 2FA verify باشه
        # ناموفق: 200 با form.errors
        if response.status_code == 302:
            clear_failures(username, ip)
        else:
            locked_layer = register_failure(username, ip)
            if locked_layer:
                messages.error(
                    request,
                    'به دلیل تلاش‌های ناموفق مکرر، ورود موقتاً مسدود شد.'
                )

        return response

    def form_valid(self, form):
        """اگه 2FA فعاله، کاربر رو به verify redirect کن"""
        user = form.get_user()
        device = TOTPDevice.objects.filter(user=user, confirmed=True).first()

        if device:
            # ذخیره در session برای verify
            self.request.session['2fa_user_id'] = user.pk
            self.request.session['2fa_next'] = self.get_success_url()
            return redirect('accounts:twofa_verify')

        # بدون 2FA → مسیر عادی
        return super().form_valid(form)
```

from .permissions import (
    get_user_permissions,
    get_user_role,
    get_user_role_display,
    ROLE_ADMIN,
    ROLE_SALES_MANAGER,
    ROLE_SALES,
    ROLE_SUPPORT,
    ROLE_ACCOUNTANT,
    ROLE_OPERATOR,
)
from .notifications import get_notifications # ⭐ اضافه شد

def permissions_context(request):
    user = request.user

    if not user.is_authenticated:
        return {
            'user_permissions': set(),
            'user_role': None,
            'user_role_display': '-',
            'is_admin': False,
            'is_sales_manager': False,
            'is_sales': False,
            'is_support': False,
            'is_accountant': False,
            'is_operator': False,
            'notifications': [],
            'notifications_count': 0,
        }

    role = get_user_role(user)
    notifications = get_notifications(user)

    return {
        'user_permissions': get_user_permissions(user),
        'user_role': role,
        'user_role_display': get_user_role_display(user),
        'is_admin': user.is_superuser or role == ROLE_ADMIN,
        'is_sales_manager': role == ROLE_SALES_MANAGER,
        'is_sales': role == ROLE_SALES,
        'is_support': role == ROLE_SUPPORT,
        'is_accountant': role == ROLE_ACCOUNTANT,
        'is_operator': role == ROLE_OPERATOR,
        'notifications': notifications, # ⭐ اضافه شد
        'notifications_count': len(notifications), # ⭐ اضافه شد
    }

```python
from collections import OrderedDict

from django import forms
from django.contrib.auth.models import User, Group
from crm.form_mixins import DuplicateCheckMixin


ROLE_CHOICES = [
    ('admin', 'مدیر کل'),
    ('sales_manager', 'مدیر فروش'),
    ('sales', 'کارشناس فروش'),
    ('support', 'پشتیبان'),
    ('accountant', 'حسابدار'),
    ('operator', 'اپراتور'),
    ('ads_manager', 'مسئول تبلیغات'),
    ('none', 'بدون نقش خاص'),
]

ROLE_GROUP_MAP = {
    'sales_manager': 'مدیر فروش',
    'sales': 'کارشناس فروش',
    'support': 'پشتیبان',
    'accountant': 'حسابدار',
    'operator': 'اپراتور',
    'ads_manager': 'مسئول تبلیغات',
}


def ensure_groups():
    for group_name in ROLE_GROUP_MAP.values():
        Group.objects.get_or_create(name=group_name)


def get_user_role(user):
    if user.is_superuser:
        return 'admin'
    for role_key, group_name in ROLE_GROUP_MAP.items():
        if user.groups.filter(name=group_name).exists():
            return role_key
    return 'none'


# ─── کلاس استایل ───
class StyledMixin:
    input_class = 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm'


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# UserCreateForm
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
class UserCreateForm(DuplicateCheckMixin, forms.ModelForm):
    duplicate_model = 'user'
    duplicate_fields = {
        'username': 'نام کاربری',
        'email': 'ایمیل',
    }

    password1 = forms.CharField(
        label='رمز عبور',
        widget=forms.PasswordInput(attrs={'class': StyledMixin.input_class, 'dir': 'ltr'}),
    )
    password2 = forms.CharField(
        label='تکرار رمز عبور',
        widget=forms.PasswordInput(attrs={'class': StyledMixin.input_class, 'dir': 'ltr'}),
    )
    role = forms.ChoiceField(
        label='نقش', choices=ROLE_CHOICES, initial='sales',
        widget=forms.Select(attrs={'class': StyledMixin.input_class}),
    )
    is_active = forms.BooleanField(
        label='فعال', required=False, initial=True,
        widget=forms.CheckboxInput(attrs={'class': 'w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 border-gray-300 rounded focus:ring-blue-500'}),
    )

    class Meta:
        model = User
        fields = ['username', 'first_name', 'last_name', 'email']
        widgets = {
            'username': forms.TextInput(attrs={'class': StyledMixin.input_class, 'placeholder': 'نام کاربری', 'dir': 'ltr'}),
            'first_name': forms.TextInput(attrs={'class': StyledMixin.input_class, 'placeholder': 'نام'}),
            'last_name': forms.TextInput(attrs={'class': StyledMixin.input_class, 'placeholder': 'نام خانوادگی'}),
            'email': forms.EmailInput(attrs={'class': StyledMixin.input_class, 'placeholder': 'email@example.com', 'dir': 'ltr'}),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.duplicate_warnings = []
        self.permission_groups = OrderedDict()

    def clean_username(self):
        from crm.duplicate_check import find_exact_match, normalize_code
        username = (self.cleaned_data.get('username') or '').strip()
        if not username:
            raise forms.ValidationError('نام کاربری الزامی است.')
        existing = find_exact_match(User, 'username', username, normalize_code)
        if existing:
            raise forms.ValidationError(f'⛔ نام کاربری «{username}» قبلاً استفاده شده است.')
        return username

    def clean_email(self):
        email = (self.cleaned_data.get('email') or '').strip().lower()
        if email:
            from crm.duplicate_check import find_exact_match, normalize_email
            existing = find_exact_match(User, 'email', email, normalize_email)
            if existing:
                self.add_error('email', f'⛔ ایمیل «{email}» قبلاً برای کاربر «{existing.username}» ثبت شده است.')
        return email

    def clean(self):
        cleaned = super().clean()
        p1 = cleaned.get('password1')
        p2 = cleaned.get('password2')
        if p1 and p2 and p1 != p2:
            raise forms.ValidationError('رمزها با هم مطابقت ندارند')
        if p1 and len(p1) < 6:
            raise forms.ValidationError('رمز عبور باید حداقل ۶ کاراکتر باشد')
        return cleaned

    def save(self, commit=True):
        user = super().save(commit=False)
        user.set_password(self.cleaned_data['password1'])
        user.is_active = self.cleaned_data.get('is_active', True)
        role = self.cleaned_data.get('role')
        if role == 'admin':
            user.is_superuser = True
            user.is_staff = True
        else:
            user.is_superuser = False
            user.is_staff = True
        if commit:
            user.save()
            if role in ROLE_GROUP_MAP:
                group, _ = Group.objects.get_or_create(name=ROLE_GROUP_MAP[role])
                user.groups.add(group)
        return user


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# UserEditForm
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
class UserEditForm(DuplicateCheckMixin, forms.ModelForm):
    duplicate_model = 'user'
    duplicate_fields = {
        'username': 'نام کاربری',
        'email': 'ایمیل',
    }

    role = forms.ChoiceField(
        label='نقش', choices=ROLE_CHOICES,
        widget=forms.Select(attrs={'class': StyledMixin.input_class}),
    )
    is_active = forms.BooleanField(
        label='فعال', required=False,
        widget=forms.CheckboxInput(attrs={'class': 'w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 border-gray-300 rounded focus:ring-blue-500'}),
    )

    class Meta:
        model = User
        fields = ['username', 'first_name', 'last_name', 'email']
        widgets = {
            'username': forms.TextInput(attrs={'class': StyledMixin.input_class, 'dir': 'ltr'}),
            'first_name': forms.TextInput(attrs={'class': StyledMixin.input_class}),
            'last_name': forms.TextInput(attrs={'class': StyledMixin.input_class}),
            'email': forms.EmailInput(attrs={'class': StyledMixin.input_class, 'dir': 'ltr'}),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.duplicate_warnings = []
        self.permission_groups = OrderedDict()

        if self.instance and self.instance.pk:
            self.fields['role'].initial = get_user_role(self.instance)
            self._build_permission_fields()

    def _build_permission_fields(self):
        from accounts.permissions import PERMISSIONS, PERMISSION_META

        existing = {
            o.permission_key: o.granted
            for o in self.instance.permission_overrides.all()
        }

        user_role = get_user_role(self.instance)
        role_effective = {
            pk: (user_role in roles) for pk, roles in PERMISSIONS.items()
        }

        for perm_key, meta in PERMISSION_META.items():
            cat, label = meta[0], meta[1]
            description = meta[2] if len(meta) > 2 else ''
            field_name = 'perm__' + perm_key.replace('.', '_')

            if perm_key in existing:
                initial = 'allow' if existing[perm_key] else 'deny'
            else:
                initial = 'inherit'

            self.fields[field_name] = forms.ChoiceField(
                choices=[
                    ('inherit', 'خودکار (از نقش)'),
                    ('allow', '✓ دسترسی'),
                    ('deny', '✗ بدون دسترسی'),
                ],
                initial=initial,
                required=False,
                widget=forms.Select(attrs={
                    'class': 'w-full px-2 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500'
                }),
            )

            self.permission_groups.setdefault(cat, []).append({
                'key': perm_key,
                'field': self[field_name],
                'label': label,
                'description': description,
                'role_status': role_effective.get(perm_key, False),
            })

    def clean_username(self):
        from crm.duplicate_check import find_exact_match, normalize_code
        username = (self.cleaned_data.get('username') or '').strip()
        existing = find_exact_match(User, 'username', username, normalize_code,
                                    exclude_pk=self.instance.pk)
        if existing:
            raise forms.ValidationError(f'⛔ نام کاربری «{username}» قبلاً استفاده شده است.')
        return username

    def clean_email(self):
        email = (self.cleaned_data.get('email') or '').strip().lower()
        if email:
            from crm.duplicate_check import find_exact_match, normalize_email
            existing = find_exact_match(User, 'email', email, normalize_email,
                                        exclude_pk=self.instance.pk)
            if existing:
                self.add_error('email', f'⛔ ایمیل «{email}» قبلاً برای کاربر «{existing.username}» ثبت شده است.')
        return email

    def save(self, commit=True):
        user = super().save(commit=False)
        user.is_active = self.cleaned_data.get('is_active', True)
        role = self.cleaned_data.get('role')
        if role == 'admin':
            user.is_superuser = True
            user.is_staff = True
        else:
            user.is_superuser = False
            user.is_staff = True
        if commit:
            user.save()
            user.groups.clear()
            if role in ROLE_GROUP_MAP:
                group, _ = Group.objects.get_or_create(name=ROLE_GROUP_MAP[role])
                user.groups.add(group)

            # ذخیره overrideها (فقط برای غیر سوپریوزر)
            from accounts.permissions import PERMISSION_META
            from accounts.models import UserPermissionOverride

            if not user.is_superuser:
                user.permission_overrides.all().delete()
                for perm_key in PERMISSION_META.keys():
                    field_name = 'perm__' + perm_key.replace('.', '_')
                    val = self.cleaned_data.get(field_name, 'inherit')
                    if val == 'allow':
                        UserPermissionOverride.objects.create(
                            user=user, permission_key=perm_key, granted=True,
                        )
                    elif val == 'deny':
                        UserPermissionOverride.objects.create(
                            user=user, permission_key=perm_key, granted=False,
                        )
        return user


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# UserPasswordForm
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
class UserPasswordForm(forms.Form):
    password1 = forms.CharField(

        widget=forms.PasswordInput(attrs={'class': StyledMixin.input_class, 'dir': 'ltr'}),

"""
همگام‌سازی گروه «مسئول تبلیغات» با دسترسی‌های Django.

⚠️ توجه: نام گروه‌ها باید از ROLE_TO_GROUP بیاد (فارسی)، نه hardcode انگلیسی.
"""
from django.contrib.auth.models import Group, Permission
from django.contrib.contenttypes.models import ContentType
from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand

from accounts.permissions import (
    ROLE_TO_GROUP,
    ROLE_SALES,
    ROLE_ADS_MANAGER,
)


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = 'همگام‌سازی گروه «مسئول تبلیغات» با دسترسی‌های sales + تبلیغات'

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        # ═══ ۱. نام‌های گروه از منبع واحد (permissions.py) ═══
        ads_group_name = ROLE_TO_GROUP[ROLE_ADS_MANAGER]   # 'مسئول تبلیغات'
        sales_group_name = ROLE_TO_GROUP[ROLE_SALES]        # 'کارشناس فروش'

        ads_group, created = Group.objects.get_or_create(name=ads_group_name)
        sales_group = Group.objects.filter(name=sales_group_name).first()

        if created:
            self.stdout.write(self.style.WARNING(
                f'گروه «{ads_group_name}» ساخته شد.'
            ))
        else:
            self.stdout.write(f'گروه «{ads_group_name}» موجود است — همگام می‌شود...')

        # ═══ ۲. پاک‌سازی دسترسی‌های قبلی ═══
        ads_group.permissions.clear()

        # ═══ ۳. کپی دسترسی‌های sales ═══
        if sales_group:
            sales_perms = list(sales_group.permissions.all())
            if sales_perms:
                ads_group.permissions.add(*sales_perms)
                self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(
                    f'✓ {len(sales_perms)} دسترسی از «{sales_group_name}» کپی شد.'
                ))
            else:
                self.stdout.write(self.style.WARNING(
                    f'⚠ گروه «{sales_group_name}» هیچ Django permission ندارد — '
                    'Django perms کپی نشد.'
                ))
        else:
            self.stdout.write(self.style.WARNING(
                f'⚠ گروه «{sales_group_name}» پیدا نشد.'
            ))

        # ═══ ۴. دسترسی‌های تبلیغات ═══
        ad_ct = ContentType.objects.get(app_label='ads', model='ad')
        adlog_ct = ContentType.objects.get(app_label='ads', model='adlog')

        ad_perms = Permission.objects.filter(
            content_type=ad_ct,
            codename__in=['add_ad', 'change_ad', 'view_ad'],
        )
        adlog_perms = Permission.objects.filter(
            content_type=adlog_ct,
            codename__in=['view_adlog'],
        )

        ads_group.permissions.add(*ad_perms, *adlog_perms)
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(
            f'✓ {ad_perms.count() + adlog_perms.count()} دسترسی تبلیغات اضافه شد.'
        ))

        # ═══ ۵. خلاصه ═══
        total = ads_group.permissions.count()
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(
            f'\n✅ گروه «{ads_group_name}» الان {total} دسترسی Django دارد.'
        ))

        if total > 0:
            self.stdout.write('نمونه‌ها:')
            for p in list(ads_group.permissions.all())[:10]:
                self.stdout.write(f'  - {p.content_type.app_label}.{p.codename}')
            if total > 10:
                self.stdout.write(f'  ... و {total - 10} مورد دیگر')
```

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.db import models


class UserPermissionOverride(models.Model):
    """بازنویسی دسترسی کاربر — فراتر از نقش"""
    user = models.ForeignKey(
        User,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='permission_overrides',
        verbose_name='کاربر',
    )
    permission_key = models.CharField('کلید دسترسی', max_length=100)
    granted = models.BooleanField(
        'داده شده',
        help_text='True=دسترسی داده شده، False=دسترسی سلب شده',
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'بازنویسی دسترسی'
        verbose_name_plural = 'بازنویسی‌های دسترسی'
        unique_together = [('user', 'permission_key')]
        ordering = ['user__username', 'permission_key']

    def __str__(self):
        status = '✓' if self.granted else '✗'
        return f'{self.user.username} — {self.permission_key} {status}'

from django.utils import timezone
from accounts.permissions import has_permission

def get_notifications(user):
    """تولید اعلان‌های پویا برای کاربر بر اساس دسترسی‌ها و وضعیت سیستم"""
    if not user.is_authenticated:
        return []

    notifications = []
    today = timezone.now().date()

    # ۱. هشدار وظایف عقب‌افتاده
    if has_permission(user, 'hr.view_tasks'):
        from hr.models import Task
        overdue_tasks = Task.objects.filter(due_date__lt=today).exclude(status__in=['done', 'cancelled'])
        
        # اگر کاربر مدیر کل نیست، فقط وظایف خودش را ببیند
        if not user.is_superuser and not has_permission(user, 'hr.manage_tasks'):
            overdue_tasks = overdue_tasks.filter(assigned_to__user=user)
            
        count = overdue_tasks.count()
        if count > 0:
            notifications.append({
                'icon': '⚠️',
                'title': f'شما {count} وظیفه عقب‌افتاده دارید.',
                'url': '/hr/tasks/?due=overdue', # ⭐ لینک اصلاح شد
                'color': 'text-orange-600',
                'bg': 'bg-orange-50'
            })

    # ۲. درخواست‌های مرخصی در انتظار (فقط برای مدیران)
    if has_permission(user, 'hr.review_leaves'):
        from hr.models import LeaveRequest
        pending_leaves = LeaveRequest.objects.filter(status='pending').count()
        if pending_leaves > 0:
            notifications.append({
                'icon': '🏖',
                'title': f'{pending_leaves} درخواست مرخصی در انتظار بررسی است.',
                'url': '/hr/leaves/?status=pending',
                'color': 'text-blue-600',
                'bg': 'bg-blue-50'
            })

    # ۳. تماس‌های پیگیری امروز و گذشته
    if has_permission(user, 'calls.view'):
        from calls.models import Call
        followups = Call.objects.filter(follow_up_date__lte=today, is_followed_up=False)
        
        if not user.is_superuser:
            followups = followups.filter(called_by=user)
            
        count_followups = followups.count()
        if count_followups > 0:
            notifications.append({
                'icon': '📞',
                'title': f'{count_followups} تماس نیازمند پیگیری دارید.',
                'url': '/calls/?followup=pending',
                'color': 'text-green-600',
                'bg': 'bg-green-50'
            })

    return notifications
```

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# توابع کمکی
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def get_user_role(user):
    """
    نقش کاربر رو از روی عضویت گروهی برمی‌گردونه.

    ترتیب چک:
    1. Superuser → admin
    2. گروه فارسی (طبق ROLE_TO_GROUP) → role_key
    3. گروه انگلیسی (legacy/تست) → role_key (fallback)
    """
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return None
    if user.is_superuser:
        return ROLE_ADMIN

    # ─── چک گروه فارسی ───
    for role_key, group_name in ROLE_TO_GROUP.items():
        if user.groups.filter(name=group_name).exists():
            return role_key

    # ─── fallback: چک گروه انگلیسی (برای سازگاری با تست‌ها/legacy) ───
    for role_key in ROLE_TO_GROUP.keys():
        if user.groups.filter(name=role_key).exists():
            return role_key

    return 'none'


def get_user_role_display(user):
    role = get_user_role(user)
    return ROLE_DISPLAY.get(role, '—')


def has_role(user, *roles):
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return False
    if user.is_superuser:
        return True
    return get_user_role(user) in roles


def has_permission(user, permission_name):
    """
    ترتیب:
    1. سوپریوزر → True
    2. override کاربر → granted یا denied
    3. نقش کاربر → از PERMISSIONS
    """
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return False
    if user.is_superuser:
        return True

    # 1. override
    override = user.permission_overrides.filter(
        permission_key=permission_name,
    ).first()
    if override is not None:
        return override.granted

    # 2. role-based
    allowed_roles = PERMISSIONS.get(permission_name, [])
    return get_user_role(user) in allowed_roles


def get_user_permissions(user):
    if not user or not user.is_authenticated:
        return set()
    if user.is_superuser:
        return set(PERMISSIONS.keys())

    user_role = get_user_role(user)
    perms = {
        perm for perm, roles in PERMISSIONS.items()
        if user_role in roles
    }

    for override in user.permission_overrides.all():
        if override.granted:
            perms.add(override.permission_key)
        else:
            perms.discard(override.permission_key)

    return perms


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Handling denial
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def _is_ajax(request):
    return (
        request.headers.get('X-Requested-With') == 'XMLHttpRequest'
        or request.headers.get('HX-Request') == 'true'
    )


def _log_denied(request, permission_name):
    user = getattr(request, 'user', None)
    username = (
        user.username if user and user.is_authenticated else 'anonymous'
    )
    logger.warning(
        'Access denied — user=%s permission=%s path=%s method=%s',
        username, permission_name, request.path, request.method,
    )


def _render_403(request, message=None):
    user = getattr(request, 'user', None)
    user_role_display = (
        get_user_role_display(user)
        if user and user.is_authenticated else None
    )
    return render(request, 'errors/403.html', {
        'message': message or 'شما دسترسی به این بخش را ندارید.',
        'user_role_display': user_role_display,
    }, status=403)


def _handle_denied(request, permission_name, on_denied, redirect_to):
    _log_denied(request, permission_name)

    if _is_ajax(request):
        return JsonResponse({
            'success': False,
            'error': 'شما دسترسی به این عملیات را ندارید.',
        }, status=403)

    if on_denied == 'redirect':
        messages.error(request, 'شما دسترسی به این بخش را ندارید.')
        return redirect(redirect_to)

    return _render_403(request)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Decoratorها
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def require_roles(*roles, on_denied='403', redirect_to='dashboard:home'):
    def decorator(view_func):
        @wraps(view_func)
        def wrapper(request, *args, **kwargs):
            if not request.user.is_authenticated:
                if _is_ajax(request):
                    return JsonResponse(
                        {'success': False, 'error': 'لطفاً وارد شوید.'},
                        status=401,
                    )
                return redirect('accounts:login')

            if has_role(request.user, *roles):
                return view_func(request, *args, **kwargs)

            return _handle_denied(
                request,
                permission_name=f'roles={roles}',
                on_denied=on_denied,
                redirect_to=redirect_to,
            )
        return wrapper
    return decorator


def require_permission(permission_name, on_denied='403', redirect_to='dashboard:home'):
    def decorator(view_func):
        @wraps(view_func)
        def wrapper(request, *args, **kwargs):
            if not request.user.is_authenticated:
                if _is_ajax(request):
                    return JsonResponse(
                        {'success': False, 'error': 'لطفاً وارد شوید.'},
                        status=401,
                    )
                return redirect('accounts:login')

            if has_permission(request.user, permission_name):
                return view_func(request, *args, **kwargs)

            return _handle_denied(
                request,
                permission_name=permission_name,
                on_denied=on_denied,
                redirect_to=redirect_to,
            )
        return wrapper
    return decorator

```python
"""
Rate limiting برای صفحه‌ی ورود — ۸.۲

دو لایه محافظت:
1. per (username + IP):  پس از ۵ تلاش ناموفق، ۱۵ دقیقه قفل
2. per IP:               پس از ۲۰ تلاش ناموفق، ۱۵ دقیقه قفل

از cache بومی Django استفاده می‌کنه — بدون وابستگی خارجی.
"""
import time

from django.conf import settings
from django.core.cache import cache


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# پیش‌فرض‌ها (قابل override از settings)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
_DEFAULT_USER_LIMIT = 5           # حداکثر تلاش ناموفق per (username+IP)
_DEFAULT_IP_LIMIT = 20            # حداکثر تلاش ناموفق per IP
_DEFAULT_WINDOW = 15 * 60         # پنجره‌ی زمانی (ثانیه)
_DEFAULT_LOCKOUT = 15 * 60        # مدت قفل (ثانیه)


def _cfg(name, default):
    return getattr(settings, name, default)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# کلیدهای cache
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def _key_user(username, ip):
    return f'rl:login:user:{username.lower()}:{ip}'


def _key_ip(ip):
    return f'rl:login:ip:{ip}'


def _lock_user(username, ip):
    return f'rl:login:lock:user:{username.lower()}:{ip}'


def _lock_ip(ip):
    return f'rl:login:lock:ip:{ip}'


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ابزارها
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def get_client_ip(request):
    """
    IP کاربر با پشتیبانی از پروکسی/load balancer.
    ترتیب اولویت: X-Forwarded-For → X-Real-IP → REMOTE_ADDR
    """
    xff = request.META.get('HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR')
    if xff:
        # اولین IP در لیست، IP کاربر واقعیه
        return xff.split(',')[0].strip()

    real_ip = request.META.get('HTTP_X_REAL_IP')
    if real_ip:
        return real_ip.strip()

    return request.META.get('REMOTE_ADDR', '0.0.0.0')


def _bump(counter_key, window):
    """
    افزایش شمارنده به‌صورت اتمیک.
    اگه کلید نبود، با مقدار ۱ و TTL=window ست می‌شه.
    """
    if cache.add(counter_key, 1, window):
        return 1
    try:
        return cache.incr(counter_key)
    except ValueError:
        # کلید در فاصله‌ی بین add و incr منقضی شد
        cache.set(counter_key, 1, window)
        return 1


def _set_lock(lock_key, lockout):
    """ذخیره‌ی lock با timestamp انقضا (برای محاسبه‌ی remaining)"""
    expires_at = time.time() + lockout
    cache.set(lock_key, expires_at, lockout)


def _remaining(lock_key):
    """چند ثانیه تا رفع قفل مونده؟ (0 = قفل نیست)"""
    expires_at = cache.get(lock_key)
    if not expires_at:
        return 0
    return max(0, int(expires_at - time.time()))


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# API عمومی
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def is_locked(username, ip):
    """آیا (username, ip) قفل هست؟"""
    return bool(
        cache.get(_lock_user(username, ip))
        or cache.get(_lock_ip(ip))
    )


def get_lock_remaining(username, ip):
    """چند ثانیه تا رفع قفل؟ (0 = قفل نیست)"""
    return max(
        _remaining(_lock_user(username, ip)),
        _remaining(_lock_ip(ip)),
    )


def register_failure(username, ip):
    """
    ثبت یک تلاش ناموفق.
    برمی‌گردونه: 'user' یا 'ip' (کدوم لایه قفل شد) یا None.
    """
    user_limit = _cfg('LOGIN_FAILED_ATTEMPTS', _DEFAULT_USER_LIMIT)
    ip_limit = _cfg('LOGIN_FAILED_IP_ATTEMPTS', _DEFAULT_IP_LIMIT)
    window = _cfg('LOGIN_FAILED_WINDOW', _DEFAULT_WINDOW)
    lockout = _cfg('LOGIN_LOCKOUT', _DEFAULT_LOCKOUT)

    # ─── لایه ۱: per (username+IP) ───
    if username:
        count = _bump(_key_user(username, ip), window)
        if count >= user_limit:
            _set_lock(_lock_user(username, ip), lockout)
            return 'user'

    # ─── لایه ۲: per IP ───
    count_ip = _bump(_key_ip(ip), window)
    if count_ip >= ip_limit:
        _set_lock(_lock_ip(ip), lockout)
        return 'ip'

    return None


def clear_failures(username, ip):
    """پاک کردن همه‌ی شمارنده‌ها پس از لاگین موفق"""
    cache.delete_many([
        _key_user(username, ip),
        _key_ip(ip),
        _lock_user(username, ip),
        _lock_ip(ip),
    ])


def get_remaining_attempts(username, ip):
    """
    تعداد تلاش‌های باقی‌مانده برای این (username, ip).
    None اگه قفل باشه.
    """
    if is_locked(username, ip):
        return None
    limit = _cfg('LOGIN_FAILED_ATTEMPTS', _DEFAULT_USER_LIMIT)
    count = cache.get(_key_user(username, ip), 0)
    return max(0, limit - count)
```

"""

"""
from django.test import TestCase, RequestFactory
from django.contrib.auth.models import User, Group, AnonymousUser
from django.http import HttpResponse
from django.urls import reverse

from .permissions import (
    get_user_role, get_user_role_display, has_role, has_permission,
    get_user_permissions, require_permission, require_roles,
    PERMISSIONS,
    ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SALES_MANAGER, ROLE_SALES,
    ROLE_SUPPORT, ROLE_ACCOUNTANT, ROLE_OPERATOR,
    ROLE_TO_GROUP,
)
from .forms import ROLE_GROUP_MAP, ensure_groups
