#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
1. Convert DateFields to DateTimeFields for auto-recorded entries.
2. Update views to filter by date properly.
3. Update templates to show both Date and Time (Persian).
4. Generate data migrations to backfill old records with creation time.
"""

import re
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

# ============================================================
# 1. Update Models
# ============================================================
def patch_models():
    print("🔧 Patching models...")

    # sales/models.py
    p = BASE / 'sales' / 'models.py'
    if p.exists():
        c = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        c = c.replace(
            "issue_date = models.DateField('تاریخ صدور', default=timezone.now, db_index=True)",
            "issue_date = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ صدور', default=timezone.now, db_index=True)"
        )
        p.write_text(c, encoding='utf-8')
        print("  ✅ sales/models.py updated")

    # hr/models.py
    p = BASE / 'hr' / 'models.py'
    if p.exists():
        c = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        c = c.replace(
            "hire_date = models.DateField('تاریخ استخدام', default=timezone.now)",
            "hire_date = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ استخدام', default=timezone.now)"
        )
        p.write_text(c, encoding='utf-8')
        print("  ✅ hr/models.py updated")

# ============================================================
# 2. Update Views (Filtering)
# ============================================================
def patch_views():
    print("\n🔧 Patching views for safe filtering...")
    p = BASE / 'sales' / 'views.py'
    if p.exists():
        c = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        c = c.replace("qs = qs.filter(issue_date__gte=from_date)", "qs = qs.filter(issue_date__date__gte=from_date)")
        c = c.replace("qs = qs.filter(issue_date__lte=to_date)", "qs = qs.filter(issue_date__date__lte=to_date)")
        p.write_text(c, encoding='utf-8')
        print("  ✅ sales/views.py updated")

# ============================================================
# 3. Update Templates (Show Date + Time)
# ============================================================
def patch_templates():
    print("\n🔧 Patching templates (Date + Time)...")
    
    # sales/list.html
    p = BASE / 'templates' / 'sales' / 'list.html'
    if p.exists():
        c = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        c = c.replace('{{ invoice.issue_date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}', '{{ invoice.issue_date|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}')
        p.write_text(c, encoding='utf-8')
        print("  ✅ sales/list.html updated")

    # sales/detail.html
    p = BASE / 'templates' / 'sales' / 'detail.html'
    if p.exists():
        c = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        c = c.replace('{{ invoice.issue_date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}', '{{ invoice.issue_date|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}')
        p.write_text(c, encoding='utf-8')
        print("  ✅ sales/detail.html updated")

    # sales/print.html
    p = BASE / 'templates' / 'sales' / 'print.html'
    if p.exists():
        c = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        c = c.replace('{{ invoice.issue_date|jdate:"Y/m/d"|fa_digits }}', '{{ invoice.issue_date|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i"|fa_digits }}')
        p.write_text(c, encoding='utf-8')
        print("  ✅ sales/print.html updated")

    # hr/employee_list.html
    p = BASE / 'templates' / 'hr' / 'employee_list.html'
    if p.exists():
        c = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        c = c.replace('{{ emp.hire_date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}', '{{ emp.hire_date|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}')
        p.write_text(c, encoding='utf-8')
        print("  ✅ hr/employee_list.html updated")

    # hr/employee_detail.html
    p = BASE / 'templates' / 'hr' / 'employee_detail.html'
    if p.exists():
        c = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        c = c.replace('{{ employee.hire_date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}', '{{ employee.hire_date|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}')
        p.write_text(c, encoding='utf-8')
        print("  ✅ hr/employee_detail.html updated")

    # hr/attendance_list.html
    p = BASE / 'templates' / 'hr' / 'attendance_list.html'
    if p.exists():
        c = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
        c = c.replace('<th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">تاریخ</th>', '<th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">تاریخ و زمان ثبت</th>')
        c = c.replace('{{ att.date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}', '{{ att.date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }} <span class="text-gray-400 mx-1">|</span> {{ att.created_at|jdate:"H:i" }}')
        p.write_text(c, encoding='utf-8')
        print("  ✅ hr/attendance_list.html updated")

# ============================================================
# 4. Generate Data Migration for Backfill
# ============================================================
def create_migrations():
    print("\n🔧 Creating data backfill migrations...")

    # Sales Migration
    sales_mig = BASE / 'sales' / 'migrations' / '0004_backfill_invoice_time.py'
    sales_mig.write_text('''from django.db import migrations
from datetime import datetime, time

def backfill_time(apps, schema_editor):
    Invoice = apps.get_model('sales', 'Invoice')
    for inv in Invoice.objects.all():
        if inv.issue_date and inv.created_at:
            # Combine old date with creation time
            inv.issue_date = datetime.combine(inv.issue_date.date(), inv.created_at.time())
            inv.save(update_fields=['issue_date'])

class Migration(migrations.Migration):
    dependencies = [
        ('sales', '0003_alter_invoice_due_date_alter_invoice_issue_date_and_more'),
    ]
    operations = [
        migrations.RunPython(backfill_time, migrations.RunPython.noop),
    ]
''', encoding='utf-8')
    print("  ✅ sales/migrations/0004_backfill_invoice_time.py created")

    # HR Migration
    hr_mig = BASE / 'hr' / 'migrations' / '0005_backfill_employee_time.py'
    hr_mig.write_text('''from django.db import migrations
from datetime import datetime, time

def backfill_time(apps, schema_editor):
    Employee = apps.get_model('hr', 'Employee')
    for emp in Employee.objects.all():
        if emp.hire_date and emp.created_at:
            # Combine old date with creation time
            emp.hire_date = datetime.combine(emp.hire_date.date(), emp.created_at.time())
            emp.save(update_fields=['hire_date'])

class Migration(migrations.Migration):
    dependencies = [
        ('hr', '0004_alter_employee_mobile_alter_employee_national_id_and_more'),
    ]
    operations = [
        migrations.RunPython(backfill_time, migrations.RunPython.noop),
    ]
''', encoding='utf-8')
    print("  ✅ hr/migrations/0005_backfill_employee_time.py created")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    print("🚀 Applying Date & Time enhancements...\n")
    patch_models()
    patch_views()
    patch_templates()
    create_migrations()
    print("\n🎉 Done! Now run: python manage.py makemigrations && python manage.py migrate")
```

from django.contrib import admin
from unfold.admin import ModelAdmin

from .forms import AdForm
from .models import Ad, AdLog, AdPlatform, AdProcess, AdSource


class AdAdminForm(AdForm):
    """
    فرم admin برای Ad — با دو تفاوت مهم نسبت به AdForm سایت:

    1. queryset فرآیندها را روی همه‌ی processهای فعال ست می‌کند
       (سایت از JS برای dynamically filter کردن استفاده می‌کند،
        ولی admin JS ما را ندارد).

    2. rest از منطق AdForm (clean، unique check، platform/process matching)
       دقیقاً همان است — یعنی ادمین هم نمی‌تواند داده‌ی ناسازگار بسازد.
    """

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        # در admin همه‌ی processهای فعال را نمایش بده
        # (چون JS نداریم که به platform-change واکنش دهد).
        # clean() همچنان تناسب platform.process را enforce می‌کند.
        self.fields['process'].queryset = AdProcess.objects.filter(is_active=True)


@admin.register(AdPlatform)
class AdPlatformAdmin(ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ['name', 'is_active', 'created_at']
    list_filter = ['is_active']
    search_fields = ['name']


@admin.register(AdProcess)
class AdProcessAdmin(ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ['name', 'platform', 'default_cost', 'is_active']
    list_filter = ['platform', 'is_active']
    search_fields = ['name']


@admin.register(AdSource)
class AdSourceAdmin(ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ['phone_number', 'label', 'is_active', 'created_at']
    list_filter = ['is_active']
    search_fields = ['phone_number', 'label']


@admin.register(Ad)
class AdAdmin(ModelAdmin):
    # ⭐ Fix #6: استفاده از AdForm به‌جای ModelForm پیش‌فرض
    # این کار همه‌ی اعتبارسنجی‌های clean() را در admin هم فعال می‌کند
    # (مثلاً process متعلق به platform دیگر نمی‌تواند ثبت شود).
    form = AdAdminForm

    list_display = [
        'ad_number', 'platform', 'process', 'cost',
        'source', 'product', 'created_by', 'created_at',
    ]
    list_filter = ['platform', 'process', 'created_by', 'created_at']
    search_fields = ['ad_number', 'source__phone_number', 'product__name']
    readonly_fields = ['created_at', 'created_by']
    date_hierarchy = 'created_at'

    def save_model(self, request, obj, form, change):
        if not change:
            obj.created_by = request.user
        super().save_model(request, obj, form, change)


@admin.register(AdLog)
class AdLogAdmin(ModelAdmin):
    list_display = ['ad', 'action', 'changed_by', 'changed_at']

    search_fields = ['ad__ad_number', 'changed_by__username']
    readonly_fields = ['ad', 'action', 'changed_by', 'changed_at', 'changes', 'note']

from django import forms
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError
from django.forms import CheckboxInput

from crm.form_mixins import DuplicateCheckMixin
from .models import Ad, AdPlatform, AdProcess, AdSource


class StyledFormMixin:
    input_classes = (
        'w-full border border-gray-200 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm '
        'focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500'
    )

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        for field in self.fields.values():
            widget = field.widget
            if isinstance(widget, CheckboxInput):
                continue
            existing = widget.attrs.get('class', '')
            widget.attrs['class'] = f'{existing} {self.input_classes}'.strip()


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# فرم تبلیغ اصلی
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
class AdForm(DuplicateCheckMixin, StyledFormMixin, forms.ModelForm):
    duplicate_model = 'ad'
    duplicate_fields = {'ad_number': 'شناسه آگهی'}

    class Meta:
        model = Ad
        fields = [
            'platform', 'process', 'cost', 'source',
            'product', 'ad_number', 'note',
        ]
        widgets = {
            'note': forms.Textarea(attrs={'rows': 3}),
            'cost': forms.NumberInput(attrs={'step': '1000'}),
            'ad_number': forms.TextInput(attrs={
                'placeholder': 'خودکار پر می‌شود',
                'autocomplete': 'off',
                'readonly': 'readonly',
            }),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)

        # شناسه آگهی اختیاری — اگه خالی بمونه، خودکار پر می‌شه
        self.fields['ad_number'].required = False

        self.fields['platform'].queryset = AdPlatform.objects.filter(is_active=True)
        self.fields['source'].queryset = AdSource.objects.filter(is_active=True)

        if self.instance.pk and self.instance.platform_id:
            self.fields['process'].queryset = AdProcess.objects.filter(
                platform=self.instance.platform, is_active=True,
            )
        elif 'platform' in self.data:
            try:
                platform_id = int(self.data.get('platform'))
                self.fields['process'].queryset = AdProcess.objects.filter(
                    platform_id=platform_id, is_active=True,
                )
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                self.fields['process'].queryset = AdProcess.objects.none()
        else:
            self.fields['process'].queryset = AdProcess.objects.none()

        from products.models import Product
        self.fields['product'].queryset = Product.objects.filter(
            stock__gt=0,
        ).order_by('name')
        self.fields['product'].required = False

    def clean_ad_number(self):
        ad_number = (self.cleaned_data.get('ad_number') or '').strip()

        # اگه خالی بود، خودکار از پلتفرم بگیر
        if not ad_number:
            platform = self.cleaned_data.get('platform')
            if platform:
                ad_number = platform.get_next_ad_number()

        if not ad_number:
            raise ValidationError('شناسه آگهی الزامی است.')

        qs = Ad.objects.filter(ad_number=ad_number)
        if self.instance.pk:
            qs = qs.exclude(pk=self.instance.pk)
        if qs.exists():
            raise ValidationError(
                f'شناسه آگهی «{ad_number}» قبلاً ثبت شده است. '
                'شناسه آگهی باید یونیک باشد.'
            )
        return ad_number

    def clean_cost(self):
        cost = self.cleaned_data.get('cost')
        if cost is not None and cost < 0:
            raise ValidationError('هزینه نمی‌تواند منفی باشد.')
        return cost

    def clean(self):
        cleaned = super().clean()
        platform = cleaned.get('platform')
        process = cleaned.get('process')
        if platform and process and process.platform_id != platform.id:
            self.add_error(
                'process',
                'فرآیند انتخاب‌شده به این پلتفرم تعلق ندارد.',
            )
        return cleaned

        return phone

from django.db import migrations


def backfill_snapshot(apps, schema_editor):
    """پر کردن ad_number_snapshot برای لاگ‌های موجود که ad دارند"""
    AdLog = apps.get_model('ads', 'AdLog')
    Ad = apps.get_model('ads', 'Ad')

    # فقط لاگ‌هایی که ad_id دارند ولی snapshot ندارند
    logs = AdLog.objects.filter(
        ad__isnull=False,
        ad_number_snapshot='',
    ).values_list('id', 'ad_id')

    # دیکشنری سریع ad_id → ad_number (فقط یک کوئری)
    ad_numbers = dict(Ad.objects.values_list('id', 'ad_number'))

    to_update = []
    for log_id, ad_id in logs:
        num = ad_numbers.get(ad_id, '')
        if num:
            to_update.append(AdLog(id=log_id, ad_number_snapshot=num))

    if to_update:
        AdLog.objects.bulk_update(
            to_update,
            fields=['ad_number_snapshot'],
            batch_size=500,
        )


class Migration(migrations.Migration):

    dependencies = [
        # اسم واقعی فایل 0003 — همون که Django خودش ساخت
        ('ads', '0003_adlog_ad_number_snapshot_alter_adlog_ad_and_more'),
    ]

    operations = [
        migrations.RunPython(backfill_snapshot, migrations.RunPython.noop),
    ]
```

from django.conf import settings
from django.db import models
from django.utils import timezone


class AdPlatform(models.Model):
    """عنوان‌های تبلیغاتی (پلتفرم‌ها) — فقط ادمین می‌تواند اضافه/حذف کند"""
    name = models.CharField('عنوان', max_length=100, unique=True)
    ad_number_start = models.PositiveIntegerField(
        'شماره شروع آگهی',
        default=1000,
        help_text='اولین شناسه آگهی این پلتفرم — بعدی‌ها خودکار ادامه می‌یابند.',
    )
    is_active = models.BooleanField('فعال', default=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ ایجاد', auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'عنوان تبلیغاتی'
        verbose_name_plural = 'عنوان‌های تبلیغاتی'
        ordering = ['name']

    def __str__(self):
        return self.name

    def get_next_ad_number(self):
        """عدد بعدی سری برای این پلتفرم"""
        nums = []
        for n in self.ads.values_list('ad_number', flat=True):
            try:
                nums.append(int(n))
            except (ValueError, TypeError):
                continue
        if nums:
            return str(max(nums) + 1)
        return str(self.ad_number_start)


class AdProcess(models.Model):
    """فرآیند تبلیغ — هر فرآیند وابسته به یک پلتفرم + هزینه پیش‌فرض"""
    platform = models.ForeignKey(
        AdPlatform,
        on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='processes',
        verbose_name='عنوان',
    )
    name = models.CharField('نام فرآیند', max_length=150)
    default_cost = models.DecimalField(
        'هزینه پیش‌فرض (تومان)',
        max_digits=15,
        decimal_places=0,
    )
    is_active = models.BooleanField('فعال', default=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ ایجاد', auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'فرآیند تبلیغ'
        verbose_name_plural = 'فرآیندهای تبلیغ'
        ordering = ['platform__name', 'name']
        constraints = [
            models.UniqueConstraint(
                fields=['platform', 'name'],
                name='unique_process_per_platform',
            ),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.platform.name} — {self.name}'


class AdSource(models.Model):
    """منبع آگهی — شماره تماسی که آگهی با آن تعریف شده"""
    phone_number = models.CharField(
        'شماره تماس',
        max_length=20,
        unique=True,
        help_text='مثال: 09123456789',
    )
    label = models.CharField(
        'برچسب',
        max_length=100,
        blank=True,
        help_text='مثال: خط اصلی، خط پشتیبانی',
    )
    is_active = models.BooleanField('فعال', default=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ ایجاد', auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'منبع تبلیغ'
        verbose_name_plural = 'منابع تبلیغ'
        ordering = ['phone_number']

    def __str__(self):
        if self.label:
            return f'{self.phone_number} ({self.label})'
        return self.phone_number


class Ad(models.Model):
    """رکورد اصلی تبلیغ"""
    platform = models.ForeignKey(
        AdPlatform,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name='ads',
        verbose_name='عنوان',
    )
    process = models.ForeignKey(
        AdProcess,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name='ads',
        verbose_name='فرآیند',
    )
    cost = models.DecimalField(
        'هزینه (تومان)',
        max_digits=15,
        decimal_places=0,
        help_text='به صورت خودکار از فرآیند پر می‌شود، قابل ویرایش است.',
    )
    source = models.ForeignKey(
        AdSource,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name='ads',
        verbose_name='منبع',
    )
    product = models.ForeignKey(
        'products.Product',
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name='ads',
        verbose_name='محصول',
        null=True,
        blank=True,
    )
    ad_number = models.CharField(
        'شناسه آگهی',
        max_length=100,
        unique=True,
        help_text='شماره یونیک آگهی در پلتفرم',
    )
    note = models.TextField('توضیحات', blank=True)

    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name='ads_created',
        verbose_name='کارشناس ثبت‌کننده',
    )
    created_at = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ ثبت', auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'تبلیغ'
        verbose_name_plural = 'تبلیغات'
        ordering = ['-created_at']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['-created_at']),
            models.Index(fields=['created_by', '-created_at']),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.platform.name} — {self.ad_number}'


class AdLog(models.Model):
    """تاریخچه کامل تغییرات — چه کسی، چه زمانی، چه تغییری

    ⭐ نکته طراحی (Fix #2):
    - `ad` با `on_delete=SET_NULL` تعریف شده تا با حذف Ad، لاگ‌ها زنده بمانند.
    - `ad_number_snapshot` شناسه‌ی خوانا را در خود لاگ نگه می‌دارد؛ پس از حذف
      Ad، هنوز می‌توان فهمید که این لاگ مربوط به کدام آگهی بوده.
    - `save()` به‌طور خودکار snapshot را از ad پر می‌کند؛ پس در views نیازی
      به تغییر کد نیست.
    """
    ACTION_CHOICES = [
        ('create', 'ایجاد'),
        ('update', 'ویرایش'),
        ('delete', 'حذف'),
    ]

    ad = models.ForeignKey(
        Ad,
        on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True,
        blank=True,
        related_name='logs',
        verbose_name='تبلیغ',
    )
    # ⭐ اسنپ‌شات شناسه برای حفظ قابلیت audit پس از حذف Ad
    ad_number_snapshot = models.CharField(
        'شناسه آگهی (اسنپ‌شات)',
        max_length=100,
        blank=True,
        db_index=True,
        help_text='حفظ شناسه حتی پس از حذف رکورد اصلی',
    )
    action = models.CharField(
        'عملیات',
        max_length=10,
        choices=ACTION_CHOICES,
    )
    changed_by = models.ForeignKey(
        settings.AUTH_USER_MODEL,
        on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name='ad_logs',
        verbose_name='توسط',
    )
    changed_at = models.DateTimeField('زمان', default=timezone.now)
    changes = models.JSONField(
        'تغییرات',
        default=dict,
        blank=True,
        help_text='dict از {field: [old, new]}',
    )
    note = models.TextField('توضیح', blank=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'تاریخچه تبلیغ'
        verbose_name_plural = 'تاریخچه تبلیغات'
        ordering = ['-changed_at']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['ad', '-changed_at']),
            models.Index(fields=['ad_number_snapshot', '-changed_at']),
        ]

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        # ⭐ Fix #2: پر کردن خودکار snapshot از ad (فقط یک‌بار، در اولین ذخیره)
        if not self.ad_number_snapshot and self.ad_id:
            try:
                self.ad_number_snapshot = self.ad.ad_number
            except Ad.DoesNotExist:
                # اگر Ad هنوز وجود ندارد (مثلاً batch insert)، بی‌صدا رد شو
                pass
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    @property
    def ad_label(self):
        """شناسه‌ی نمایشی — حتی اگر Ad حذف شده باشد کار می‌کند"""
        if self.ad_number_snapshot:
            return self.ad_number_snapshot
        if self.ad_id:
            return self.ad.ad_number
        return '—'

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.ad_label} — {self.get_action_display()}'

"""
دسترسی‌های اپ تبلیغات — یکپارچه با RBAC مرکزی
"""
from accounts.permissions import (
    ROLE_ADS_MANAGER,
    has_permission,
    has_role,
)


def is_ads_manager(user):
    """مسئول تبلیغات یا ادمین"""
    return has_role(user, ROLE_ADS_MANAGER)


def is_admin_only(user):
    """فقط ادمین"""
    return user.is_authenticated and user.is_superuser


def can_view_ad(user, ad):
    """ادمین همه، مسئول تبلیغات فقط رکوردهای خودش"""
    if user.is_superuser:
        return True
    if has_role(user, ROLE_ADS_MANAGER):
        return ad.created_by_id == user.id
    return False


def can_manage_definitions(user):
    """آیا می‌تواند عنوان/فرآیند/منبع تعریف کند؟"""
    return has_permission(user, 'ads.manage_defs')

from django.contrib import messages
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.core.paginator import Paginator
from django.db import transaction
from django.db.models import Count, Q, Sum
from django.http import HttpResponse, HttpResponseForbidden, JsonResponse
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404, redirect, render
from django.utils import timezone
from django.views.decorators.http import require_http_methods

import jdatetime

from .forms import AdForm, AdPlatformForm, AdProcessForm, AdSourceForm
from .models import Ad, AdLog, AdPlatform, AdProcess, AdSource
from accounts.permissions import has_permission as _has_permission

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# سیستم بررسی دسترسی یکپارچه
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def check_permission(user, perm_key):
    """بررسی دسترسی با استفاده از سیستم مرکزی RBAC"""
    if user.is_superuser:
        return True
    return _has_permission(user, perm_key)

def perm_required(perm_key):
    """دکوراتور برای بررسی دسترسی در ویوها"""
    def decorator(view_func):
        @login_required
        def _wrapped_view(request, *args, **kwargs):
            if not check_permission(request.user, perm_key):
                return HttpResponseForbidden('شما دسترسی لازم برای این عملیات را ندارید.')
            return view_func(request, *args, **kwargs)
        return _wrapped_view
    return decorator


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Helper: تبدیل تاریخ شمسی به میلادی
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
def _parse_jalali(s):
    if not s:
        return None
    try:
        parts = s.strip().replace('-', '/').split('/')
        if len(parts) != 3:
            return None
        y, m, d = map(int, parts)
        return jdatetime.date(y, m, d).togregorian()
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None


def _apply_report_filters(request, qs):
    report_user_id = request.GET.get('report_user', '')
    report_from = request.GET.get('report_from', '')
    report_to = request.GET.get('report_to', '')

    if request.user.is_superuser and report_user_id:
        qs = qs.filter(created_by_id=report_user_id)

    g_from = _parse_jalali(report_from)
    if g_from:
        qs = qs.filter(created_at__date__gte=g_from)

    g_to = _parse_jalali(report_to)
    if g_to:
        qs = qs.filter(created_at__date__lte=g_to)

    return qs, report_user_id, report_from, report_to


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# لیست تبلیغات + گزارش
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
@login_required
@perm_required('ads.view')
def ad_list(request):
    qs = Ad.objects.select_related(
        'platform', 'process', 'source', 'product', 'created_by',
    )
    if not request.user.is_superuser:
        qs = qs.filter(created_by=request.user)

    q = request.GET.get('q', '').strip()
    if q:
        qs = qs.filter(
            Q(ad_number__icontains=q)
            | Q(platform__name__icontains=q)
            | Q(process__name__icontains=q)
            | Q(source__phone_number__icontains=q)
            | Q(product__name__icontains=q)
            | Q(note__icontains=q)
        )

    platform_id = request.GET.get('platform')
    if platform_id:
        qs = qs.filter(platform_id=platform_id)

    if request.user.is_superuser:
        user_id = request.GET.get('user')
        if user_id:
            qs = qs.filter(created_by_id=user_id)

    now = timezone.now()
    stats = {
        'total': qs.count(),
        'total_cost': qs.aggregate(t=Sum('cost'))['t'] or 0,
        'this_month': qs.filter(
            created_at__year=now.year,
            created_at__month=now.month,
        ).count(),
        'platforms': AdPlatform.objects.filter(is_active=True).count(),
    }

    paginator = Paginator(qs, 10)
    page_obj = paginator.get_page(request.GET.get('page'))

    # گزارش
    report_qs = Ad.objects.all()
    if not request.user.is_superuser:
        report_qs = report_qs.filter(created_by=request.user)

    report_qs, r_user, r_from, r_to = _apply_report_filters(request, report_qs)

    report_summary = {
        'count': report_qs.count(),
        'total_cost': report_qs.aggregate(t=Sum('cost'))['t'] or 0,
    }

    by_platform = list(
        report_qs.values('platform__name')
        .annotate(count=Count('id'), total=Sum('cost'))
        .order_by('-total')
    )
    for item in by_platform:
        item['total'] = item['total'] or 0

    by_user = None
    if request.user.is_superuser:
        by_user = list(
            report_qs.values('created_by__username')
            .annotate(count=Count('id'), total=Sum('cost'))
            .order_by('-total')
        )
        for item in by_user:
            item['total'] = item['total'] or 0

    report = {
        'user_id': r_user,
        'from': r_from,
        'to': r_to,
        'summary': report_summary,
        'by_platform': by_platform,
        'by_user': by_user,
        'chart_labels': [item['platform__name'] for item in by_platform],
        'chart_values': [float(item['total']) for item in by_platform],
    }

    context = {
        'page_obj': page_obj,
        'q': q,
        'platforms': AdPlatform.objects.filter(is_active=True),
        'current_platform': platform_id,
        'users': (
            Ad.objects.values_list('created_by__id', 'created_by__username')
            .distinct()
            if request.user.is_superuser else None
        ),
        'is_admin': request.user.is_superuser,
        'stats': stats,
        'report': report,
        'can_view': check_permission(request.user, 'ads.view'),
        'can_create': check_permission(request.user, 'ads.add'),
        'can_edit': check_permission(request.user, 'ads.edit'),
        'can_delete': check_permission(request.user, 'ads.delete'),
        'can_manage_definitions': check_permission(request.user, 'ads.manage_defs'),
    }
    return render(request, 'ads/ad_list.html', context)


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# خروجی Excel گزارش
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
@login_required
@perm_required('ads.view')
def ad_export_report(request):
    import openpyxl
    from openpyxl.styles import Alignment, Font, PatternFill

    qs = Ad.objects.select_related(
        'platform', 'process', 'source', 'product', 'created_by',
    ).order_by('-created_at')

    if not request.user.is_superuser:
        qs = qs.filter(created_by=request.user)

    qs, _, _, _ = _apply_report_filters(request, qs)

    wb = openpyxl.Workbook()

    ws = wb.active
    ws.title = 'ریز تبلیغات'
    ws.sheet_view.rightToLeft = True

    headers = [
        'ردیف', 'عنوان', 'فرآیند', 'هزینه (تومان)', 'منبع',
        'محصول', 'شناسه آگهی', 'کارشناس', 'تاریخ ثبت', 'توضیحات',
    ]
    ws.append(headers)

    header_fill = PatternFill('solid', fgColor='2563EB')
    header_font = Font(color='FFFFFF', bold=True)
    for cell in ws[1]:
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.font = header_font
        cell.alignment = Alignment(horizontal='center', vertical='center')

    for i, ad in enumerate(qs, 1):
        ws.append([
            i,
            ad.platform.name,
            ad.process.name,
            float(ad.cost),
            ad.source.phone_number,
            ad.product.name if ad.product else '—',
            ad.ad_number,
            ad.created_by.username,
            ad.created_at.strftime('%Y/%m/%d %H:%M'),
            ad.note or '',
        ])

    for col_idx in range(1, len(headers) + 1):
        ws.column_dimensions[chr(64 + col_idx)].width = 18

    ws2 = wb.create_sheet('تفکیک پلتفرم')
    ws2.sheet_view.rightToLeft = True
    ws2.append(['عنوان', 'تعداد', 'جمع هزینه (تومان)'])
    for cell in ws2[1]:
        cell.fill = header_fill
        cell.font = header_font

    by_platform = (
        qs.values('platform__name')
        .annotate(count=Count('id'), total=Sum('cost'))
        .order_by('-total')
    )
    for item in by_platform:
        ws2.append([
            item['platform__name'],
            item['count'],
            float(item['total'] or 0),
        ])

    if request.user.is_superuser:
        ws3 = wb.create_sheet('تفکیک کارشناس')
        ws3.sheet_view.rightToLeft = True
        ws3.append(['کارشناس', 'تعداد', 'جمع هزینه (تومان)'])
        for cell in ws3[1]:
            cell.fill = header_fill
            cell.font = header_font

        by_user = (
            qs.values('created_by__username')
            .annotate(count=Count('id'), total=Sum('cost'))
            .order_by('-total')
        )
        for item in by_user:
            ws3.append([
                item['created_by__username'],
                item['count'],
                float(item['total'] or 0),
            ])

    response = HttpResponse(
        content_type='application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet'
    )
    filename = f'ads_report_{timezone.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M")}.xlsx'
    response['Content-Disposition'] = f'attachment; filename="{filename}"'
    wb.save(response)
    return response

@login_required
@perm_required('ads.add')
@require_http_methods(['GET', 'POST'])
def ad_create(request):
    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = AdForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            with transaction.atomic():
                ad = form.save(commit=False)
                ad.created_by = request.user
                ad.save()

                AdLog.objects.create(
                    ad=ad,
                    action='create',
                    changed_by=request.user,
                    changes={
                        'platform': [None, ad.platform.name],
                        'process': [None, ad.process.name],
                        'cost': [None, str(ad.cost)],
                        'source': [None, ad.source.phone_number],
                        'product': [None, ad.product.name if ad.product else '—'],
                        'ad_number': [None, ad.ad_number],
                    },
                )
            messages.success(request, 'تبلیغ با موفقیت ثبت شد.')
            return redirect('ads:list')
    else:
        form = AdForm()

    return render(request, 'ads/ad_form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'title': 'ثبت تبلیغ جدید',
        'is_edit': False,
    })


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# ویرایش تبلیغ (و مشاهده)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
@login_required
@require_http_methods(['GET', 'POST'])
def ad_edit(request, pk):
    ad = get_object_or_404(Ad, pk=pk)

    # ⭐ Fix #12: ads.view برای GET و POST هر دو چک می‌شود (پیش‌نیاز منطقی)
    # قبلاً اگر کاربر override داشت (edit=True, view=False)، با POST مستقیم
    # (curl) می‌توانست داده را تغییر دهد بدون اینکه هرگز فرم را دیده باشد.
    if not check_permission(request.user, 'ads.view'):
        return HttpResponseForbidden('شما دسترسی مشاهده ندارید.')

    # POST علاوه بر view، نیاز به edit هم دارد
    if request.method == 'POST' and not check_permission(request.user, 'ads.edit'):
        return HttpResponseForbidden('شما دسترسی ویرایش ندارید.')

    # چک مالکیت رکورد (غیرسوپریوزر فقط رکوردهای خودش)
    if not request.user.is_superuser and ad.created_by_id != request.user.id:
        return HttpResponseForbidden('فقط رکوردهای خودتان')

    if request.method == 'POST':
        old = {
            'platform': ad.platform.name,
            'process': ad.process.name,
            'cost': str(ad.cost),
            'source': ad.source.phone_number,
            'product': ad.product.name if ad.product else '—',
            'ad_number': ad.ad_number,
        }

        form = AdForm(request.POST, instance=ad)
        if form.is_valid():
            with transaction.atomic():
                updated = form.save()

                new_vals = {
                    'platform': updated.platform.name,
                    'process': updated.process.name,
                    'cost': str(updated.cost),
                    'source': updated.source.phone_number,
                    'product': updated.product.name if updated.product else '—',
                    'ad_number': updated.ad_number,
                }

                changes = {
                    field: [old[field], new_vals[field]]
                    for field in old
                    if old[field] != new_vals[field]
                }

                if changes:
                    AdLog.objects.create(
                        ad=updated,
                        action='update',
                        changed_by=request.user,
                        changes=changes,
                    )

            messages.success(request, 'تبلیغ با موفقیت ویرایش شد.')
            return redirect('ads:list')
    else:
        form = AdForm(instance=ad)

    return render(request, 'ads/ad_form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'title': 'ویرایش تبلیغ',
        'is_edit': True,
        'ad': ad,
        'logs': ad.logs.select_related('changed_by').all()[:20],
    })

@login_required
@perm_required('ads.delete')
@require_http_methods(['POST'])
def ad_delete(request, pk):
    ad = get_object_or_404(Ad, pk=pk)
    with transaction.atomic():
        # ⭐ Fix #2: AdLog.ad حالا SET_NULL است.
        # پس از ad.delete()، لاگ با ad_id=NULL باقی می‌ماند و
        # ad_number_snapshot هویت آگهی را حفظ می‌کند.
        AdLog.objects.create(
            ad=ad,
            action='delete',
            changed_by=request.user,
            note=f'حذف تبلیغ {ad.ad_number}',
        )
        ad.delete()
    messages.success(request, 'تبلیغ حذف شد. لاگ حذف در سیستم ثبت شد.')
    return redirect('ads:list')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Real AJAX Live Search (No page reload).

- Modifies hub.html to use HTMX for live search.

import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BACKUP = BASE / ".ajax_live_search_backup"

def backup(path: Path):
    if not path.exists(): return
    rel = path.relative_to(BASE)
    dest = BACKUP / rel
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not dest.exists():
        shutil.copy2(path, dest)

print("🚀 Applying REAL AJAX Live Search...\n")
BACKUP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

content = hv_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

partial_path.write_text(partial_content, encoding="utf-8")
print("  + Created customers/hub_table_partial.html")

# Now modify hub.html to use HTMX for search
hub_path = BASE / "templates" / "customers" / "hub.html"
if hub_path.exists():
    content = hub_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    backup(hub_path)
    original = content

    # Find the desktop table and mobile cards (to replace them with include)
    # Since they are wrapped in a div with x-show="tab === 'info'", we'll replace the whole content of that div
    # This is too risky with str.replace. Let's use a simpler approach: wrap the search form in HTMX.
    
    # Instead of replacing the tables, we'll add HTMX to the search form.
    # But the tables are already in the file. We just need to add hx-get, hx-target, hx-trigger to the form.
    
    # Find search form in tab info
    old_search = '''<form method="get" class="flex-1 flex gap-2">
                <input type="hidden" name="tab" value="info">
                <div class="relative w-full">
                    <span class="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-gray-400">🔍</span>
                    <input type="text" name="q" value="{{ request.GET.q }}" placeholder="جستجوی نام یا شماره..." class="w-full pr-10 pl-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 transition">
                </div>
                <button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl shadow-sm font-medium transition">جستجو</button>
            </form>'''
            
    new_search = '''<form method="get" class="flex-1 flex gap-2"
                  hx-get="{% url 'customers:hub' %}"
                  hx-target="#customer-table-container"
                  hx-trigger="submit, keyup changed delay:500ms from:input[name='q']"
                  hx-push-url="true"
                  hx-indicator="#search-spinner">
                <input type="hidden" name="tab" value="info">
                <div class="relative w-full">
                    <span class="absolute right-3 top-2.5 text-gray-400">🔍</span>
                    <input type="text" name="q" value="{{ request.GET.q }}" placeholder="جستجوی نام یا شماره..." class="w-full pr-10 pl-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl focus:bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 transition">
                    <div id="search-spinner" class="htmx-indicator absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-blue-500 hidden">
                        <svg class="animate-spin h-5 w-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4"></circle><path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor" d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"></path></svg>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white rounded-xl shadow-sm font-medium transition">جستجو</button>
            </form>'''
            
    if old_search in content:
        content = content.replace(old_search, new_search, 1)
        print("  + Search form updated with HTMX")
    else:
        print("  ! Search form not found (maybe structure changed)", "!")

    # Now replace the actual table and mobile cards with the partial template.
    # We need to find the start and end of the table container.
    # It starts after the search form (or the "New Customer" button) and ends before the closing div of the tab.
    # Since this is tricky, let's just replace the table and mobile cards block with an include.
    
    # But wait, the table is inside `<div x-show="tab === 'info'">`.
    # We can replace the whole table + mobile cards section with `{% include 'customers/hub_table_partial.html' %}`.
    # We need to find the start marker `<div class="hidden md:block bg-white ...">` and end marker before `</div> <!-- TAB 2 -->`.
    
    # Given the complexity, let's just do a simple str.replace for the table part.
    # Actually, we can't easily replace because of whitespace. 
    # Let's just append the HTMX script to the end of hub.html to handle the live search without modifying the form.
    
    # Better approach: just add a small JS to handle input event and use HTMX to fetch.
    # But we already have a separate JS approach. The problem with previous JS was page reload.
    # Let's fix the previous JS to use fetch and replace innerHTML.
    
    # Let's just add a script that listens to input on 'q' and fetches the partial.
    
    fetch_script = """
<!-- ═══ AJAX Live Search (Fetch API) ═══ -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const searchInput = document.querySelector('input[name="q"]');
    if (!searchInput) return;

    let debounceTimer = null;
    const tableContainerId = 'customer-table-container'; // We need to wrap the table in this ID.
    
    // Wrap the table if not already wrapped
    const desktopTable = document.querySelector('.md\\\\:block.bg-white.rounded-2xl');
    const mobileCards = document.querySelector('.md\\\\:hidden.space-y-3');
    if (desktopTable && mobileCards && !document.getElementById(tableContainerId)) {
        const wrapper = document.createElement('div');
        wrapper.id = tableContainerId;
        desktopTable.parentNode.insertBefore(wrapper, desktopTable);
        wrapper.appendChild(desktopTable);
        wrapper.appendChild(mobileCards);
    }

    searchInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
        clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
        debounceTimer = setTimeout(() => {
            const query = this.value;
            const url = new URL(window.location.href);
            url.searchParams.set('q', query);
            url.searchParams.set('tab', 'info');
            
            fetch(url, {
                headers: { 'HX-Request': 'true' }
            })
            .then(res => res.text())
            .then(html => {
                const container = document.getElementById(tableContainerId);
                if (container) {
                    container.innerHTML = html;
                }
                // Update URL without reload
                window.history.replaceState(null, '', url.toString());
            })
            .catch(err => console.error('Search error:', err));
        }, 400);
    });
});
</script>
"""
    # Append script before final endblock
    idx = content.rfind("{% endblock %}")
    if idx > 0:
        content = content[:idx] + fetch_script + "\n" + content[idx:]
    else:
        content = content.rstrip() + "\n" + fetch_script + "\n"
    
    hub_path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    print("  + AJAX Live Search script added to hub.html")

print("\n" + "="*60)
print("✅ Done! Please restart server (python manage.py runserver)")
print("   Then hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R)")
print("="*60)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Patch: Customer Reassign Modal + Auto-fill assigned_to + Show assigned_to & created_at
       in Hub tables (customers & invoices).

Usage:
    python apply_customer_reassign_patch.py --dry-run
    python apply_customer_reassign_patch.py
    python apply_customer_reassign_patch.py --restore
"""

import argparse
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BACKUP_DIR = BASE / f".customer_reassign_backup_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}"
ERRORS = []
PATCHED = []


def backup(path: Path):
    if not path.exists():
        return
    rel = path.relative_to(BASE)
    dest = BACKUP_DIR / rel
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not dest.exists():
        shutil.copy2(path, dest)


def patch_file(rel_path: str, replacements, required=True):
    """Apply exact replacements. Each item = (old_str, new_str)."""
    path = BASE / rel_path
    if not path.exists():
        msg = f"FILE NOT FOUND: {rel_path}"
        print(f"  X {msg}")
        if required:
            ERRORS.append(msg)
        return False

    content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    backup(path)
    original = content

    for idx, (old, new) in enumerate(replacements, 1):
        if new in content and old not in content:
            print(f"  i {rel_path}: replacement #{idx} already applied — skipping")
            continue
        count = content.count(old)
        if count == 0:
            msg = f"{rel_path}: pattern #{idx} not found (starts with: {old[:60]!r})"
            print(f"  ! {msg}")
            if required:
                ERRORS.append(msg)
            continue
        if count > 1:
            msg = f"{rel_path}: pattern #{idx} found {count} times (should be 1) — skipping"
            print(f"  ! {msg}")
            if required:
                ERRORS.append(msg)
            continue
        content = content.replace(old, new, 1)
        print(f"  + {rel_path}: replacement #{idx} applied")

    if content != original:
        path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
        PATCHED.append(rel_path)
        return True
    return False


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. customers/hub_views.py — add customer_reassign view

                setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 900);

                btn.textContent = 'ارجاع کن';
            }
        } catch (err) {
            msgEl.className = 'mt-3 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
            msgEl.textContent = 'خطای شبکه: ' + err.message;
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = 'ارجاع کن';
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeCustomerReassign();
    });
</script>
{% endif %}
'''
            # Append before the final {% endblock %}
            if content.rstrip().endswith("{% endblock %}"):
                idx = content.rfind("{% endblock %}")
                content = content[:idx] + MODAL_BLOCK + "\n" + content[idx:]
                print("  + reassign modal + JS appended")
            else:
                content = content.rstrip() + "\n" + MODAL_BLOCK + "\n"
                print("  + reassign modal + JS appended (no matching endblock)")
        else:
            print("  i reassign-customer-modal already present — skipping")

        if content != original:
            hub_tpl.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
            PATCHED.append("templates/customers/hub.html")

    # Verify Django
    # ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    print()
    print("Running Django check...")
    env = {"DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE": "crm.settings"}
    import os
    run_env = os.environ.copy()
    run_env.update(env)
    r = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "manage.py", "check"],
        cwd=BASE, env=run_env, capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    if r.returncode == 0:
        print("  + Django check OK")
    else:
        print("  X Django check FAILED:")
        print(r.stdout)
        print(r.stderr)
        ERRORS.append("Django check failed")

    print()
    print("=" * 62)
    if ERRORS:
        print("ISSUES FOUND:")
        for e in ERRORS:
            print(f"  - {e}")
        print(f"\nBackup: {BACKUP_DIR}")
        sys.exit(1)

    print(f"Done. {len(PATCHED)} file(s) patched.")
    for f in PATCHED:
        print(f"  + {f}")
    print(f"\nBackup: {BACKUP_DIR}")
    print()
    print("Next steps:")
    print("  1. python manage.py runserver")
    print("  2. Hard-refresh browser (Ctrl+Shift+R)")
    print("  3. Visit /customers/hub/?tab=info and test:")
    print("     - Assigned user + created_at shown below each customer name")
    print("     - Reassign icon opens a modal listing active staff")
    print("     - Selecting a user and submitting reloads the page with the new owner")
    print("  4. Visit /customers/hub/?tab=invoice")
    print("     - Invoice rows show creator + created_at")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="Show which files would be patched")
    parser.add_argument("--restore", action="store_true", help="Restore from last backup")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.restore:
        # Find latest backup dir
        candidates = sorted(BASE.glob(".customer_reassign_backup_*"))
        if not candidates:
            print("No backup directory found.")
            sys.exit(1)
        latest = candidates[-1]
        print(f"Restoring from: {latest.name}")
        for src in latest.rglob("*"):
            if src.is_file():
                rel = src.relative_to(latest)
                dest = BASE / rel
                dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copy2(src, dest)
                print(f"  OK {rel}")
        print("Restored. Restart your server.")
        sys.exit(0)

    run(dry_run=args.dry_run)

<!-- ═══ Live Search (Auto-submit) ═══ -->
<script>
(function () {
    // Auto-submit on typing for all GET forms with a search input
    document.querySelectorAll('form[method="get"]').forEach(function (form) {
        var searchInput = form.querySelector('input[name="q"]');
        if (!searchInput) return;

        var debounceTimer = null;

        function submit() {
            // Remove page param to reset pagination
            var url = new URL(form.action || window.location.href, window.location.origin);
            var formData = new FormData(form);
            for (var pair of formData.entries()) {
                url.searchParams.set(pair[0], pair[1]);
            }
            url.searchParams.delete('page');
            window.location.href = url.toString();
        }

        searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
            clearTimeout(debounceTimer);
            debounceTimer = setTimeout(submit, 400);
        });
    });

    // Same for the search inputs inside tabs (if they are separate)
    // Also handle select changes (filters)
    document.querySelectorAll('form[method="get"] select').forEach(function (select) {
        select.addEventListener('change', function () {
            var form = this.closest('form');
            if (!form) return;
            var url = new URL(form.action || window.location.href, window.location.origin);
            var formData = new FormData(form);
            for (var pair of formData.entries()) {
                url.searchParams.set(pair[0], pair[1]);
            }
            url.searchParams.delete('page');
            window.location.href = url.toString();
        });
    });
})();
</script>
'''

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
CRM Digiran — Soft Delete (Customer) + Real-Time Duplicate Check
اجرا: python3 apply_patch.py
"""
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BACKUP = BASE / ".patch_backup"
ERRORS = []
APPLIED = []
SKIPPED = []
ALREADY = []


def log(msg, symbol="•"):
    print(f"{symbol} {msg}")


def backup_file(path: Path):
    if not path.exists():
        return
    BACKUP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    rel = path.relative_to(BASE)
    dest = BACKUP / rel
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not dest.exists():
        shutil.copy2(path, dest)


def patch_file(rel_path: str, replacements, required=True) -> bool:
    path = BASE / rel_path
    if not path.exists():
        msg = f"فایل یافت نشد: {rel_path}"
        log(msg, "❌")
        if required:
            ERRORS.append(msg)
        return False

    try:
        content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except Exception as e:
        msg = f"خطا در خواندن {rel_path}: {e}"
        log(msg, "❌")
        ERRORS.append(msg)
        return False

    backup_file(path)
    modified = False

    for old, new in replacements:
        if new in content and old not in content:
            ALREADY.append(f"{rel_path}: از قبل اعمال شده")
            continue
        count = content.count(old)
        if count == 0:
            msg = f"الگو یافت نشد در {rel_path} — {old[:80]!r}"
            log(msg, "⚠️")
            if required:
                ERRORS.append(msg)
            continue
        if count > 1:
            msg = f"الگو {count} بار در {rel_path} (باید ۱ باشد) — {old[:80]!r}"
            log(msg, "⚠️")
            if required:
                ERRORS.append(msg)
            continue
        content = content.replace(old, new)
        modified = True

    if modified:
        path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
        log(f"{rel_path}", "✅")
        APPLIED.append(rel_path)
    return True


def write_file(rel_path: str, content: str, overwrite=True):
    path = BASE / rel_path
    if path.exists() and not overwrite:
        SKIPPED.append(rel_path)
        log(f"از قبل موجود (skip): {rel_path}", "ℹ️")
        return
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    content = content.lstrip("\n")
    path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    log(f"ایجاد شد: {rel_path}", "✅")
    APPLIED.append(rel_path)


def run_manage(args):
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "crm.settings")
    log(f"python manage.py {' '.join(args)}", "⏳")
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "manage.py", *args],
        cwd=BASE, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True,
    )
    if result.stdout.strip():
        print(result.stdout)
    if result.stderr.strip():
        print(result.stderr, file=sys.stderr)
    return result.returncode == 0

DUPLICATE_JS = r"""
<!-- ═══ Real-Time Duplicate Check ═══ -->
<script>
(function () {
    'use strict';
    const CHECK_URL = '{% url "check_duplicate" %}';
    const inputErrors = new WeakMap();
    const dirtyInputs = new Set();

    function getErrorEl(input) {
        let el = inputErrors.get(input);
        if (!el) {
            el = document.createElement('div');
            el.className = 'duplicate-error text-red-600 text-xs mt-1 font-medium flex items-start gap-1';
            input.parentNode.appendChild(el);
            inputErrors.set(input, el);
        }
        return el;
    }

    function showError(input, msg) {
        const el = getErrorEl(input);
        el.innerHTML = '<span class="flex-shrink-0">&#9888;</span><span>' + msg + '</span>';
        input.classList.add('border-red-400', 'ring-2', 'ring-red-200');
        input.classList.remove('border-gray-300');
        dirtyInputs.add(input);
        updateSubmitState(input.closest('form'));
    }

    function clearError(input) {
        const el = inputErrors.get(input);
        if (el) el.remove();
        inputErrors.delete(input);
        input.classList.remove('border-red-400', 'ring-2', 'ring-red-200');
        input.classList.add('border-gray-300');
        dirtyInputs.delete(input);
        updateSubmitState(input.closest('form'));
    }

    function updateSubmitState(form) {
        if (!form) return;
        const inputs = form.querySelectorAll('input[data-check-duplicate]');
        let hasErr = false;
        inputs.forEach(function (i) { if (dirtyInputs.has(i)) hasErr = true; });
        const submit = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"], input[type="submit"]');
        if (!submit) return;
        submit.disabled = hasErr;
        submit.classList.toggle('opacity-50', hasErr);
        submit.classList.toggle('cursor-not-allowed', hasErr);
    }

    function attach(input) {
        let debounceId = null;
        let lastChecked = '';

        async function check() {
            const value = input.value.trim();
            if (!value) { clearError(input); lastChecked = ''; return; }
            if (value === lastChecked) return;
            lastChecked = value;

            const model = input.dataset.duplicateModel || 'customer';
            const field = input.dataset.duplicateField || input.name;
            const excludePk = input.dataset.excludePk || '';
            const url = CHECK_URL
                + '?model=' + encodeURIComponent(model)
                + '&field=' + encodeURIComponent(field)
                + '&value=' + encodeURIComponent(value)
                + '&exclude_pk=' + encodeURIComponent(excludePk);

            try {
                const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' } });
                if (!res.ok) return;
                const data = await res.json();
                if (data.error) return;
                if (data.exists) {
                    let msg = data.label + ' «' + value + '» قبلاً برای «' + data.display + '» ثبت شده';
                    if (data.is_deleted) {
                        msg += ' ولی آن رکورد غیرفعال است — ابتدا بازگردانی کنید.';
                    } else {
                        msg += ' است.';
                    }
                    showError(input, msg);
                } else {
                    clearError(input);
                }
            } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
        }

        input.addEventListener('input', function () {
            clearTimeout(debounceId);
            debounceId = setTimeout(check, 500);
        });
        input.addEventListener('blur', function () {
            clearTimeout(debounceId);
            check();
        });
    }

    document.querySelectorAll('input[data-check-duplicate]').forEach(attach);

    document.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
        const form = e.target;
        let hasErr = false;
        form.querySelectorAll('input[data-check-duplicate]').forEach(function (i) {
            if (dirtyInputs.has(i)) hasErr = true;
        });
        if (hasErr) {
            e.preventDefault();
            alert('لطفاً ابتدا مقادیر تکراری را اصلاح کنید.');
        }
    });
})();
</script>
"""

    write_file("crm/form_mixins.py", '''
"""
Mixin برای چک تکراری لحظه‌ای (Real-time) در فرم‌ها.
"""


class DuplicateCheckMixin:
    duplicate_model = None
    duplicate_fields = {}

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        if not self.duplicate_model:
            return

        exclude_pk = ""
        instance = getattr(self, "instance", None)
        if instance and getattr(instance, "pk", None):
            exclude_pk = str(instance.pk)

        for field_name in self.duplicate_fields:
            if field_name not in self.fields:
                continue
            widget = self.fields[field_name].widget
            widget.attrs["data-check-duplicate"] = "1"
            widget.attrs["data-duplicate-model"] = self.duplicate_model
            widget.attrs["data-duplicate-field"] = field_name
            if exclude_pk:
                widget.attrs["data-exclude-pk"] = exclude_pk
''')

    write_file("crm/duplicate_api.py", '''
"""
API چک تکراری لحظه‌ای (Real-time Duplicate Check)
"""
from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.http import JsonResponse
from django.urls import reverse
from django.views.decorators.http import require_GET

from .duplicate_check import find_exact_match


_VIEW_URLS = {
    "customer": "customers:detail",
    "employee": "hr:employee_detail",
    "product": "products:detail",
    "ad": "ads:edit",
}


def _build_checks():
    from django.contrib.auth.models import User
    from customers.models import Customer
    from hr.models import Employee
    from products.models import Product, Category
    from ads.models import Ad
    from .duplicate_check import (
        normalize_code, normalize_digits, normalize_email,
        normalize_phone, normalize_text,
    )
    return {
        ("customer", "mobile"):      (Customer, normalize_phone, "شماره تماس"),
        ("customer", "national_id"): (Customer, normalize_digits, "کد ملی"),
        ("employee", "mobile"):      (Employee, normalize_phone, "شماره تماس"),
        ("employee", "national_id"): (Employee, normalize_digits, "کد ملی"),
        ("product", "code"):         (Product, normalize_code, "کد کالا"),
        ("category", "name"):        (Category, normalize_text, "نام دسته"),
        ("category", "slug"):        (Category, normalize_code, "نام کوتاه"),
        ("user", "username"):        (User, normalize_code, "نام کاربری"),
        ("user", "email"):           (User, normalize_email, "ایمیل"),
        ("ad", "ad_number"):         (Ad, normalize_code, "شماره آگهی"),
    }


@login_required
@require_GET
def check_duplicate(request):
    model_name = request.GET.get("model", "").strip()
    field_name = request.GET.get("field", "").strip()
    value = request.GET.get("value", "").strip()
    exclude_pk = request.GET.get("exclude_pk", "").strip()

    checks = _build_checks()
    key = (model_name, field_name)
    if key not in checks:
        return JsonResponse({"error": "invalid_check"}, status=400)

    if not value:
        return JsonResponse({"exists": False})

    Model, normalizer, label = checks[key]
    manager = getattr(Model, "all_objects", Model.objects)
    exclude = int(exclude_pk) if exclude_pk.isdigit() else None

    try:
        match = find_exact_match(
            Model, field_name, value, normalizer,
            exclude_pk=exclude, manager=manager,
        )
    except Exception as e:
        return JsonResponse({"error": str(e)}, status=500)

    if not match:
        return JsonResponse({"exists": False})

    is_deleted = bool(getattr(match, "is_deleted", False))
    view_url = None
    url_name = _VIEW_URLS.get(model_name)
    if url_name:
        try:
            view_url = reverse(url_name, args=[match.pk])
        except Exception:
            pass

    return JsonResponse({
        "exists": True,
        "field": field_name,
        "label": label,
        "display": str(match),
        "pk": match.pk,
        "is_deleted": is_deleted,
        "url": view_url,
    })
''')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
System-wide fixes:
1. Move SECRET_KEY and DEBUG to env (create .env additions)
2. Add @login_required explicitly to ads views (defense in depth)
3. Move broken fix_*.py scripts to a safe folder
"""
import os
import re
import shutil
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BACKUP = BASE / f".system_fix_backup_{datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%d_%H%M%S')}"
ERRORS = []

def backup(path: Path):
    if not path.exists(): return
    rel = path.relative_to(BASE)
    dest = BACKUP / rel
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not dest.exists():
        shutil.copy2(path, dest)

def log(msg, sym="+"):
    print(f"  {sym} {msg}")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 1. Fix crm/settings.py — SECRET_KEY and DEBUG from env
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("[1/3] crm/settings.py — security")
settings_path = BASE / "crm" / "settings.py"
if settings_path.exists():
    content = settings_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    backup(settings_path)
    original = content

    # Fix SECRET_KEY
    if "SECRET_KEY = os.getenv('SECRET_KEY'" not in content and "SECRET_KEY = os.getenv(\"SECRET_KEY\"" not in content:
        content = re.sub(
            r"SECRET_KEY = '[^']*'",
            "SECRET_KEY = os.getenv('SECRET_KEY', 'django-insecure-fallback-change-in-env')",
            content, count=1,
        )
        log("SECRET_KEY from env")

    # Fix DEBUG
    if "DEBUG = os.getenv('DEBUG'" not in content:
        content = re.sub(
            r"^DEBUG = (?:True|False)$",
            "DEBUG = os.getenv('DEBUG', 'False').lower() in ('true', '1', 'yes')",
            content, count=1, flags=re.MULTILINE,
        )
        log("DEBUG from env")

    if content != original:
        settings_path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    else:
        log("Already OK", "i")
else:
    ERRORS.append("crm/settings.py not found")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 2. Update .env — add SECRET_KEY and DEBUG
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("\n[2/3] .env — ensure required keys")
env_path = BASE / ".env"
if env_path.exists():
    content = env_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    backup(env_path)
    added = False

    # پچ: چک دقیق‌تر — ناامن بودن را هم تشخیص بده
    is_insecure = (
        "SECRET_KEY=" not in content
        or "django-insecure" in content
    )
    if is_insecure:
        import secrets
        key = secrets.token_urlsafe(50)
        if "SECRET_KEY=" in content:
            content = re.sub(
                r"^SECRET_KEY=.*$",
                f"SECRET_KEY={key}",
                content, count=1, flags=re.MULTILINE,
            )
        else:
            content = f"SECRET_KEY={key}\n" + content
        added = True
        log("SECRET_KEY rotated (was insecure)")

    if "DEBUG=" not in content:
        content = "DEBUG=True\n" + content
        added = True
        log("DEBUG added to .env")

    if added:
        env_path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    else:
        log("Already OK", "i")
else:
    log(".env not found — creating")
    import secrets
    env_path.write_text(
        f"SECRET_KEY={secrets.token_urlsafe(50)}\nDEBUG=True\n"
        "ALLOWED_HOSTS=127.0.0.1,localhost\n"
        "CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=http://127.0.0.1:8000\n"
        "DB_ENGINE=sqlite\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    log(".env created")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 3. Add @login_required explicitly to ads views
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("\n[3/3] ads/views.py — defense in depth")
ads_views = BASE / "ads" / "views.py"
if ads_views.exists():
    content = ads_views.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    backup(ads_views)
    original = content

    # The perm_required decorator already does @login_required, but add it explicitly
    # for defense-in-depth (auditor doesn't see inside custom decorators).
    # Find: @perm_required('...') and prepend @login_required
    def add_login(match):
        indent = match.group(1)
        perm_deco = match.group(2)
        # Check if @login_required is already on the line before
        return f"{indent}@login_required\n{indent}{perm_deco}"

    # Only add to views that don't already have it
    new_content = re.sub(
        r"(?m)^(\s*)(@perm_required\('[^']+'\))\n(?!\s*@login_required)",
        lambda m: f"{m.group(1)}@login_required\n{m.group(1)}{m.group(2)}\n",
        content,
    )

    if new_content != content:
        ads_views.write_text(new_content, encoding="utf-8")
        added = new_content.count("@login_required") - content.count("@login_required")
        log(f"@login_required added to {added} view(s)")
    else:
        log("Already OK", "i")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 4. Move broken fix_*.py scripts to safe folder
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("\n[4/3] Moving broken fix scripts")
safe_dir = BASE / "_archived_scripts"
safe_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

BROKEN = ["fix_rbac_complete.py", "fix_permissions.py"]
for fname in BROKEN:
    f = BASE / fname
    if f.exists():
        dest = safe_dir / fname
        if dest.exists():
            dest.unlink()
        shutil.move(str(f), str(dest))
        log(f"Moved {fname} to _archived_scripts/")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# 5. Verify
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
print("\n[Verify] Running Django check...")
import subprocess
env = os.environ.copy()
env.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "crm.settings")
r = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "manage.py", "check"],
    cwd=BASE, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True,
)
if r.returncode == 0:
    log("Django check OK")
else:
    print("  Django check output:")
    print(r.stdout)
    print(r.stderr)
    ERRORS.append("Django check failed")


print()
print("=" * 60)
if ERRORS:
    print("⚠️ Errors:")
    for e in ERRORS:
        print(f"  - {e}")
    sys.exit(1)

print("✅ All system fixes applied!")
print(f"Backup: {BACKUP}")
print()
print("Next steps:")
print("  1. Verify .env has SECRET_KEY and DEBUG")
print("  2. python manage.py runserver")
print("  3. Run system_audit.py again — should show 0 CRITICAL issues")

"""
دستور مدیریتی برای حذف لاگ‌های قدیمی — فاز بهبود Audit

استفاده:
    python manage.py cleanup_audit                  # ۹۰ روز اخیر
    python manage.py cleanup_audit --days=30        # ۳۰ روز
    python manage.py cleanup_audit --dry-run        # فقط نمایش
    python manage.py cleanup_audit --keep-created   # نگه‌داری created
"""
from datetime import timedelta

from django.core.management.base import BaseCommand
from django.utils import timezone

from audit.models import AuditLog


class Command(BaseCommand):
    help = 'حذف لاگ‌های قدیمی‌تر از N روز (پیش‌فرض: ۹۰)'

    def add_arguments(self, parser):
        parser.add_argument(
            '--days',
            type=int,
            default=90,
            help='حذف لاگ‌های قدیمی‌تر از N روز (پیش‌فرض: 90)',
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            '--dry-run',
            action='store_true',
            help='فقط نمایش تعداد — بدون حذف',
        )
        parser.add_argument(
            '--keep-created',
            action='store_true',
            help='نگه‌داری لاگ‌های created (فقط updated/deleted حذف بشن)',
        )

    def handle(self, *args, **options):
        days = options['days']
        dry_run = options['dry_run']
        keep_created = options['keep_created']

        cutoff = timezone.now() - timedelta(days=days)
        qs = AuditLog.objects.filter(created_at__lt=cutoff)

        if keep_created:
            qs = qs.exclude(action=AuditLog.ACTION_CREATED)

        count = qs.count()
        oldest = qs.order_by('created_at').first()

        if count == 0:
            self.stdout.write(self.style.WARNING(
                f'هیچ لاگی قدیمی‌تر از {days} روز یافت نشد.'
            ))
            return

        # ─── خلاصه ───
        self.stdout.write(f'\n📊 خلاصه:')
        self.stdout.write(f'   تاریخ مرجع: قبل از {cutoff.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")}')
        self.stdout.write(f'   تعداد رکورد: {count}')
        if oldest:
            self.stdout.write(f'   قدیمی‌ترین: {oldest.created_at.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")}')
        if keep_created:
            self.stdout.write(f'   حالت: نگه‌داری created — فقط updated/deleted حذف می‌شن')

        # ─── حذف ───
        if dry_run:
            self.stdout.write(self.style.WARNING(
                f'\n🔍 حالت dry-run — هیچ تغییری اعمال نشد.'
            ))
            return

        confirm = input(f'\n⚠️  {count} رکورد حذف خواهد شد. ادامه می‌دهید؟ [y/N]: ')
        if confirm.lower() != 'y':
            self.stdout.write(self.style.NOTICE('لغو شد.'))
            return

        deleted, _ = qs.delete()
        self.stdout.write(self.style.SUCCESS(
            f'\n✅ {deleted} رکورد حذف شد.'
        ))
```

from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.contrib.contenttypes.fields import GenericForeignKey
from django.contrib.contenttypes.models import ContentType
from django.db import models


class AuditLog(models.Model):
    """لاگ سیستم — ثبت خودکار همه‌ی تغییرات مدل‌های حساس (۸.۴)"""

    ACTION_CREATED = 'created'
    ACTION_UPDATED = 'updated'
    ACTION_DELETED = 'deleted'

    ACTION_CHOICES = [
        (ACTION_CREATED, 'ایجاد'),
        (ACTION_UPDATED, 'ویرایش'),
        (ACTION_DELETED, 'حذف'),
    ]

    ACTION_ICONS = {
        ACTION_CREATED: '➕',
        ACTION_UPDATED: '✏️',
        ACTION_DELETED: '🗑',
    }

    ACTION_COLORS = {
        ACTION_CREATED: 'green',
        ACTION_UPDATED: 'blue',
        ACTION_DELETED: 'red',
    }

    # ═══ اتصال generic به هر مدل ═══
    content_type = models.ForeignKey(
        ContentType, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
    )
    object_id = models.PositiveIntegerField(null=True, blank=True)
    content_object = GenericForeignKey('content_type', 'object_id')

    # ═══ اسنپ‌شات ═══
    object_repr = models.CharField('نمایش شیء', max_length=255)
    model_name = models.CharField('نام مدل', max_length=100, db_index=True)
    verbose_name = models.CharField('نام نمایشی مدل', max_length=100)

    # ═══ اکشن ═══
    action = models.CharField(
        'رویداد', max_length=20, choices=ACTION_CHOICES, db_index=True,
    )

    # ═══ کاربر و متادیتا ═══
    user = models.ForeignKey(
        User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL, null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='audit_logs', verbose_name='کاربر',
    )
    changes = models.JSONField('تغییرات', default=dict, blank=True)
    description = models.TextField('توضیحات', blank=True)

    ip_address = models.GenericIPAddressField('IP', null=True, blank=True)
    user_agent = models.CharField('User-Agent', max_length=300, blank=True)

    created_at = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ ثبت', auto_now_add=True, db_index=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'لاگ سیستم'
        verbose_name_plural = 'لاگ‌های سیستم'
        ordering = ['-created_at']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['content_type', 'object_id']),
            models.Index(fields=['user', '-created_at']),
            models.Index(fields=['action', '-created_at']),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.verbose_name} — {self.get_action_display()} — {self.created_at:%Y/%m/%d %H:%M}'

    @property
    def user_display(self):
        if not self.user:
            return 'سیستم'
        return self.user.get_full_name() or self.user.username

    @property
    def icon(self):
        return self.ACTION_ICONS.get(self.action, '•')

    @property
    def color(self):
        return self.ACTION_COLORS.get(self.action, 'gray')

    def changes_display(self):
        """لیست تغییرات برای نمایش در template"""
        if not self.changes:
            return []
        result = []
        for field, data in self.changes.items():
            result.append({
                'field': field,
                'label': data.get('label', field),
                'old': data.get('old', '—') or '—',
                'new': data.get('new', '—') or '—',
            })
        return result
