```python
import jdatetime
from datetime import datetime
from django import forms
from django.forms import inlineformset_factory
from django.utils import timezone
from customers.models import Customer
from products.models import Product
from .models import Invoice, InvoiceItem


class InvoiceForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """فرم سربرگ فاکتور"""

    # ⭐ تاریخ‌ها به‌عنوان CharField برای تقویم شمسی
    due_date = forms.CharField(
        required=False,
        label='مهلت پرداخت',
        widget=forms.TextInput(attrs={
            'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
            'data-jdp': '',
            'data-jdp-time': 'false',
            'placeholder': '۱۴۰۵/۰۱/۱۵',
            'autocomplete': 'off',
        })
    )

    class Meta:
        model = Invoice
        fields = ['customer', 'status', 'payment_type', 'due_date',
                  'discount', 'tax_percent', 'notes']
        widgets = {
            'customer': forms.Select(attrs={
                'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm'
            }),
            'status': forms.Select(attrs={
                'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm'
            }),
            'payment_type': forms.Select(attrs={
                'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm'
            }),
            'discount': forms.NumberInput(attrs={
                'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
                'placeholder': '۰', 'min': 0, 'dir': 'ltr'
            }),
            'tax_percent': forms.NumberInput(attrs={
                'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
                'placeholder': '۹', 'min': 0, 'max': 100, 'step': '0.01', 'dir': 'ltr'
            }),
            'notes': forms.Textarea(attrs={
                'class': 'w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
                'rows': 3, 'placeholder': 'توضیحات فاکتور'
            }),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)

        
        if self.instance and self.instance.pk and self.instance.due_date:
            j = jdatetime.date.fromgregorian(date=self.instance.due_date)
            self.initial['due_date'] = j.strftime('%Y/%m/%d')

    def _to_en(self, value):
        persian = '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'
        arabic = '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'
        for i, (p, a) in enumerate(zip(persian, arabic)):
            value = value.replace(p, str(i)).replace(a, str(i))
        return value

    
    def clean_due_date(self):
        value = self.cleaned_data.get('due_date')
        if not value:
            return None
        if hasattr(value, 'year'):
            return value

        value = self._to_en(str(value).strip()).replace('-', '/').replace('.', '/')
        if ' ' in value:
            value = value.split(' ', 1)[0]

        try:
            y, m, d = map(int, value.split('/'))
            return jdatetime.date(y, m, d).togregorian()
        except (ValueError, AttributeError):
            raise forms.ValidationError('تاریخ معتبر نیست')


# ═══ فرم قلم فاکتور — پشتیبانی از محصولات soft-deleted ═══
from django.db.models import Q


class InvoiceItemForm(forms.ModelForm):
    """فرم هر قلم فاکتور"""

    class Meta:
        model = InvoiceItem
        fields = ['product', 'quantity', 'unit_price']
        widgets = {
            'product': forms.Select(attrs={
                'class': 'item-product w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
            }),
            'quantity': forms.NumberInput(attrs={
                'class': 'item-qty w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
                'min': 1, 'placeholder': '۱',
            }),
            'unit_price': forms.NumberInput(attrs={
                'class': 'item-price w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm',
                'min': 0, 'placeholder': '۰', 'dir': 'ltr'
            }),
        }

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)

        # اگه این قلم قبلاً ذخیره شده و محصولش soft-deleted شده،
        # محصول فعلی رو توی queryset نگه‌دار تا فرم معتبر بمونه
        if self.instance and self.instance.pk and self.instance.product_id:
            current_id = self.instance.product_id
            self.fields['product'].queryset = Product.all_objects.filter(
                Q(is_deleted=False) | Q(pk=current_id)
            )
        else:
            self.fields['product'].queryset = Product.objects.all()


InvoiceItemFormSet = inlineformset_factory(
    Invoice,
    InvoiceItem,
    form=InvoiceItemForm,
    extra=3,
    can_delete=True,
)
```

```python
from datetime import datetime, time
from django.db import migrations, models
from django.utils import timezone
import django.utils.timezone


def backfill(apps, schema_editor):
    Invoice = apps.get_model('sales', 'Invoice')
    for inv in Invoice.objects.all():
        if inv.issue_date and inv.created_at:
            dt = inv.issue_date
            ct = inv.created_at

            date_part = dt.date() if isinstance(dt, datetime) else dt
            time_part = ct.time() if isinstance(ct, datetime) else time(0, 0)

            combined = datetime.combine(date_part, time_part)
            if timezone.is_naive(combined):
                combined = timezone.make_aware(combined, timezone.get_current_timezone())

            inv.issue_date = combined
            inv.save(update_fields=['issue_date'])


class Migration(migrations.Migration):
    dependencies = [
        ('sales', '0003_alter_invoice_due_date_alter_invoice_issue_date_and_more'),
    ]
    operations = [
        migrations.AlterField(
            model_name='invoice',
            name='issue_date',
            field=models.DateTimeField(
                db_index=True,
                default=django.utils.timezone.now,
                verbose_name='تاریخ صدور',
            ),
        ),
        migrations.RunPython(backfill, migrations.RunPython.noop),
    ]
```

```python
import jdatetime
import time
from django.db import models, transaction, IntegrityError
from django.contrib.auth.models import User
from django.utils import timezone
from customers.models import Customer
from products.models import Product


class Invoice(models.Model):
    """مدل فاکتور — سربرگ فاکتور"""

    STATUS_CHOICES = [
        ('draft', 'پیش‌نویس'),
        ('issued', 'صادر شده'),
        ('paid', 'پرداخت شده'),
        ('cancelled', 'لغو شده'),
    ]

    PAYMENT_TYPE_CHOICES = [
        ('cash', 'نقدی'),
        ('installment', 'اقساطی'),
        ('cheque', 'چکی'),
        ('card', 'کارت به کارت'),
        ('other', 'سایر'),
    ]

    # ═══ شماره و مشتری ═══
    number = models.CharField('شماره فاکتور', max_length=30, unique=True, db_index=True)
    customer = models.ForeignKey(
        Customer, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name='invoices', verbose_name='مشتری'
    )

    # ═══ وضعیت ═══
    status = models.CharField('وضعیت', max_length=20,
                              choices=STATUS_CHOICES, default='draft', db_index=True)
    payment_type = models.CharField('نوع پرداخت', max_length=20,
                                     choices=PAYMENT_TYPE_CHOICES, default='cash')

    # ═══ تاریخ‌ها ═══
    issue_date = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ صدور', default=timezone.now, db_index=True)
    due_date = models.DateField('مهلت پرداخت', null=True, blank=True, db_index=True)

    # ═══ مالیات و تخفیف ═══
    discount = models.DecimalField('تخفیف (تومان)', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0, default=0)
    tax_percent = models.DecimalField('درصد مالیات', max_digits=5, decimal_places=2, default=9)
    tax_amount = models.DecimalField('مبلغ مالیات', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0, default=0)
    subtotal = models.DecimalField('جمع اقلام', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0, default=0)
    total = models.DecimalField('مبلغ نهایی', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0, default=0, db_index=True)

    # ═══ توضیحات ═══
    notes = models.TextField('توضیحات', blank=True, null=True)

    # ═══ مسئول ═══
    created_by = models.ForeignKey(
        User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='created_invoices', verbose_name='ایجادکننده'
    )

    # ═══ زمان‌ها ═══
    created_at = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ ایجاد', auto_now_add=True)
    updated_at = models.DateTimeField('آخرین ویرایش', auto_now=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'فاکتور'
        verbose_name_plural = 'فاکتورها'
        ordering = ['-created_at']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['status', 'issue_date']),
            models.Index(fields=['created_at']),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.number} - {self.customer.name}"

    def calculate_totals(self):
        """محاسبه جمع کل از روی اقلام"""
        items = self.items.all()
        subtotal = sum(item.total_price for item in items)

        self.subtotal = subtotal
        after_discount = subtotal - self.discount
        self.tax_amount = int(after_discount * self.tax_percent / 100)
        self.total = after_discount + self.tax_amount
        return self.total

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        # تولید شماره فاکتور خودکار — با تاریخ شمسی و ضد race condition
        if not self.number:
            max_retries = 5
            for attempt in range(max_retries):
                try:
                    with transaction.atomic():
                        # قفل کردن آخرین رکورد برای محاسبه ID جدید
                        last = Invoice.objects.select_for_update().order_by('-id').first()
                        new_id = (last.id + 1) if last else 1
                        now_j = jdatetime.datetime.now()
                        self.number = f"INV-{now_j.year}{now_j.month:02d}-{new_id:04d}"
                        
                        # ذخیره در دیتابیس
                        super().save(*args, **kwargs)
                    return  # اگر موفق بود، از حلقه خارج شو
                except IntegrityError:
                    if attempt == max_retries - 1:
                        raise  # اگر بعد از ۵ بار باز هم خطا داد، خطا رو بفرست
                    
                    # ریست کردن مقادیر برای تلاش بعدی
                    self.pk = None
                    self.number = None
                    time.sleep(0.1)  # تاخیر خیلی کوتاه تا تراکنش دیگر تمام شود
        else:
            # اگر شماره از قبل وجود دارد، فقط ذخیره کن
            super().save(*args, **kwargs)

    @property
    def status_color(self):
        return {
            'draft': 'gray',
            'issued': 'blue',
            'paid': 'green',
            'cancelled': 'red',
        }.get(self.status, 'gray')

    @property
    def items_count(self):
        return self.items.count()


class InvoiceItem(models.Model):
    """قلم فاکتور — هر خط از فاکتور"""

    invoice = models.ForeignKey(
        Invoice, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='items', verbose_name='فاکتور'
    )
    product = models.ForeignKey(
        Product, on_delete=models.PROTECT,
        related_name='invoice_items', verbose_name='کالا'
    )

    quantity = models.PositiveIntegerField('تعداد', default=1)
    unit_price = models.DecimalField('قیمت واحد', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0, default=0)
    total_price = models.DecimalField('جمع خط', max_digits=15, decimal_places=0, default=0)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'قلم فاکتور'
        verbose_name_plural = 'اقلام فاکتور'

    def __str__(self):
        return f"{self.product.name} × {self.quantity}"

    def save(self, *args, **kwargs):
        # اگه قیمت واحد خالی بود، از قیمت کالا بگیر
        if not self.unit_price:
            self.unit_price = self.product.price

        self.total_price = self.quantity * self.unit_price
        super().save(*args, **kwargs)


class InvoiceLog(models.Model):
    """لاگ تغییرات فاکتور — Audit Trail (۷.۹)"""

    ACTION_CREATED = 'created'
    ACTION_STATUS = 'status'
    ACTION_UPDATED = 'updated'
    ACTION_ITEM_ADDED = 'item_added'
    ACTION_ITEM_CHANGED = 'item_changed'
    ACTION_ITEM_REMOVED = 'item_removed'

    ACTION_CHOICES = [
        (ACTION_CREATED, 'صدور فاکتور'),
        (ACTION_STATUS, 'تغییر وضعیت'),
        (ACTION_UPDATED, 'ویرایش اطلاعات'),
        (ACTION_ITEM_ADDED, 'افزودن قلم'),
        (ACTION_ITEM_CHANGED, 'ویرایش قلم'),
        (ACTION_ITEM_REMOVED, 'حذف قلم'),
    ]

    ACTION_ICONS = {
        ACTION_CREATED: '📄',
        ACTION_STATUS: '🔄',
        ACTION_UPDATED: '✏️',
        ACTION_ITEM_ADDED: '➕',
        ACTION_ITEM_CHANGED: '📝',
        ACTION_ITEM_REMOVED: '➖',
    }

    invoice = models.ForeignKey(
        Invoice, on_delete=models.CASCADE,
        related_name='logs', verbose_name='فاکتور'
    )
    user = models.ForeignKey(
        User, on_delete=models.SET_NULL,
        null=True, blank=True,
        related_name='invoice_logs', verbose_name='کاربر'
    )
    action = models.CharField(
        'رویداد', max_length=20,
        choices=ACTION_CHOICES, db_index=True,
    )
    field_name = models.CharField('نام فیلد', max_length=50, blank=True)
    old_value = models.TextField('مقدار قبلی', blank=True)
    new_value = models.TextField('مقدار جدید', blank=True)
    description = models.TextField('توضیحات')
    created_at = models.DateTimeField('تاریخ ثبت', auto_now_add=True)

    class Meta:
        verbose_name = 'لاگ فاکتور'
        verbose_name_plural = 'لاگ‌های فاکتور'
        ordering = ['-created_at']
        indexes = [
            models.Index(fields=['invoice', '-created_at']),
        ]

    def __str__(self):
        return f'{self.invoice.number} — {self.get_action_display()}'

    @property
    def user_display(self):
        if not self.user:
            return 'سیستم'
        return self.user.get_full_name() or self.user.username

    @property
    def icon(self):
        return self.ACTION_ICONS.get(self.action, '•')
```

```python
from decimal import Decimal
from datetime import date, datetime

from django.db.models.signals import pre_save, post_save, post_delete, pre_delete
from django.dispatch import receiver
from django.utils import timezone

from crm.middleware import get_current_user
from .models import Invoice, InvoiceItem, InvoiceLog


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# محاسبه‌ی مجدد مبالغ (موجود)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def _recalc_invoice_totals(invoice_id):
    """محاسبه‌ی مجدد مبالغ فاکتور — با مقاومت در برابر حذف همزمان"""
    try:
        invoice = Invoice.objects.get(pk=invoice_id)
    except (Invoice.DoesNotExist, TypeError):
        return

    invoice.calculate_totals()
    
    # استفاده از update() به‌جای save() برای جلوگیری از ساخت لاگ‌های یتیم
    Invoice.objects.filter(pk=invoice_id).update(
        subtotal=invoice.subtotal,
        tax_amount=invoice.tax_amount,
        total=invoice.total,
        updated_at=timezone.now()
    )


@receiver(post_save, sender=InvoiceItem)
def recalc_on_item_save(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    _recalc_invoice_totals(instance.invoice_id)


@receiver(post_delete, sender=InvoiceItem)
def recalc_on_item_delete(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    _recalc_invoice_totals(instance.invoice_id)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Audit Trail — ۷.۹
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

TRACKED_INVOICE_FIELDS = {
    'status': 'وضعیت',
    'payment_type': 'نوع پرداخت',
    'discount': 'تخفیف',
    'tax_percent': 'درصد مالیات',
    'due_date': 'مهلت پرداخت',
    'issue_date': 'تاریخ صدور',
}

_INTERNAL_UPDATE_FIELDS = {'subtotal', 'tax_amount', 'total', 'updated_at'}


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# مقایسه‌ی امن مقادیر — type-agnostic
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

def _to_comparable(v):
    if v is None:
        return ''
    if isinstance(v, Decimal):
        return str(v.normalize())
    if isinstance(v, datetime):
        return v.date().isoformat()
    if isinstance(v, date):
        return v.isoformat()
    return str(v)


def _values_equal(a, b):
    return _to_comparable(a) == _to_comparable(b)


def _format_value(field_name, value, instance):
    if value is None or value == '':
        return '—'

    if field_name == 'status' and instance is not None:
        method = getattr(instance, 'get_status_display', None)
        if method:
            return str(method())

    if field_name == 'payment_type' and instance is not None:
        method = getattr(instance, 'get_payment_type_display', None)
        if method:
            return str(method())

    return str(value)


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Invoice: pre_save — گرفتن state قدیمی
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@receiver(pre_save, sender=Invoice)
def capture_old_invoice_state(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    update_fields = kwargs.get('update_fields')

    if update_fields is not None and set(update_fields).issubset(_INTERNAL_UPDATE_FIELDS):
        instance._old_state = None
        return

    if not instance.pk:
        instance._old_state = None
        return

    try:
        instance._old_state = Invoice.objects.get(pk=instance.pk)
    except Invoice.DoesNotExist:
        instance._old_state = None


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Invoice: post_save — ثبت لاگ
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@receiver(post_save, sender=Invoice)
def log_invoice_save(sender, instance, created, **kwargs):
    update_fields = kwargs.get('update_fields')

    if update_fields is not None and set(update_fields).issubset(_INTERNAL_UPDATE_FIELDS):
        return

    user = get_current_user()

    if created:
        InvoiceLog.objects.create(
            invoice=instance,
            user=user,
            action=InvoiceLog.ACTION_CREATED,
            description=f'فاکتور «{instance.number}» صادر شد.',
        )
        return

    old = getattr(instance, '_old_state', None)
    if not old:
        return

    for field, label in TRACKED_INVOICE_FIELDS.items():
        old_val = getattr(old, field, None)
        new_val = getattr(instance, field, None)

        if _values_equal(old_val, new_val):
            continue

        old_display = _format_value(field, old_val, old)
        new_display = _format_value(field, new_val, instance)

        action = (
            InvoiceLog.ACTION_STATUS if field == 'status'
            else InvoiceLog.ACTION_UPDATED
        )

        InvoiceLog.objects.create(
            invoice=instance,
            user=user,
            action=action,
            field_name=field,
            old_value=_to_comparable(old_val),
            new_value=_to_comparable(new_val),
            description=f'{label}: {old_display} → {new_display}',
        )


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# InvoiceItem: pre_save — state قدیمی
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@receiver(pre_save, sender=InvoiceItem)
def capture_old_item_state(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    if not instance.pk:
        instance._old_state = None
        return
    try:
        instance._old_state = InvoiceItem.objects.get(pk=instance.pk)
    except InvoiceItem.DoesNotExist:
        instance._old_state = None


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# InvoiceItem: post_save — ثبت لاگ
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@receiver(post_save, sender=InvoiceItem)
def log_item_save(sender, instance, created, **kwargs):
    user = get_current_user()

    if created:
        InvoiceLog.objects.create(
            invoice=instance.invoice,
            user=user,
            action=InvoiceLog.ACTION_ITEM_ADDED,
            description=(
                f'کالای «{instance.product.name}» × {instance.quantity} افزوده شد.'
            ),
        )
        return

    old = getattr(instance, '_old_state', None)
    if not old:
        return

    changes = []
    if not _values_equal(old.quantity, instance.quantity):
        changes.append(f'تعداد {old.quantity} → {instance.quantity}')
    if not _values_equal(old.unit_price, instance.unit_price):
        old_price = old.unit_price or 0
        changes.append(
            f'قیمت واحد {old_price:,} → {instance.unit_price:,} تومان'
        )

    if not changes:
        return

    InvoiceLog.objects.create(
        invoice=instance.invoice,
        user=user,
        action=InvoiceLog.ACTION_ITEM_CHANGED,
        description=f'قلم «{instance.product.name}» ویرایش شد — ' + '، '.join(changes),
    )


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Invoice & InvoiceItem: مدیریت حذف (اصلاح نهایی)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ⭐ یک متغیر سراسری برای نگه‌داشتن فاکتورهایی که در حال حذف هستند
_DELETING_INVOICES = set()

@receiver(pre_delete, sender=Invoice)
def mark_invoice_deleting(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    """قبل از حذف فاکتور، آیدی آن را در لیست حذف قرار می‌دهیم"""
    _DELETING_INVOICES.add(instance.pk)

@receiver(post_delete, sender=Invoice)
def unmark_invoice_deleting(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    """بعد از حذف فاکتور، آیدی آن را از لیست حذف خارج می‌کنیم"""
    _DELETING_INVOICES.discard(instance.pk)

@receiver(post_delete, sender=InvoiceItem)
def log_item_delete(sender, instance, **kwargs):
    # ⭐ اگر فاکتور مربوطه در حال حذف باشد، اصلاً لاگ نمی‌سازیم
    if instance.invoice_id in _DELETING_INVOICES:
        return

    user = get_current_user()
    
    # چک اضافی برای اطمینان از وجود فاکتور در دیتابیس
    if not Invoice.objects.filter(pk=instance.invoice_id).exists():
        return
        
    InvoiceLog.objects.create(
        invoice_id=instance.invoice_id,
        user=user,
        action=InvoiceLog.ACTION_ITEM_REMOVED,
        description=(
            f'کالای «{instance.product.name}» × {instance.quantity} حذف شد.'
        ),
    )
```

```python
# تست یکپارچگی موجودی انبار (View Integration)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
class InvoiceStockIntegrationTest(TestCase):
    """تست کاهش و افزایش خودکار موجودی انبار هنگام صدور/حذف فاکتور"""

    @classmethod
    def setUpTestData(cls):
        cls.user = User.objects.create_superuser('admin_stock', password='t123456')
        cls.customer = Customer.objects.create(name='مشتری موجودی', mobile='09120000003')
        cls.category = Category.objects.create(name='دسته موجودی', slug='stock-cat')
        cls.product = Product.objects.create(
            name='کالای موجودی', code='STK-001', category=cls.category, price=50000, stock=50
        )

    def setUp(self):
        self.client.force_login(self.user)

    def test_create_invoice_deducts_stock(self):
        """صدور فاکتور با وضعیت 'صادر شده' باید موجودی را کم کند و StockMovement بسازد"""
        url = reverse('sales:create')
        data = {
            'customer': self.customer.pk,
            'status': 'issued',
            'payment_type': 'cash',
            'discount': '0',
            'tax_percent': '9',
            'issue_date': '1405/01/01',
            'items-TOTAL_FORMS': '1',
            'items-INITIAL_FORMS': '0',
            'items-MIN_NUM_FORMS': '0',
            'items-MAX_NUM_FORMS': '1000',
            'items-0-product': self.product.pk,
            'items-0-quantity': '10',
            'items-0-unit_price': '50000',
        }
        response = self.client.post(url, data)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
        
        self.product.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.product.stock, 40)
        
        movement = StockMovement.objects.filter(product=self.product).first()
        self.assertIsNotNone(movement)
        self.assertEqual(movement.quantity, -10)

    def test_delete_issued_invoice_returns_stock(self):
        """حذف فاکتور صادر شده باید موجودی را برگرداند"""
        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer, status='issued')
        InvoiceItem.objects.create(invoice=invoice, product=self.product, quantity=10, unit_price=50000)
        
        self.product.change_stock(-10, 'out', reference_type='invoice')
        self.product.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.product.stock, 40)

        url = reverse('sales:delete', args=[invoice.pk])
        response = self.client.post(url)
        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 302)
        
        self.product.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertEqual(self.product.stock, 50)

class InvoiceLogTest(TestCase):

        cls.category = Category.objects.create(name='د', slug='log-cat')
        cls.product = Product.objects.create(name='کالای لاگ', code='LOG-1', category=cls.category, price=100000)

        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer)
        logs = InvoiceLog.objects.filter(invoice=invoice)
        self.assertEqual(logs.count(), 1)
        self.assertEqual(logs.first().action, InvoiceLog.ACTION_CREATED)

    def test_status_change_log(self):
        invoice = Invoice.objects.create(customer=self.customer, status='draft')
        InvoiceLog.objects.all().delete()
        invoice.status = 'issued'
        invoice.save()
        log = InvoiceLog.objects.filter(invoice=invoice, action=InvoiceLog.ACTION_STATUS).first()
        self.assertIsNotNone(log)
```

```python
DEDUCTING_STATUSES = ('issued', 'paid')


# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# توابع کمکی
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════

def _parse_jalali_date(value):
    """تبدیل تاریخ شمسی به میلادی (۷.۶)"""
    if not value:
        return None
    try:
        persian = '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'
        arabic = '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩'
        for i, (p, a) in enumerate(zip(persian, arabic)):
            value = value.replace(p, str(i)).replace(a, str(i))
        value = value.replace('-', '/').replace('.', '/')
        if ' ' in value:
            value = value.split(' ', 1)[0]
        y, m, d = map(int, value.split('/'))
        return jdatetime.date(y, m, d).togregorian()
    except (ValueError, AttributeError):
        return None


def _get_employee_choices():
    """کاربران فعال برای dropdown فیلتر"""
    return User.objects.filter(
        is_active=True,
        is_staff=True,
    ).order_by('first_name', 'last_name', 'username')


def _products_data():
    """
    لیست کالاهای فعال با نام + کد + قیمت — برای autocomplete (۷.۱۰).
    سبک و cache-friendly.
    """
    return [
        {
            'id': p.pk,
            'name': p.name,
            'code': p.code,
            'price': float(p.price),
        }
        for p in Product.objects.only('id', 'name', 'code', 'price')
    ]


def _apply_invoice_stock(invoice, user):
    """
    کاهش موجودی برای همه‌ی اقلام فاکتور.
    اگر موجودی هر کالایی کافی نباشد ValueError می‌دهد.
    باید داخل یک transaction.atomic صدا زده شود.
    """
    for item in invoice.items.select_related('product'):
        item.product.change_stock(
            -item.quantity,
            movement_type='out',
            user=user,
            reference_type='invoice',
            reference_id=invoice.pk,
            reference_note=invoice.number,
        )


def _reverse_invoice_stock(invoice, user):
    """
    برگرداندن موجودی همه‌ی اقلام فاکتور.
    برای لغو، ویرایش یا حذف فاکتور استفاده می‌شود.
    """
    for item in invoice.items.select_related('product'):
        item.product.change_stock(
            +item.quantity,
            movement_type='cancel',
            user=user,
            reference_type='invoice',
            reference_id=invoice.pk,
            reference_note=f'برگشت {invoice.number}',
        )


# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# فیلترهای پیشرفته (۷.۶)
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════

def _apply_invoice_filters(qs, request):
    """اعمال همه‌ی فیلترها روی queryset فاکتورها — برمی‌گردونه (qs, filters_dict)"""
    search = request.GET.get('q', '').strip()
    if search:
        qs = qs.filter(
            Q(number__icontains=search) |
            Q(customer__name__icontains=search) |
            Q(customer__mobile__icontains=search)
        )

    status = request.GET.get('status', '').strip()
    if status:
        qs = qs.filter(status=status)

    payment_type = request.GET.get('payment_type', '').strip()
    if payment_type:
        qs = qs.filter(payment_type=payment_type)

    employee = request.GET.get('employee', '').strip()
    if employee:
        qs = qs.filter(created_by_id=employee)

    from_date_str = request.GET.get('from_date', '').strip()
    to_date_str = request.GET.get('to_date', '').strip()
    from_date = _parse_jalali_date(from_date_str)
    to_date = _parse_jalali_date(to_date_str)
    if from_date:
        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__date__gte=from_date)
    if to_date:
        qs = qs.filter(issue_date__date__lte=to_date)

    amount_min_str = request.GET.get('amount_min', '').strip()
    amount_max_str = request.GET.get('amount_max', '').strip()
    try:
        if amount_min_str:
            qs = qs.filter(total__gte=int(amount_min_str.replace(',', '')))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        amount_min_str = ''
    try:
        if amount_max_str:
            qs = qs.filter(total__lte=int(amount_max_str.replace(',', '')))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        amount_max_str = ''

    filters = {
        'search': search,
        'current_status': status,
        'current_payment': payment_type,
        'current_employee': employee,
        'from_date': from_date_str,
        'to_date': to_date_str,
        'amount_min': amount_min_str,
        'amount_max': amount_max_str,
    }
    return qs, filters


# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# فهرست و جزئیات
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
@login_required
@require_permission('invoices.view')
def invoice_list(request):
    qs = Invoice.objects.select_related('customer', 'created_by').all()
    qs, filters = _apply_invoice_filters(qs, request)

    all_invoices = Invoice.objects.all()
    stats = {
        'total': all_invoices.count(),
        'draft': all_invoices.filter(status='draft').count(),
        'issued': all_invoices.filter(status='issued').count(),
        'paid': all_invoices.filter(status='paid').count(),
        'total_amount': all_invoices.filter(
            status__in=DEDUCTING_STATUSES
        ).aggregate(s=Sum('total'))['s'] or 0,
    }

    has_filters = any([
        filters['search'], filters['current_status'],
        filters['current_payment'], filters['current_employee'],
        filters['from_date'], filters['to_date'],
        filters['amount_min'], filters['amount_max'],
    ])

    filtered_stats = None
    if has_filters:
        filtered_stats = {
            'count': qs.count(),
            'total': qs.aggregate(s=Sum('total'))['s'] or 0,
        }

    paginator = Paginator(qs, 20)
    page_obj = paginator.get_page(request.GET.get('page', 1))

    context = {
        'page_obj': page_obj,
        'stats': stats,
        'filtered_stats': filtered_stats,
        'has_filters': has_filters,
        'employees': _get_employee_choices(),
        'status_choices': Invoice.STATUS_CHOICES,
        'payment_choices': Invoice.PAYMENT_TYPE_CHOICES,
        **filters,
    }
    return render(request, 'sales/list.html', context)


@login_required
@require_permission('invoices.view')
def invoice_detail(request, pk):
    invoice = get_object_or_404(
        Invoice.objects
        .select_related('customer', 'created_by')
        .prefetch_related('logs__user'),
        pk=pk,
    )
    items = invoice.items.select_related('product')
    return render(request, 'sales/detail.html', {
        'invoice': invoice,
        'items': items,
    })


# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ایجاد فاکتور
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
@login_required
@require_permission('invoices.add')
def invoice_create(request):
    initial = {}
    customer_id = request.GET.get('customer')
    if customer_id:
        initial['customer'] = customer_id

    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = InvoiceForm(request.POST)
        formset = InvoiceItemFormSet(request.POST)

        if form.is_valid() and formset.is_valid():
            try:
                with transaction.atomic():
                    invoice = form.save(commit=False)
                    invoice.created_by = request.user
                    invoice.save()

                    formset.instance = invoice
                    formset.save()

                    if invoice.status in DEDUCTING_STATUSES:
                        _apply_invoice_stock(invoice, request.user)

                messages.success(request, f'فاکتور «{invoice.number}» با موفقیت ثبت شد.')
                return redirect('sales:detail', pk=invoice.pk)
            except ValueError as e:
                messages.error(request, f'خطا در موجودی: {e}')
    else:
        form = InvoiceForm(initial=initial)
        formset = InvoiceItemFormSet()

    return render(request, 'sales/form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'formset': formset,
        'title': 'صدور فاکتور جدید',
        'submit_label': 'صدور فاکتور',
        'products_data': _products_data(),
    })


# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ویرایش فاکتور
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
@login_required
@require_permission('invoices.edit')
def invoice_edit(request, pk):
    invoice = get_object_or_404(Invoice, pk=pk)

    if request.method == 'POST':
        old_status = invoice.status
        form = InvoiceForm(request.POST, instance=invoice)
        formset = InvoiceItemFormSet(request.POST, instance=invoice)

        if form.is_valid() and formset.is_valid():
            try:
                with transaction.atomic():
                    if old_status in DEDUCTING_STATUSES:
                        _reverse_invoice_stock(invoice, request.user)

                    invoice = form.save()
                    formset.save()

                    if invoice.status in DEDUCTING_STATUSES:
                        _apply_invoice_stock(invoice, request.user)

                messages.success(request, 'فاکتور به‌روزرسانی شد.')
                return redirect('sales:detail', pk=invoice.pk)
            except ValueError as e:
                messages.error(request, f'خطا در موجودی: {e}')
    else:
        form = InvoiceForm(instance=invoice)
        formset = InvoiceItemFormSet(instance=invoice)

    return render(request, 'sales/form.html', {
        'form': form,
        'formset': formset,
        'title': f'ویرایش فاکتور {invoice.number}',
        'submit_label': 'ذخیره تغییرات',
        'invoice': invoice,
        'products_data': _products_data(),
    })


# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# حذف فاکتور
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
@login_required
@require_permission('invoices.delete')
def invoice_delete(request, pk):
    invoice = get_object_or_404(Invoice, pk=pk)

    if request.method == 'POST':
        try:
            with transaction.atomic():
                if invoice.status in DEDUCTING_STATUSES:
                    _reverse_invoice_stock(invoice, request.user)

                number = invoice.number
                invoice.delete()

            messages.success(request, f'فاکتور «{number}» حذف شد و موجودی برگشت.')
            return redirect('sales:list')
        except Exception as e:
            messages.error(request, f'خطا در حذف فاکتور: {e}')
            return redirect('sales:detail', pk=pk)

    return render(request, 'sales/confirm_delete.html', {'invoice': invoice})


# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
# چاپ فاکتور
# ═════════════════════════════════════════════════
@login_required
@require_permission('invoices.print')
def invoice_print(request, pk):
    """نسخه چاپی فاکتور"""
    from django.conf import settings

    invoice = get_object_or_404(
        Invoice.objects.select_related('customer', 'created_by'),
        pk=pk
    )
    items = invoice.items.select_related('product')

    context = {
        'invoice': invoice,
        'items': items,
        'company': settings.COMPANY_INFO,
        'print_date': timezone.now(),
    }
    return render(request, 'sales/print.html', context)
```

#### `system_audit.py` _(14,032 bytes, text)_

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
CRM Digiran — System Audit v2
==============================
بازنویسی شده برای رفع false positive ها:
- پوشه‌های بکاپ ignore می‌شوند
- namespace-aware URL check
- دکوراتورهای سفارشی شناخته می‌شوند
- متدهای کلاس view تشخیص داده نمی‌شوند
- خروجی دسته‌بندی شده با severity
"""

import ast
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Ignore lists
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
IGNORE_DIRS = {
    "__pycache__", ".venv", "venv", "env", "ENV",
    ".git", "node_modules", "staticfiles", "media", "logs",
    "_archived_scripts", "migrations",  # migrations are auto-generated
}

IGNORE_PATTERNS = [
    r"^\.",
    r".*\.bak.*",
]

# Decorators that count as permission checks
PERMISSION_DECORATORS = {
    "require_permission", "perm_required", "require_roles",
}

# Views explicitly exempt from permission decorator
EXEMPT_VIEW_NAMES = {
    "my_profile", "edit_my_profile",
    "leave_list", "leave_create",
    "global_search",
}

# Severity buckets
SEVERITY = {"CRITICAL": [], "HIGH": [], "MEDIUM": [], "LOW": []}

def add(severity, msg):
    SEVERITY[severity].append(msg)

def should_skip(path: Path) -> bool:
    for part in path.parts:
        if part in IGNORE_DIRS:
            return True
    for pattern in IGNORE_PATTERNS:
        for part in path.parts:
            if re.match(pattern, part):
                return True
    return False

def iter_py_files():
    for path in BASE.rglob("*.py"):
        if should_skip(path):
            continue
        yield path

def iter_template_files():
    for path in BASE.rglob("*.html"):
        if should_skip(path):
            continue
        yield path


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Check 1: Python syntax
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def check_python_syntax():
    print("🔍 [1/7] Python syntax (AST parse)...")
    for path in iter_py_files():
        try:
            source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            ast.parse(source)
        except SyntaxError as e:
            rel = path.relative_to(BASE)
            add("CRITICAL", f"{rel}:{e.lineno} — SyntaxError: {e.msg}")
        except Exception as e:
            rel = path.relative_to(BASE)
            add("MEDIUM", f"{rel} — read error: {e}")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Check 2: Django system check
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def check_django():
    print("🔍 [2/7] Django system check...")
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "crm.settings")
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "manage.py", "check"],
            cwd=BASE, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60,
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            add("CRITICAL", f"Django check failed: {result.stderr.strip()[:300]}")
    except Exception as e:
        add("HIGH", f"Django check error: {e}")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Check 3: Missing migrations
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def check_migrations():
    print("🔍 [3/7] Missing migrations...")
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "crm.settings")
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "manage.py", "makemigrations", "--check", "--dry-run"],
            cwd=BASE, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60,
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            add("HIGH", f"Uncommitted migrations: {result.stdout.strip()[:300]}")
    except Exception as e:
        add("MEDIUM", f"Migration check error: {e}")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Check 4: URL namespaces (namespace-aware)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def check_urls():
    print("🔍 [4/7] URL configurations...")
    env = os.environ.copy()
    env.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "crm.settings")

    # Let Django itself validate URLs
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-c",
             "import django; django.setup();"
             "from django.urls import get_resolver;"
             "r = get_resolver();"
             "total = len(list(r.reverse_dict.keys()));"
             "print(f'OK:{total}')"],
            cwd=BASE, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60,
        )
        if result.returncode == 0 and result.stdout.startswith("OK:"):
            count = result.stdout.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
            print(f"     Found {count} URL patterns")
        else:
            add("HIGH", f"URL resolver error: {result.stderr.strip()[:300]}")
    except Exception as e:
        add("HIGH", f"URL check error: {e}")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Check 5: View decorators (AST-based, smarter)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def check_view_decorators():
    print("🔍 [5/7] View decorators...")

    for path in iter_py_files():
        if path.name in ("urls.py", "settings.py", "apps.py", "admin.py",
                         "tests.py", "conftest.py", "__init__.py"):
            continue
        try:
            source = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            tree = ast.parse(source)
        except Exception:
            continue

        for node in ast.walk(tree):
            # فقط FunctionDef های top-level (نه متدهای کلاس)
            if not isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef):
                continue

            # skip اگه داخل کلاس هست
            if any(isinstance(p, ast.ClassDef) for p in _walk_parents(tree, node)):
                continue

            # skip اگه اسمش private یا helper هست
            if node.name.startswith("_"):
                continue

            # اگه هیچ پارامتر request نداره، view نیست
            if not _has_request_param(node):
                continue

            # skip اگه exemption list
            if node.name in EXEMPT_VIEW_NAMES:
                continue

            decorator_names = _get_decorator_names(node)

            has_login = "login_required" in decorator_names
            has_perm = any(d in PERMISSION_DECORATORS for d in decorator_names)

            rel = path.relative_to(BASE)

            if not has_login and not has_perm:
                add("HIGH", f"{rel}:{node.lineno} — '{node.name}' has no auth decorator")
            elif has_login and not has_perm:
                # فقط اگه یک view حساس هست (نه helper)
                if node.name not in EXEMPT_VIEW_NAMES and not node.name.startswith("_"):
                    add("LOW", f"{rel}:{node.lineno} — '{node.name}' has @login_required but no permission")


def _has_request_param(node):
    return any(a.arg == "request" for a in node.args.args)


def _get_decorator_names(node):
    names = []
    for dec in node.decorator_list:
        target = dec
        while isinstance(target, ast.Call):
            target = target.func
        if isinstance(target, ast.Name):
            names.append(target.id)
        elif isinstance(target, ast.Attribute):
            names.append(target.attr)
    return names


def _walk_parents(tree, target):
    """شبیه‌سازی parent lookup"""
    parents = []
    for parent in ast.walk(tree):
        for child in ast.iter_child_nodes(parent):
            if child is target:
                parents.append(parent)
    return parents


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Check 6: SECRET_KEY & DEBUG (accurate)
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def check_security_settings():
    print("🔍 [6/7] Settings & security...")

    env_path = BASE / ".env"
    settings_path = BASE / "crm" / "settings.py"

    if not settings_path.exists():
        add("CRITICAL", "crm/settings.py not found")
        return

    # چک SECRET_KEY
    if env_path.exists():
        env_content = env_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
        if re.search(r"SECRET_KEY=django-insecure", env_content):
            add("CRITICAL", "SECRET_KEY in .env is insecure (django-insecure-...)")
        elif "SECRET_KEY=" not in env_content:
            add("CRITICAL", "SECRET_KEY not found in .env")
    else:
        add("CRITICAL", ".env not found")

    # چک DEBUG (فقط اگر production علامت‌گذاری شده)
    env_prod = os.environ.get("DJANGO_ENV", "").lower()
    if env_prod == "production":
        if env_path.exists():
            env_content = env_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
            if re.search(r"^DEBUG=True", env_content, re.MULTILINE):
                add("CRITICAL", "DEBUG=True in production environment")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Check 7: Templates
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def check_templates():
    print("🔍 [7/7] Template syntax...")
    try:
        env = os.environ.copy()
        env.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE", "crm.settings")
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-c",
             "import django; django.setup();"
             "from django.template.loader import get_template;"
             "import pathlib;"
             "base = pathlib.Path('templates');"
             "errs = []\n"
             "for p in base.rglob('*.html'):\n"
             "    rel = str(p.relative_to('templates'))\n"
             "    try:\n"
             "        get_template(rel)\n"
             "    except Exception as e:\n"
             "        errs.append(f'{rel}: {e}')\n"
             "print('ERRS=' + ';;'.join(errs))"],
            cwd=BASE, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120,
        )
        if "ERRS=" in result.stdout:
            err_str = result.stdout.split("ERRS=", 1)[1].strip()
            if err_str:
                for err in err_str.split(";;")[:10]:
                    add("MEDIUM", f"Template error: {err}")
    except Exception as e:
        add("LOW", f"Template check skipped: {e}")


# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Report
# ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
def print_report():
    print()
    print("=" * 62)
    print("                📊 SYSTEM AUDIT REPORT (v2)")
    print("=" * 62)

    total = sum(len(v) for v in SEVERITY.values())

    icons = {"CRITICAL": "🔴", "HIGH": "🟠", "MEDIUM": "🟡", "LOW": "🟢"}
    for sev in ("CRITICAL", "HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"):
        items = SEVERITY[sev]
        if not items:
            continue
        print(f"\n{icons[sev]} {sev} ({len(items)})")
        print("-" * 62)
        for item in items[:30]:  # max 30 per severity
            print(f"  • {item}")
        if len(items) > 30:
            print(f"  ... و {len(items) - 30} مورد دیگر")

    print()
    print(f"📈 Total issues: {total}")

    if total == 0:
        print("\n🎉 هیچ مشکلی یافت نشد!")
        return 0
    elif SEVERITY["CRITICAL"]:
        print("\n⚠️  ابتدا CRITICAL ها را برطرف کنید.")
        return 1
    else:
        print("\n✅ هیچ CRITICAL وجود ندارد.")
        return 0


def main():
    print("🔍 CRM Digiran System Audit v2\n")

    check_python_syntax()
    check_django()
    check_migrations()
    check_urls()
    check_view_decorators()
    check_security_settings()
    check_templates()

    return print_report()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```html
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }

            animation: fadeInUp 0.6s ease-out;
        }
        /* انیمیشن دکمه */
        @keyframes pulseGlow {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4); }
            50% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 12px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0); }
        }
        .pulse-btn:hover {
            animation: pulseGlow 1.5s infinite;
        }
        /* الگوی نقطه‌ای پس‌زمینه */
        .bg-pattern {
            background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: 24px 24px;
        }
        /* لغزش آرام گرادیانت */
        @keyframes gradientShift {
            0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
            50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
        }
        .animated-gradient {
            background: linear-gradient(-45deg, #1e3a8a, #2563eb, #3b82f6, #1e40af);
            background-size: 400% 400%;
            animation: gradientShift 12s ease infinite;
        }
        /* حذف استایل پیش‌فرض input */
        input:focus {
            outline: none;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body class="min-h-screen">

<div class="min-h-screen flex">

    <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════
         سمت راست: بخش برندینگ (فقط دسکتاپ)
         ═══════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="hidden lg:flex lg:w-1/2 animated-gradient relative overflow-hidden">

        <!-- الگوی پس‌زمینه -->
        <div class="absolute inset-0 bg-pattern opacity-40"></div>

        <!-- دایره‌های تزئینی -->
        <div class="absolute -top-32 -right-32 w-96 h-96 bg-blue-400 rounded-full opacity-10 blur-3xl"></div>
        <div class="absolute -bottom-32 -left-32 w-96 h-96 bg-cyan-400 rounded-full opacity-10 blur-3xl"></div>

        <!-- محتوا -->
        <div class="relative z-10 flex flex-col justify-between p-12 text-white w-full">

            <!-- لوگو بالا -->
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-white/15 backdrop-blur-sm rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center border border-white/20">
                    <img src="{% static 'images/logo.gif' %}"
                         alt="دیجیران"
                         class="w-8 h-8 object-contain"
                         onerror="this.onerror=null; this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='block';">
                    <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-white hidden" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M13 10V3L4 14h7v7l9-11h-7z"/>
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <div>
                    <div class="text-lg font-bold">دیجیران</div>
                    <div class="text-xs text-blue-100">CRM System</div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- محتوای وسط -->
            <div class="max-w-md">
                <h2 class="text-4xl font-bold leading-tight mb-4">
                    مدیریت هوشمند
                    <span class="block text-cyan-300">مشتریان و فروش</span>
                </h2>
                <p class="text-blue-100 text-base leading-relaxed mb-8">
                    همه‌چیز در یک پنل. مشتریان، تماس‌ها، فاکتورها، گزارشات — سریع، دقیق، حرفه‌ای.
                </p>

                <!-- ویژگی‌ها -->
                <div class="space-y-3">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-blue-50 text-sm">
                        <div class="w-6 h-6 bg-white/20 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                            <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="3" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"/>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <span>مدیریت کامل مشتریان و لیدها</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-blue-50 text-sm">
                        <div class="w-6 h-6 bg-white/20 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                            <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="3" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"/>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <span>گزارشات لحظه‌ای و نمودارهای تعاملی</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3 text-blue-50 text-sm">
                        <div class="w-6 h-6 bg-white/20 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                            <svg class="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="3" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7"/>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <span>دسترسی سریع از هر دستگاهی</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>

            <!-- پایین -->
            <div class="text-xs text-blue-200">
                © ۱۴۰۵ دیجیران — تمامی حقوق محفوظ است
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════
         سمت چپ: فرم ورود
         ═══════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <div class="w-full lg:w-1/2 flex items-center justify-center p-6 bg-gray-50">

        <div class="w-full max-w-md animate-fade-in">

            <!-- لوگو موبایل -->
            <div class="lg:hidden text-center mb-8">
                <div class="inline-flex items-center justify-center w-16 h-16 bg-blue-600 rounded-2xl mb-3 shadow-lg shadow-blue-200">
                    <img src="{% static 'images/logo.gif' %}"
                         alt="دیجیران"
                         class="w-10 h-10 object-contain"
                         onerror="this.onerror=null; this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='block';">
                    <svg class="w-8 h-8 text-white hidden" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M13 10V3L4 14h7v7l9-11h-7z"/>
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <div class="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800">دیجیران CRM</div>
            </div>

            <!-- عنوان -->
            <div class="mb-8">
                <h1 class="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-2">
                    خوش آمدید 👋
                </h1>
                <p class="text-gray-500 text-sm">
                    برای ورود به پنل مدیریت، اطلاعات خود را وارد کنید
                </p>
            </div>

            <!-- پیام‌ها و خطاها -->
            {% if messages %}
                {% for message in messages %}
                <div class="mb-4 p-4 rounded-xl border flex items-start gap-3 text-sm
                    {% if message.tags == 'error' %}bg-red-50 border-red-200 text-red-700
                    {% elif message.tags == 'warning' %}bg-yellow-50 border-yellow-200 text-yellow-800
                    {% elif message.tags == 'success' %}bg-green-50 border-green-200 text-green-700
                    {% else %}bg-blue-50 border-blue-200 text-blue-700{% endif %}">
                    <svg class="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        {% if message.tags == 'error' %}
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M12 8v4m0 4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"/>
                        {% elif message.tags == 'warning' %}
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z"/>
                        {% elif message.tags == 'success' %}
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"/>
                        {% else %}
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M13 16h-1v-4h-1m1-4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"/>
                        {% endif %}
                    </svg>
                    <div class="leading-relaxed">{{ message }}</div>
                </div>
                {% endfor %}
            {% endif %}

            {% if form.errors %}
            <div class="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700 p-4 rounded-xl mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 text-sm">
                <svg class="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0 mt-0.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                          d="M12 8v4m0 4h.01M21 12a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"/>
                </svg>
                <div>
                    <strong class="block mb-1">ورود ناموفق</strong>
                    نام کاربری یا رمز عبور اشتباه است.
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            <!-- فرم -->
            <form method="post" class="space-y-5">
                {% csrf_token %}

                <!-- نام کاربری -->
                <div>
                    <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">نام کاربری</label>
                    <div class="relative">
                        <div class="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-4 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                            <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-gray-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                      d="M16 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0zM12 14a7 7 0 00-7 7h14a7 7 0 00-7-7z"/>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <input type="text" name="username" required autofocus autocomplete="username"
                               class="w-full pr-12 pl-4 py-3.5 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-gray-800 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-100 transition"
                               placeholder="نام کاربری خود را وارد کنید">
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- رمز عبور -->
                <div x-data="{ show: false }">
                    <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">رمز عبور</label>
                    <div class="relative">
                        <div class="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-4 flex items-center pointer-events-none">
                            <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-gray-400" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                      d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8z"/>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                        <input :type="show ? 'text' : 'password'" name="password" required autocomplete="current-password"
                               class="w-full pr-12 pl-12 py-3.5 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-gray-800 focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-100 transition"
                               placeholder="••••••••">
                        <button type="button" @click="show = !show"
                                class="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-4 flex items-center text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 transition">
                            <svg x-show="!show" class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                      d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"/>
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                      d="M2.458 12C3.732 7.943 7.523 5 12 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.542 7-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7-4.477 0-8.268-2.943-9.542-7z"/>
                            </svg>
                            <svg x-show="show" x-cloak class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                                      d="M13.875 18.825A10.05 10.05 0 0112 19c-4.478 0-8.268-2.943-9.543-7a9.97 9.97 0 011.563-3.029m5.858.908a3 3 0 114.243 4.243M9.878 9.878l4.242 4.242M9.88 9.88l-3.29-3.29m7.532 7.532l3.29 3.29M3 3l3.59 3.59m0 0A9.953 9.953 0 0112 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.543 7a10.025 10.025 0 01-4.132 5.411m0 0L21 21"/>
                            </svg>
                        </button>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <!-- یادآوری و فراموشی -->
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-sm">
                    <label class="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer text-gray-600">
                        <input type="checkbox" class="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 border-gray-300 rounded focus:ring-blue-500">
                        <span>مرا به خاطر بسپار</span>
                    </label>
                    <a href="#" class="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700 font-medium">رمز را فراموش کرده‌اید؟</a>
                </div>

                <!-- دکمه ورود -->
                <button type="submit"
                        class="pulse-btn w-full bg-gradient-to-l from-blue-600 to-blue-500 hover:from-blue-700 hover:to-blue-600 text-white py-3.5 rounded-xl font-medium transition-all shadow-lg shadow-blue-200 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                    <span>ورود به پنل</span>
                    <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M11 16l-4-4m0 0l4-4m-4 4h14"/>
                    </svg>
                </button>
            </form>

            <!-- پشتیبانی -->
            <div class="mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-100 text-center text-sm text-gray-500">
                مشکلی در ورود دارید؟ با
                <a href="#" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline font-medium">پشتیبانی</a>
                تماس بگیرید
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- Alpine.js برای toggle رمز -->
<script defer src="https://unpkg.com/alpinejs@3.x.x/dist/cdn.min.js"></script>

</body>
</html>
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}تغییر رمز عبور{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
    <div class="mb-6">
        <a href="{% url 'hr:my_profile' %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm">← بازگشت به پروفایل</a>
    </div>

    <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-6">تغییر رمز عبور</h1>

    <form method="post" class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        {% csrf_token %}

        {% if form.errors %}
        <div class="bg-red-50 text-red-700 p-4 rounded-lg mb-6 text-sm">
            <strong>لطفاً خطاهای زیر را برطرف کنید:</strong>
            <ul class="mt-2 list-disc list-inside">
                {% for field, errors in form.errors.items %}
                    {% for error in errors %}
                        <li>{{ error }}</li>
                    {% endfor %}
                {% endfor %}
            </ul>
        </div>
        {% endif %}

        <div class="space-y-5">
            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">
                    رمز عبور فعلی <span class="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <input type="password" name="old_password" required
                       class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm" dir="ltr">
                <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">برای امنیت بیشتر، ابتدا رمز فعلی خود را وارد کنید.</p>
            </div>

            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">
                    رمز عبور جدید <span class="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <input type="password" name="new_password1" required
                       class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm" dir="ltr">
                <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">حداقل ۸ کاراکتر، نباید شبیه اطلاعات شخصی یا رمزهای رایج باشد.</p>
            </div>

            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">
                    تکرار رمز عبور جدید <span class="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <input type="password" name="new_password2" required
                       class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm" dir="ltr">
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="flex gap-3 mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-100">
            <button type="submit"
                    class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm font-medium">
                🔐 تغییر رمز عبور
            </button>
            <a href="{% url 'hr:my_profile' %}"
               class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm font-medium">
                انصراف
            </a>
        </div>
    </form>
</div>

{% endblock %}
```

#### `templates/accounts/user_form.html` _(15,319 bytes, text)_

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="mb-6">
    <a href="{% url 'accounts:user_list' %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm">← بازگشت به لیست کاربران</a>
</div>

<h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-6">{{ title }}</h1>

{% if is_self %}
<div class="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 text-blue-800 p-4 rounded-xl mb-6 text-sm">
    <strong>ℹ️ توجه:</strong>
    شما در حال ویرایش حساب کاربری خودتان هستید. امکان غیرفعال کردن یا تغییر نقش از «مدیر کل» وجود ندارد.
</div>
{% endif %}

<form method="post" class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
    {% csrf_token %}

    {% if form.errors %}
    <div class="bg-red-50 text-red-700 p-4 rounded-lg mb-6 text-sm">
        <strong>لطفاً خطاهای زیر را برطرف کنید:</strong>
        <ul class="mt-2 list-disc list-inside">
            {% for field, errors in form.errors.items %}
                {% for error in errors %}
                    <li>{{ field }}: {{ error }}</li>
                {% endfor %}
            {% endfor %}
        </ul>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
        <div class="md:col-span-2">
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">
                نام کاربری <span class="text-red-500">*</span>
            </label>
            {{ form.username }}
            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">با این نام وارد سیستم می‌شود (فقط حروف انگلیسی، اعداد و _ )</p>
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">نام</label>
            {{ form.first_name }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">نام خانوادگی</label>
            {{ form.last_name }}
        </div>

        <div class="md:col-span-2">
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">ایمیل</label>
            {{ form.email }}
        </div>

        {% if is_create %}
        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">
                رمز عبور <span class="text-red-500">*</span>
            </label>
            {{ form.password1 }}
            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">حداقل ۶ کاراکتر</p>
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">
                تکرار رمز عبور <span class="text-red-500">*</span>
            </label>
            {{ form.password2 }}
        </div>
        {% endif %}

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">
                نقش در سیستم <span class="text-red-500">*</span>
            </label>
            {{ form.role }}
            <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1" id="role-help">
                {% if is_self %}
                    نمی‌توانید نقش خودتان را تغییر دهید
                {% else %}
                    تعیین می‌کند کاربر چه دسترسی‌هایی دارد
                {% endif %}
            </p>
        </div>

        <div class="flex items-end pb-3">
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm cursor-pointer
                          {% if is_self %}opacity-50{% endif %}">
                {{ form.is_active }}
                <span>حساب کاربری فعال باشد</span>
            </label>
        </div>
    </div>

    {# ═══════════════════════════════════════ #}
    {# سطوح دسترسی پیشرفته (override) #}
    {# ═══════════════════════════════════════ #}
    {% if not is_create and form.instance.pk and not form.instance.is_superuser %}
    <div class="mt-8 border-t border-gray-100 pt-6">
        <div class="mb-4">
            <h3 class="text-base font-bold text-gray-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                🔐 سطوح دسترسی پیشرفته
            </h3>

{# ═══════════════════════════════════════ #}
{# JS: به‌روزرسانی زنده‌ی وضعیت نقش #}
{# ═══════════════════════════════════════ #}
{% if permissions_map %}{{ permissions_map|json_script:"permissions-data" }}{% endif %}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    const dataEl = document.getElementById('permissions-data');
    const roleSelect = document.querySelector('select[name="role"]');
    if (!dataEl || !roleSelect) return;
    const permissions = JSON.parse(dataEl.textContent);

    const visibleCounter = document.getElementById('perm-visible-count');

    function updateRow(row) {
        const key = row.dataset.permKey;
        const role = roleSelect.value;
        const roles = permissions[key] || [];
        const hasRole = (role === 'admin') || roles.includes(role);
        const roleCell = row.querySelector('[data-role-status-cell]');
        const effCell = row.querySelector('[data-effective-cell]');
        const sel = row.querySelector('select[name^="perm__"]');
        if (roleCell) {
            roleCell.innerHTML = hasRole
                ? '<span class="text-xs text-green-600 font-bold">\u2713 دارد</span>'
                : '<span class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-bold">\u2717 ندارد</span>';
        }
        if (sel && effCell) {
            const v = sel.value;
            const effective = (v === 'allow') ? true : (v === 'deny') ? false : hasRole;
            effCell.innerHTML = effective
                ? '<span class="text-xs text-green-700 font-bold">\u2713 فعال</span>'
                : '<span class="text-xs text-red-500 font-bold">\u2717 غیرفعال</span>';
        }
    }

    function updateAll() {
        document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-perm-key]').forEach(updateRow);
    }

    function updateVisibleCount() {
        if (!visibleCounter) return;
        const all = document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-perm-key]');
        const visible = Array.from(all).filter(function(r) {
            return r.style.display !== 'none';
        });
        visibleCounter.textContent = visible.length + ' از ' + all.length;
    }

    roleSelect.addEventListener('change', updateAll);

    document.querySelectorAll('select[name^="perm__"]').forEach(function(s) {
        s.addEventListener('change', function() {
            updateRow(this.closest('tr'));
        });
    });

    updateAll();
    updateVisibleCount();

    // ═══ Search ═══
    const searchInput = document.getElementById('perm-search');
    if (searchInput) {
        searchInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
            const q = this.value.trim().toLowerCase();
            document.querySelectorAll('tr[data-perm-key]').forEach(function(row) {
                if (!q) { row.style.display = ''; return; }
                const label = (row.cells[0] && row.cells[0].textContent || '').toLowerCase();
                row.style.display = label.includes(q) ? '' : 'none';
            });
            updateVisibleCount();
        });
    }

    // ═══ Reset all ═══
    const resetBtn = document.getElementById('reset-all-btn');
    if (resetBtn) {
        resetBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (!confirm('همه‌ی بازنویسی‌ها به حالت «خودکار» برگردند؟')) return;
            document.querySelectorAll('select[name^="perm__"]').forEach(function(s) {
                s.value = 'inherit';
                updateRow(s.closest('tr'));
            });
        });
    }
});</script>

{% endblock %}
```
