            {% elif call.status == 'missed' %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500"></span>{{ call.get_status_display }}</span>
            {% elif call.status == 'followup' %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700 border border-yellow-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-yellow-500"></span>{{ call.get_status_display }}</span>
            {% else %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border border-gray-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-gray-500"></span>{{ call.get_status_display }}</span>
            {% endif %}
        </header>
        <!-- Hero: Phone -->
        <div class="px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-100">
            <div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 font-semibold mb-1">شماره تماس</div>
            <div class="font-mono text-lg font-bold text-gray-900" dir="ltr">{{ call.call_number }}</div>
        </div>
        <!-- Meta -->
        <div class="px-4 py-2 space-y-1.5">
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs gap-3">
                <span class="text-gray-400">هدف</span>
                <span class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ call.get_purpose_display }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs gap-3">
                <span class="text-gray-400">پیگیری</span>
                {% if call.status == 'followup' and not call.is_followed_up %}
                    <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-medium bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700"><span class="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-yellow-500"></span>در انتظار</span>
                {% elif call.is_followed_up %}
                    <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-medium bg-green-50 text-green-700"><span class="w-1 h-1 rounded-full bg-green-500"></span>انجام شد</span>
                {% else %}<span class="text-gray-300">--</span>{% endif %}
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs gap-3">
                <span class="text-gray-400">کارمند</span>
                <span class="font-medium text-gray-800 truncate">{{ call.called_by.get_full_name|default:call.called_by.username|default:"--" }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs gap-3">
                <span class="text-gray-400">تاریخ</span>
                <span class="font-medium text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ call.call_date|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</span>
            </div>
        </div>
        <!-- Actions -->
        <div class="px-4 py-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex gap-2">
            <a href="{% url 'calls:detail' call.pk %}" class="flex-1 text-center py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-medium active:bg-blue-700 transition">جزئیات</a>
            {% if 'calls.reassign' in user_permissions %}
            <button type="button" onclick="openReassign({{ call.pk }}, '{{ call.caller_name|escapejs }}')"
                    class="flex-1 text-center py-2.5 bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium active:bg-yellow-100 transition">
                ارجاع
            </button>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </article>
    {% empty %}
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 p-8 text-center text-gray-400 text-sm">تماسی یافت نشد</div>
    {% endfor %}
</div>
<!-- ===== MOBILE CARDS END ===== -->


{% if page_obj.has_other_pages %}
<div class="flex justify-center mt-6 gap-2 flex-wrap">
    {% if page_obj.has_previous %}
        <a href="?page={{ page_obj.previous_page_number }}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 text-sm">قبلی</a>
    {% endif %}
    <span class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm">
        صفحه {{ page_obj.number }} از {{ page_obj.paginator.num_pages }}
    </span>
    {% if page_obj.has_next %}
        <a href="?page={{ page_obj.next_page_number }}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 text-sm">بعدی</a>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endif %}

<!-- Reassign modal -->
{% if 'calls.reassign' in user_permissions %}
<div id="reassign-modal"
     class="hidden fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 z-50 items-center justify-center p-4"
     style="display: none;">

    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-md max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">

        <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-5 border-b border-gray-100">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div class="w-9 h-9 bg-yellow-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                    <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M8 7h12m0 0l-4-4m4 4l-4 4m0 6H4m0 0l4 4m-4-4l4-4"/>
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <h3 class="font-bold text-gray-800">ارجاع تماس</h3>
            </div>
            <button onclick="closeReassignModal()" class="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600">
                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/>
                </svg>
            </button>
        </div>

        <form id="reassign-form" onsubmit="submitReassign(event)" class="p-5">
            {% csrf_token %}
            <input type="hidden" id="reassign-call-id" name="call_id">

            <div class="mb-4">
                <p class="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-4">
                    تماس با <strong id="reassign-caller-name" class="text-gray-800"></strong>
                    به کدام کارمند ارجاع شود؟
                </p>

                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                    کارمند جدید <span class="text-red-500">*</span>
                </label>
                <select name="called_by" id="reassign-select" required
                        class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm">
                    <option value="">-- انتخاب کنید --</option>
                    {% for emp in reassign_users %}
                        <option value="{{ emp.id }}">
                            {{ emp.get_full_name|default:emp.username }}
                        </option>
                    {% endfor %}
                </select>
            </div>

            <div id="reassign-message" class="hidden mb-4 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg"></div>

            <div class="flex gap-2">
                <button type="submit" id="reassign-submit-btn"
                        class="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 bg-yellow-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-yellow-600 text-sm font-medium flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                              d="M8 7h12m0 0l-4-4m4 4l-4 4m0 6H4m0 0l4 4m-4-4l4-4"/>
                    </svg>
                    ارجاع کن
                </button>
                <button type="button" onclick="closeReassignModal()"
                        class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm font-medium">
                    انصراف
                </button>
            </div>
        </form>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    function openReassign(callId, callerName) {
        document.getElementById('reassign-call-id').value = callId;
        document.getElementById('reassign-caller-name').textContent = callerName;
        document.getElementById('reassign-select').value = '';

        const msgEl = document.getElementById('reassign-message');
        if (msgEl) msgEl.classList.add('hidden');

        const modal = document.getElementById('reassign-modal');
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeReassignModal() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('reassign-modal');
        if (!modal) return;
        modal.style.display = 'none';
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    async function submitReassign(event) {
        event.preventDefault();

        const callId = document.getElementById('reassign-call-id').value;
        const newUserId = document.getElementById('reassign-select').value;
        const messageEl = document.getElementById('reassign-message');
        const submitBtn = document.getElementById('reassign-submit-btn');

        if (!newUserId) {
            messageEl.className = 'mb-4 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
            messageEl.textContent = 'لطفاً یک کارمند انتخاب کنید';
            messageEl.classList.remove('hidden');
            return;
        }

        submitBtn.disabled = true;
        submitBtn.textContent = 'در حال ارجاع...';

        try {
            const csrfToken = document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]').value;

            const response = await fetch('/calls/' + callId + '/reassign/', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'X-CSRFToken': csrfToken,
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                },
                body: 'called_by=' + encodeURIComponent(newUserId)
            });

            const data = await response.json();

            if (data.success) {
                messageEl.className = 'mb-4 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg bg-green-50 text-green-700';
                messageEl.textContent = data.message;
                messageEl.classList.remove('hidden');

                setTimeout(() => {
                    window.location.reload();
                }, 1000);
            } else {
                messageEl.className = 'mb-4 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
                messageEl.textContent = data.error || 'خطا در ارجاع';
                messageEl.classList.remove('hidden');
                submitBtn.disabled = false;
                submitBtn.textContent = 'تلاش مجدد';
            }
        } catch (error) {
            messageEl.className = 'mb-4 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
            messageEl.textContent = 'خطای شبکه: ' + error.message;
            messageEl.classList.remove('hidden');
            submitBtn.disabled = false;
            submitBtn.textContent = 'تلاش مجدد';
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeReassignModal();
    });

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const modal = document.getElementById('reassign-modal');
        if (modal) {
            modal.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                if (e.target === this) closeReassignModal();
            });
        }
    });
</script>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}

{% block fab %}
{% if 'calls.add' in user_permissions %}
<a href="{% url 'calls:create' %}" class="app-fab" title="تماس جدید" aria-label="تماس جدید">
    <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
    </svg>
</a>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}
```

{% extends 'base.html' %}

                        {% elif call.status == 'missed' %}bg-red-500
                        {% elif call.status == 'followup' %}bg-yellow-500

                <option value="">— انتخاب کنید —</option>
                {% for user in users %}
                    <option value="{{ user.id }}"

                    {% if customer.assigned_to %}
                        {{ customer.assigned_to.get_full_name|default:customer.assigned_to.username }}
                    {% else %}
                        —
                    {% endif %}
                </dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">تاریخ ثبت:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800">{{ customer.created_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">آخرین ویرایش:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800">{{ customer.updated_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</dd>
            </div>
        </dl>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ آخرین تماس‌ها ═══ -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-6">
    <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex justify-between items-center">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-green-100 text-green-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">📞</span>
            آخرین تماس‌ها
            {% if calls_count > 0 %}
                <span class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-normal">({{ calls_count }} تماس)</span>
            {% endif %}
        </h2>
        {% if 'calls.add' in user_permissions %}
        <a href="{% url 'calls:create' %}?customer={{ customer.pk }}"
           class="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline">+ ثبت تماس جدید</a>
        {% endif %}
    </div>

    {% if calls %}
    <table class="w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">تاریخ</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">نوع</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">هدف</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">وضعیت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">کارمند</th>
                <th class="px-6 py-2.5"></th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for call in calls %}
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs text-gray-500" dir="ltr">{{ call.call_date|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs">{{ call.get_call_type_display }}</td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs">{{ call.get_purpose_display }}</td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right">
                    {% if call.status == 'answered' %}
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">{{ call.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% elif call.status == 'followup' %}
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700">{{ call.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% else %}
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">{{ call.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs text-gray-600">
                    {% if call.called_by %}
                        {{ call.called_by.get_full_name|default:call.called_by.username }}
                    {% else %}
                        —
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-left">
                    <a href="{% url 'calls:detail' call.pk %}" class="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline">جزئیات</a>
                </td>
            </tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
    {% else %}
    <div class="text-center py-8 text-gray-400 text-sm">
        هنوز تماسی با این مشتری ثبت نشده
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<!-- ═══ آخرین فاکتورها ═══ -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-6">
    <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex justify-between items-center">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">📄</span>
            آخرین فاکتورها
            {% if invoices_count > 0 %}
                <span class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-normal">({{ invoices_count }} فاکتور)</span>
            {% endif %}
        </h2>
        {% if 'invoices.add' in user_permissions %}
        <a href="{% url 'sales:create' %}?customer={{ customer.pk }}"
           class="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline">+ صدور فاکتور جدید</a>
        {% endif %}
    </div>

    {% if invoices %}
    <table class="w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">شماره</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">تاریخ</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">مبلغ</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">وضعیت</th>
                <th class="px-6 py-2.5"></th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for invoice in invoices %}
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs text-blue-600" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.number }}</td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs text-gray-500" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.issue_date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}</td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right font-bold text-xs" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.total|floatformat:0 }}</td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right">
                    {% if invoice.status == 'paid' %}
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% elif invoice.status == 'issued' %}
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-700">{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% elif invoice.status == 'draft' %}
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% else %}
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-left">
                    <a href="{% url 'sales:detail' invoice.pk %}" class="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline">جزئیات</a>
                </td>
            </tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
    {% else %}
    <div class="text-center py-8 text-gray-400 text-sm">
        هنوز فاکتوری برای این مشتری صادر نشده
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<!-- ═══ یادداشت‌ها ═══ -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-6">
    <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex justify-between items-center">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">📝</span>
            یادداشت‌ها
            <span class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-normal">({{ customer.notes_count }})</span>
        </h2>
    </div>

    <!-- فرم ثبت یادداشت جدید -->
    {% if 'customers.edit' in user_permissions %}
    <div class="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-100">
        <form id="note-form" onsubmit="submitNote(event, {{ customer.pk }})">
            {% csrf_token %}
            <textarea id="note-text" rows="3" required
                      placeholder="یادداشت جدید..."
                      class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm"></textarea>
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between mt-2">
                <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-gray-600 cursor-pointer">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="note-pinned"
                           class="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600 border-gray-300 rounded focus:ring-blue-500">
                    <span>سنجاق کن</span>
                </label>
                <button type="submit" id="note-submit-btn"
                        class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm font-medium">
                    ثبت یادداشت
                </button>
            </div>
            <div id="note-message" class="hidden mt-2 text-sm p-2 rounded-lg"></div>
        </form>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- لیست یادداشت‌ها -->
    {% if notes %}
    <div class="divide-y divide-gray-100" id="notes-list">
        {% for note in notes %}
        <div class="px-6 py-4 hover:bg-gray-50 transition group {% if note.is_pinned %}bg-yellow-50{% endif %}"
             data-note-id="{{ note.pk }}">
            <div class="flex items-start gap-3">
                <div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold flex-shrink-0
                            {% if note.created_by == request.user %}bg-blue-100 text-blue-600
                            {% else %}bg-gray-200 text-gray-600{% endif %}">
                    {{ note.author_name|first|upper }}
                </div>
                <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1 flex-wrap">
                        <span class="font-medium text-gray-800 text-sm">{{ note.author_name }}</span>
                        {% if note.is_pinned %}
                        <span class="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-yellow-200 text-yellow-800">📌 سنجاق</span>
                        {% endif %}
                        <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">{{ note.created_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</span>
                        {% if note.updated_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" != note.created_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" %}
                        <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">(ویرایش‌شده)</span>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                    <p class="text-gray-700 text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{{ note.text }}</p>
                </div>

                {% if note.created_by == request.user or request.user.is_superuser %}
                <div class="flex items-center gap-1 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition">
                    <button type="button" onclick="togglePin({{ note.pk }})"
                            class="text-yellow-600 hover:text-yellow-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-yellow-100"
                            title="{% if note.is_pinned %}لغو سنجاق{% else %}سنجاق{% endif %}">
                        📌
                    </button>
                    <button type="button" onclick="deleteNote({{ note.pk }})"
                            class="text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-red-100"
                            title="حذف">
                        🗑
                    </button>
                </div>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
        {% endfor %}
    </div>
    {% else %}
    <div class="text-center py-8 text-gray-400 text-sm">
        هنوز یادداشتی برای این مشتری ثبت نشده
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- یادداشت قدیمی -->
    {% if customer.notes %}
    <div class="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-100">
        <div class="text-xs text-gray-500 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1">
            <span>📜</span>
            <span>یادداشت قدیمی (قبل از بروزرسانی سیستم):</span>
        </div>
        <p class="text-gray-600 text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{{ customer.notes }}</p>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<!-- JS یادداشت‌ها -->
<script>
const CSRF_TOKEN = '{{ csrf_token }}';
const CUSTOMER_ID = {{ customer.pk }};

async function submitNote(event, customerId) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const textEl = document.getElementById('note-text');
    const pinnedEl = document.getElementById('note-pinned');
    const msgEl = document.getElementById('note-message');
    const btn = document.getElementById('note-submit-btn');

    if (!textEl.value.trim()) return;

    btn.disabled = true;
    btn.textContent = 'در حال ثبت...';

    try {
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        params.append('text', textEl.value);
        if (pinnedEl.checked) params.append('is_pinned', 'on');

        const response = await fetch(`/customers/${customerId}/notes/add/`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN,
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            },
            body: params.toString()
        });

        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.success) {
            window.location.reload();
        } else {
            msgEl.className = 'mt-2 text-sm p-2 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
            msgEl.textContent = data.error || 'خطا در ثبت';
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = 'ثبت یادداشت';
        }
    } catch (error) {
        msgEl.className = 'mt-2 text-sm p-2 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
        msgEl.textContent = 'خطای شبکه: ' + error.message;
        btn.disabled = false;
        btn.textContent = 'ثبت یادداشت';
    }
}

async function togglePin(noteId) {
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`/customers/${CUSTOMER_ID}/notes/${noteId}/pin/`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN,
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
            }
        });
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.success) window.location.reload();
    } catch (error) {
        alert('خطا: ' + error.message);
    }
}

async function deleteNote(noteId) {
    if (!confirm('این یادداشت حذف شود؟')) return;
    try {
        const response = await fetch(`/customers/${CUSTOMER_ID}/notes/${noteId}/delete/`, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'X-CSRFToken': CSRF_TOKEN,
                'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
            }
        });
        const data = await response.json();
        if (data.success) window.location.reload();
    } catch (error) {
        alert('خطا: ' + error.message);
    }
}
</script>

{% endblock %}
```

{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}ورود مشتریان از Excel{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="mb-6">
    <a href="{% url 'customers:hub' %}?tab=info" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm">← بازگشت به لیست</a>
</div>

<h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-6">ورود مشتریان از Excel</h1>

<div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
    <!-- فرم آپلود -->
    <div class="lg:col-span-2 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">📤</span>
            انتخاب فایل
        </h2>

        <form method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data" class="space-y-4">
            {% csrf_token %}

            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                    فایل Excel (xlsx) — حداکثر ۵ مگابایت
                </label>

                       class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:bg-blue-50 file:text-blue-700 file:font-medium hover:file:bg-blue-100 cursor-pointer text-sm">

            <div class="flex gap-3 pt-2 flex-wrap">

                        class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm font-medium">

    <div class="bg-blue-50 rounded-xl p-6 text-sm text-blue-900 h-fit">

            <li>ردیف‌ها را طبق ستون‌ها پر کنید</li>
            <li>فایل را اینجا بارگذاری کنید</li>
            <li>پیش‌نمایش نمایش داده می‌شود</li>

                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 bg-blue-200 rounded text-xs">شماره تماس</span>

        <div class="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-blue-200">
            <div class="font-medium mb-2">نکات مهم:</div>
            <ul class="space-y-1 text-xs leading-relaxed">
                <li>• اعداد فارسی/عربی خودکار تبدیل می‌شوند</li>
                <li>• تاریخ تولد را شمسی وارد کنید</li>
                <li>• ردیف‌های تکراری (موبایل/کد ملی) رد می‌شوند</li>

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}پیش‌نمایش ورود مشتریان{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="mb-6">
    <a href="{% url 'customers:excel_import' %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm">← بارگذاری فایل دیگر</a>
</div>

<h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-6">پیش‌نمایش ورود مشتریان</h1>

<!-- آمار -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-gray-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">کل ردیف‌ها</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ result.total }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-green-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">معتبر (قابل ذخیره)</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600 mt-1">{{ result.valid }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-red-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">نامعتبر (نادیده گرفته می‌شود)</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-red-600 mt-1">{{ result.invalid }}</div>
    </div>
</div>

{% if result.invalid %}
<div class="bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-xl p-4 mb-6 text-sm text-yellow-800 flex items-start gap-3">
    <span class="text-lg">⚠️</span>
    <div>
        ردیف‌های نامعتبر با پس‌زمینه‌ی قرمز مشخص شده‌اند. این ردیف‌ها هنگام ذخیره نادیده گرفته می‌شوند.
        برای رفع خطا، فایل را اصلاح کنید و مجدداً بارگذاری کنید.
    </div>
</div>
{% endif %}

<!-- جدول پیش‌نمایش -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-6">
    <div class="overflow-x-auto">
        <table class="w-full text-sm">
            <thead class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
                <tr class="text-gray-600">
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">#</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">وضعیت</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">نام</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">موبایل</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">ایمیل</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">کد ملی</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">خطاها / هشدارها</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                {% for row in result.rows %}
                <tr class="{% if not row.is_valid %}bg-red-50{% endif %}">
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-gray-500 text-right">{{ row.row_num }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                        {% if row.is_valid %}
                            <span class="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">✓ معتبر</span>
                        {% else %}
                            <span class="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">✗ نامعتبر</span>
                        {% endif %}
                    </td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">{{ row.data.name|default:"—" }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs" dir="ltr">{{ row.data.mobile|default:"—" }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs" dir="ltr">{{ row.data.email|default:"—" }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs" dir="ltr">{{ row.data.national_id|default:"—" }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs">
                        {% if row.errors %}
                            <ul class="text-red-700 space-y-0.5">
                                {% for err in row.errors %}
                                    <li>• {{ err }}</li>
                                {% endfor %}
                            </ul>
                        {% else %}
                            <span class="text-green-600">—</span>
                        {% endif %}
                    </td>
                </tr>
                {% endfor %}
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- دکمه‌ها -->
<form method="post" class="flex gap-3 flex-wrap">
    {% csrf_token %}
    {% if result.valid %}
        <button type="submit" name="action" value="confirm"
                class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700 text-sm font-medium">
            ✓ ذخیره‌ی {{ result.valid }} ردیف معتبر
        </button>
    {% endif %}
    <button type="submit" name="action" value="cancel"
            class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm font-medium">
        انصراف
    </button>
</form>

{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}
{% load widget_tweaks %}

{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="mb-6">
    <a href="{% url 'customers:hub' %}?tab=info" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm">← بازگشت به لیست</a>
</div>

<h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-6">{{ title }}</h1>

<form method="post" x-data="{ source: '{{ form.source.value|default:'website' }}' }" class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
    {% csrf_token %}

    {% if form.errors %}
    <div class="bg-red-50 text-red-700 p-4 rounded-lg mb-6 text-sm">
        <strong>لطفاً خطاهای زیر را برطرف کنید:</strong>
        <ul class="mt-2 list-disc list-inside">
            {% for field, errors in form.errors.items %}
                {% for error in errors %}
                    <li>{{ field }}: {{ error }}</li>
                {% endfor %}
            {% endfor %}
        </ul>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
        <div class="md:col-span-2">
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">نام مشتری <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
            {{ form.name }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">شماره تماس <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
            {{ form.mobile }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">ایمیل</label>
            {{ form.email }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">کد ملی</label>
            {{ form.national_id }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">تاریخ تولد</label>
            {{ form.birth_date }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">وضعیت</label>
            {{ form.status }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">منبع جذب</label>
            {{ form.source|add_class:"w-full"|attr:"x-model:source" }}
        </div>

        <div x-show="source === 'ads'" x-cloak class="md:col-span-2">
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">منبع آگهی <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
            {{ form.ad_source }}
        </div>

        <div class="md:col-span-2">
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">کارمند مسئول</label>
            {{ form.assigned_to }}
        </div>

        <div class="md:col-span-2">
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">آدرس</label>
            {{ form.address }}
        </div>

        <div class="md:col-span-2">
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">یادداشت</label>
            {{ form.notes }}
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="flex gap-3 mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-100">
        <button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm font-medium">
            {{ submit_label }}
        </button>
        <a href="{% url 'customers:hub' %}?tab=info" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm font-medium">
            انصراف
        </a>
    </div>
</form>

{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}
{% load fa_numbers %}

{% block title %}مرکز مشتریان{% endblock %}
{% block mobile_title %}مرکز مشتریان{% endblock %}

{% block content %}
<div x-data="{ 
        tab: new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('tab') || 'info',
        customerType: 'none',
        customerStatus: 'lead',
        mobile: '',
        existingCustomer: null,
        checking: false,
        checkMobile() {
            if(this.mobile.length >= 10) {
                this.checking = true;
                fetch('{% url "customers:hub_check_api" %}?mobile=' + this.mobile)
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(data => {
                        this.existingCustomer = data.exists ? data : null;
                        this.checking = false;
                        if(data.exists) {
                            document.getElementById('hub_call_name').value = data.name;
                        }
                    });
            } else {
                this.existingCustomer = null;
            }
        }
     }" class="w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto pb-10 overflow-x-hidden">
    
    <!-- Premium KPI Cards -->
    <div x-show="tab === 'info'" class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 md:gap-4 mb-6">
        <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 relative overflow-hidden">
            <div class="absolute right-0 top-0 w-1 h-full bg-blue-500"></div>
            <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs font-medium mb-1">کل مشتریان</div>
            <div class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">{{ stats.total_customers|fa_num }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 relative overflow-hidden">
            <div class="absolute right-0 top-0 w-1 h-full bg-purple-500"></div>
            <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs font-medium mb-1">سرنخ‌ها</div>
            <div class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">{{ stats.total_leads|fa_num }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 relative overflow-hidden">
            <div class="absolute right-0 top-0 w-1 h-full bg-orange-500"></div>
            <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs font-medium mb-1">در انتظار پیگیری</div>
            <div class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">{{ stats.pending_followups|fa_num }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 relative overflow-hidden col-span-2 md:col-span-1">
            <div class="absolute right-0 top-0 w-1 h-full bg-emerald-500"></div>
            <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs font-medium mb-1">درآمد وصول شده</div>
            <div class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ stats.recent_revenue|floatformat:0|fa_num }} <span class="text-xs font-normal text-gray-400">تومان</span></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Premium Segmented Tabs (Scrollable on Mobile) -->
    <div class="bg-gray-100/80 p-1.5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200/60 shadow-inner mb-6 w-full overflow-hidden">
        <div class="flex flex-nowrap overflow-x-auto hide-scrollbar gap-2 pt-4 pb-2 px-2">
            <button @click="tab = 'info'; window.history.replaceState(null, '', '?tab=info')" 
                    :class="tab === 'info' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-sm' : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-200/50'"
                    class="flex-shrink-0 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <span class="text-lg opacity-80">👥</span> اطلاعات
            </button>
            <button @click="tab = 'call'; window.history.replaceState(null, '', '?tab=call')" 
                    :class="tab === 'call' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-sm' : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-200/50'"
                    class="flex-shrink-0 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <span class="text-lg opacity-80">📞</span> تماس
            </button>
            <button @click="tab = 'followup'; window.history.replaceState(null, '', '?tab=followup')" 
                    :class="tab === 'followup' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-sm' : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-200/50'"
                    class="flex-shrink-0 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 relative">
                <span class="text-lg opacity-80">⏰</span> پیگیری
                {% if stats.pending_followups > 0 %}
                <span class="absolute -top-1.5 -right-1.5 flex h-[18px] min-w-[18px] px-1 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-red-500 text-[10px] font-bold text-white shadow-sm ring-2 ring-white z-10">{{ stats.pending_followups|fa_num }}</span>
                {% endif %}
            </button>
            <button @click="tab = 'visit'; window.history.replaceState(null, '', '?tab=visit')" 
                    :class="tab === 'visit' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-sm' : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-200/50'"
                    class="flex-shrink-0 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <span class="text-lg opacity-80">🏢</span> مراجعه
            </button>
            <button @click="tab = 'invoice'; window.history.replaceState(null, '', '?tab=invoice')" 
                    :class="tab === 'invoice' ? 'bg-white text-blue-600 shadow-sm' : 'text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-800 hover:bg-gray-200/50'"
                    class="flex-shrink-0 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <span class="text-lg opacity-80">📄</span> فاکتورها
            </button>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- TAB 1: INFO -->
    <div x-show="tab === 'info'" x-transition.opacity class="space-y-4">
        <div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-center gap-3">
            <form method="get" class="w-full md:w-1/2 relative group" hx-get="{% url 'customers:hub' %}" hx-target="#customer-table-container" hx-select="#customer-table-container" hx-swap="outerHTML" hx-trigger="submit, keyup changed delay:500ms from:find input[name='q']" hx-push-url="true" hx-indicator="#search-spinner">
                <input type="hidden" name="tab" value="info">
                <input type="text" name="q" value="{{ request.GET.q }}" placeholder="جستجوی نام یا شماره..." 
                       class="w-full pl-12 pr-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 focus:border-blue-500 transition-all text-sm shadow-sm group-hover:border-gray-300">
                <button type="submit" class="absolute left-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-8 h-8 flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-50 text-gray-400 rounded-lg group-hover:bg-blue-50 group-hover:text-blue-500 transition-colors">
                    <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z"/></svg>
                </button>
            </form>
            {% if 'customers.add' in user_permissions %}
            <a href="{% url 'customers:create' %}" class="w-full md:w-auto px-6 py-3 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-xl shadow-md shadow-blue-200 font-medium flex items-center justify-center gap-2 hover:bg-blue-700 hover:shadow-lg transition-all active:scale-95">
                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/></svg>
                مشتری جدید
            </a>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
        
        <!-- Desktop Table -->
        <div id="customer-table-container" class="hidden md:block bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden">
            <table class="w-full text-sm text-right">
                <thead class="bg-gray-50/50 border-b border-gray-100 text-gray-500 text-xs">
                    <tr>
                        <th class="p-4 font-semibold">مشتری</th>
                        <th class="p-4 font-semibold">شماره تماس</th>
                        <th class="p-4 font-semibold text-center">وضعیت</th>
                        <th class="p-4 font-semibold text-center">نوع</th>
                        <th class="p-4 font-semibold text-left">عملیات</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-50">
                    {% for c in customers %}
                    <tr class="hover:bg-blue-50/30 transition-colors group">
                        <td class="p-4">
                            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                                <div class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500 to-indigo-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm shadow-sm">{{ c.name|first|upper }}</div>
                                <div>
                                    <div class="font-bold text-gray-800">{{ c.name }}</div>
                                    <div class="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                                        مسئول: {% if c.assigned_to %}{{ c.assigned_to.get_full_name|default:c.assigned_to.username }}{% else %}<span class="text-gray-400">بدون مسئول</span>{% endif %}
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5" dir="ltr">{{ c.created_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</div>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </td>
                        <td class="p-4 font-mono text-gray-600 bg-gray-50/50 rounded-lg inline-block mt-2" dir="ltr">{{ c.mobile }}</td>
                        <td class="p-4 text-center">
                            {% if c.status == 'active' %}
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-100">
                                    <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span>{{ c.get_status_display }}
                                </span>
                            {% else %}
                                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 border border-gray-200">
                                    <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-gray-400"></span>{{ c.get_status_display }}
                                </span>
                            {% endif %}
                        </td>
                        <td class="p-4 text-center text-gray-600 text-xs font-medium">{{ c.get_customer_type_display }}</td>
                        <td class="p-4 text-left whitespace-nowrap">
                            <a href="{% url 'customers:detail' c.pk %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-blue-50">جزئیات</a>
                            {% if 'calls.reassign' in user_permissions %}
                            <button type="button" onclick="openCustomerReassign({{ c.pk }}, '{{ c.name|escapejs }}')" class="text-yellow-600 hover:text-yellow-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-yellow-50">ارجاع</button>
                            {% endif %}
                        </td>
                    </tr>
                    {% empty %}
                    <tr><td colspan="5" class="p-12 text-center text-gray-400">مشتری یافت نشد.</td></tr>
                    {% endfor %}
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>

        <!-- Mobile Cards -->
        <div class="md:hidden space-y-3">
            {% for c in customers %}
            <div class="bg-white p-4 rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm relative overflow-hidden">
                <div class="absolute right-0 top-0 w-1 h-full {% if c.status == 'active' %}bg-emerald-500{% else %}bg-gray-300{% endif %}"></div>
                <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                    <div class="font-bold text-gray-800 flex items-center gap-2 pr-2">
                        {{ c.name }}
                        {% if c.is_lead %}<span class="bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold">سرنخ</span>{% endif %}
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                        مسئول: {% if c.assigned_to %}{{ c.assigned_to.get_full_name|default:c.assigned_to.username }}{% else %}—{% endif %}
                    </div>
                    <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400" dir="ltr">{{ c.created_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="font-mono text-gray-600 text-sm mb-3 pr-2" dir="ltr">{{ c.mobile }}</div>
                <div class="flex gap-2 mb-4 pr-2 flex-wrap">
                    <span class="text-[11px] font-medium bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-100">{{ c.get_status_display }}</span>
                    <span class="text-[11px] font-medium bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-100">{{ c.get_customer_type_display }}</span>
                </div>
                <div class="flex gap-2">
                    <a href="{% url 'customers:detail' c.pk %}" class="flex-1 text-center py-2.5 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold active:bg-blue-100 transition">جزئیات</a>
                    {% if 'calls.reassign' in user_permissions %}
                    <button type="button" onclick="openCustomerReassign({{ c.pk }}, '{{ c.name|escapejs }}')" class="flex-1 text-center py-2.5 bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold active:bg-yellow-100 transition">ارجاع</button>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
            {% empty %}
            <div class="bg-white p-8 rounded-2xl text-center text-gray-400 border border-gray-100">مشتری یافت نشد.</div>
            {% endfor %}
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- TAB 2: CALL -->
    <div x-show="tab === 'call'" x-transition.opacity style="display: none;">
        <div class="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 overflow-hidden w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto">
            <div class="bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-indigo-700 p-6 md:p-8 text-white">
                <h2 class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                    <svg class="w-6 h-6 opacity-80" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M3 5a2 2 0 012-2h3.28a1 1 0 01.948.684l1.498 4.493a1 1 0 01-.502 1.21l-2.257 1.13a11.042 11.042 0 005.516 5.516l1.13-2.257a1 1 0 011.21-.502l4.493 1.498a1 1 0 01.684.949V19a2 2 0 01-2 2h-1C9.716 21 3 14.284 3 6V5z"/></svg>
                    ثبت تماس / سرنخ جدید
                </h2>
                <p class="text-blue-100 text-sm mt-2">اطلاعات مکالمه را وارد کنید تا سیستم به‌روزرسانی شود.</p>
            </div>
            
            <form method="post" action="{% url 'customers:hub_submit_call' %}" class="p-4 md:p-8 space-y-5 md:space-y-6">
                {% csrf_token %}
                
                <!-- Smart Phone Check -->
                <div class="bg-gray-50/80 p-4 md:p-5 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200">
                    <label class="block text-sm font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">شماره تماس <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
                    <div class="relative">
                        <input type="text" name="mobile" x-model="mobile" @input.debounce.500ms="checkMobile()" required 
                               class="w-full px-4 py-3 md:py-4 border-2 border-gray-200 rounded-xl focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 text-lg md:text-xl font-mono tracking-widest transition-all bg-white" dir="ltr" placeholder="09123456789">
                        <div x-show="checking" class="absolute left-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-blue-500">
                            <svg class="animate-spin h-5 w-5 md:h-6 md:w-6" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle class="opacity-25" cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="4" fill="none"></circle><path class="opacity-75" fill="currentColor" d="M4 12a8 8 0 018-8V0C5.373 0 0 5.373 0 12h4zm2 5.291A7.962 7.962 0 014 12H0c0 3.042 1.135 5.824 3 7.938l3-2.647z"></path></svg>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div x-show="existingCustomer" x-cloak x-transition class="mt-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-200 p-3 md:p-4 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-3">
                        <span class="text-xl">⚠️</span>
                        <div>
                            <p class="text-sm font-bold text-amber-800">این شماره در سیستم موجود است!</p>
                            <p class="text-xs text-amber-700 mt-1">مشتری: <strong x-text="existingCustomer?.name"></strong></p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:gap-6">
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">نام و نام خانوادگی</label>
                        <input type="text" name="name" id="hub_call_name" class="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl focus:bg-white focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 focus:border-blue-500 transition-all">
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">نوع تماس</label>
                        {{ call_form.call_type }}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">منبع تماس</label>
                        <select name="source" class="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl focus:bg-white focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 focus:border-blue-500 transition-all">
                            {% for src in call_form.source.field.queryset %}
                            <option value="{{ src.id }}">{{ src.label|default:src.phone_number }}</option>
                            {% endfor %}
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                        <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">نوع مشتری</label>
                        <select name="customer_type" x-model="customerType" class="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl focus:bg-white focus:ring-4 focus:ring-blue-500/10 focus:border-blue-500 transition-all">
                            <option value="none">فاقد شرایط</option>
                            <option value="cash">نقدی</option>
                            <option value="cheque">چک</option>
                            <option value="installment">قسطی</option>
                        </select>
                    </div>
                    
                    <div x-show="customerType === 'installment'" x-transition x-cloak class="md:col-span-2 bg-indigo-50/50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center gap-2 md:gap-4">
                        <label class="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-800 whitespace-nowrap">تعداد اقساط:</label>
                        <input type="number" name="installments_count" min="1" class="w-full md:flex-1 px-4 py-2 border border-indigo-200 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 bg-white" placeholder="مثلاً 12">
                    </div>
                    <div x-show="customerType === 'cheque'" x-transition x-cloak class="md:col-span-2 bg-indigo-50/50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center gap-2 md:gap-4">
                        <label class="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-800 whitespace-nowrap">تعداد چک:</label>

            <div class="md:hidden divide-y divide-gray-100">

                    <div class="flex justify-between items-center mt-1">
                        <div class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900" dir="ltr">{{ inv.total|floatformat:0 }} <span class="text-xs font-normal text-gray-500">تومان</span></div>
                        <a href="{% url 'sales:detail' inv.pk %}" class="text-sm text-blue-600 font-bold">جزئیات ←</a>

                </div>
                {% empty %}

                {% endfor %}
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ Customer Reassign Modal ═══ -->
{% if 'customers.edit' in user_permissions %}
<div id="reassign-customer-modal"
     class="hidden fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 items-center justify-center p-4"
     style="display:none;">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl w-full max-w-md max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between p-5 border-b border-gray-100">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div class="w-9 h-9 bg-yellow-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                    <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M8 7h12m0 0l-4-4m4 4l-4 4m0 6H4m0 0l4 4m-4-4l4-4"/>
                    </svg>
                </div>
                <h3 class="font-bold text-gray-800">ارجاع مشتری</h3>
            </div>
            <button type="button" onclick="closeCustomerReassign()" class="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600">
                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12"/>
                </svg>
            </button>
        </div>

        <form id="reassign-customer-form" onsubmit="submitCustomerReassign(event)" class="p-5">
            {% csrf_token %}
            <input type="hidden" id="reassign-customer-id">

            <p class="text-sm text-gray-600 mb-4">
                مشتری <strong id="reassign-customer-name" class="text-gray-800"></strong>
                به کدام کارمند ارجاع شود؟
            </p>

            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                کارمند جدید <span class="text-red-500">*</span>
            </label>
            <select name="assigned_to" id="reassign-customer-select" required
                    class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm">
                <option value="">-- انتخاب کنید --</option>
                {% for emp in reassign_users %}
                    <option value="{{ emp.id }}">{{ emp.get_full_name|default:emp.username }}</option>
                {% endfor %}
            </select>

            <div id="reassign-customer-message" class="hidden mt-3 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg"></div>

            <div class="flex gap-2 mt-5">
                <button type="submit" id="reassign-customer-submit"
                        class="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 bg-yellow-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-yellow-600 text-sm font-medium">
                    ارجاع کن
                </button>
                <button type="button" onclick="closeCustomerReassign()"
                        class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm font-medium">
                    انصراف
                </button>
            </div>
        </form>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    function openCustomerReassign(customerId, customerName) {
        document.getElementById('reassign-customer-id').value = customerId;
        document.getElementById('reassign-customer-name').textContent = customerName;
        document.getElementById('reassign-customer-select').value = '';
        var msg = document.getElementById('reassign-customer-message');
        msg.className = 'hidden mt-3 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg';
        msg.textContent = '';
        var modal = document.getElementById('reassign-customer-modal');
        modal.style.display = 'flex';
        modal.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    function closeCustomerReassign() {
        var modal = document.getElementById('reassign-customer-modal');
        if (!modal) return;
        modal.style.display = 'none';
        modal.classList.add('hidden');
    }

    async function submitCustomerReassign(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        var customerId = document.getElementById('reassign-customer-id').value;
        var userId = document.getElementById('reassign-customer-select').value;
        var msgEl = document.getElementById('reassign-customer-message');
        var btn = document.getElementById('reassign-customer-submit');

        if (!userId) {
            msgEl.className = 'mt-3 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
            msgEl.textContent = 'لطفاً یک کارمند انتخاب کنید';
            return;
        }

        btn.disabled = true;
        btn.textContent = 'در حال ارجاع...';

        try {
            var res = await fetch('/customers/' + customerId + '/reassign/', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {
                    'X-CSRFToken': document.querySelector('[name=csrfmiddlewaretoken]').value,
                    'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
                    'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                },
                body: 'assigned_to=' + encodeURIComponent(userId)
            });
            var data = await res.json();
            if (data.success) {
                msgEl.className = 'mt-3 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg bg-green-50 text-green-700';
                msgEl.textContent = data.message;
                setTimeout(function() { window.location.reload(); }, 900);
            } else {
                msgEl.className = 'mt-3 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
                msgEl.textContent = data.error || 'خطا در ارجاع';
                btn.disabled = false;
                btn.textContent = 'ارجاع کن';
            }
        } catch (err) {
            msgEl.className = 'mt-3 text-sm p-3 rounded-lg bg-red-50 text-red-700';
            msgEl.textContent = 'خطای شبکه: ' + err.message;
            btn.disabled = false;
            btn.textContent = 'ارجاع کن';
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') closeCustomerReassign();
    });
</script>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}
```

                                <div class="font-bold text-gray-800 group-hover:text-blue-600 transition">{{ c.name }}</div>

                                    مسئول: {% if c.assigned_to %}{{ c.assigned_to.get_full_name|default:c.assigned_to.username }}{% else %}<span class="text-gray-400">بدون مسئول</span>{% endif %}
                                </div>
                                <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5" dir="ltr">{{ c.created_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="p-4 text-right font-mono text-gray-600" dir="ltr">{{ c.mobile }}</td>
                    <td class="p-4 text-center">
                        {% if c.status == 'active' %}
                            <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-green-50 text-green-700 border border-green-100"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-green-500"></span>{{ c.get_status_display }}</span>
                        {% else %}
                            <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 border border-gray-200"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-gray-400"></span>{{ c.get_status_display }}</span>
                        {% endif %}
                    </td>
                    <td class="p-4 text-center text-gray-600 text-xs">{{ c.get_customer_type_display }}</td>
                    <td class="p-4 text-center">
                        {% if c.is_lead %}
                            <span class="bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 px-2 py-1 rounded-md text-[11px] font-bold">سرنخ</span>
                        {% else %}
                            <span class="text-gray-300">-</span>
                        {% endif %}
                    </td>
                    <td class="p-4 text-left">
                        <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                            <a href="{% url 'customers:detail' c.pk %}" class="text-xs px-3 py-1.5 bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-100 transition">
                                جزئیات
                            </a>
                            {% if 'customers.edit' in user_permissions %}
                            <button type="button" onclick="openCustomerReassign({{ c.pk }}, '{{ c.name|escapejs }}')"
                                    class="text-xs px-3 py-1.5 bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-600 rounded-lg hover:bg-yellow-100 transition">
                                ارجاع
                            </button>
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
                {% empty %}
                <tr><td colspan="6" class="p-12 text-center text-gray-400">هیچ مشتری یافت نشد.</td></tr>
                {% endfor %}
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>

    <!-- Mobile Cards -->
    <div class="md:hidden space-y-3">
        {% for c in customers %}
        <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-4 shadow-sm border border-gray-100 relative overflow-hidden">
            <div class="absolute top-0 right-0 w-1 h-full {% if c.status == 'active' %}bg-green-500{% else %}bg-gray-300{% endif %}"></div>
            <div class="flex justify-between items-start mb-2">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <div class="font-bold text-gray-800">{{ c.name }}</div>
                    {% if c.is_lead %}<span class="bg-purple-100 text-purple-700 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold">سرنخ</span>{% endif %}
                </div>
                <span class="text-[10px] text-gray-400">{{ c.created_at|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                مسئول: {% if c.assigned_to %}{{ c.assigned_to.get_full_name|default:c.assigned_to.username }}{% else %}—{% endif %}
            </div>
            <div class="font-mono text-gray-600 text-sm mb-3 mt-2" dir="ltr">{{ c.mobile }}</div>
            <div class="flex gap-2 mb-4">
                <span class="text-xs bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 px-2 py-1 rounded-md border border-gray-100">{{ c.get_status_display }}</span>
                <span class="text-xs bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 px-2 py-1 rounded-md border border-gray-100">{{ c.get_customer_type_display }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="flex gap-2">
                <a href="{% url 'customers:detail' c.pk %}" class="flex-1 text-center py-2.5 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold active:bg-blue-100 transition">جزئیات</a>
                {% if 'customers.edit' in user_permissions %}
                <button type="button" onclick="openCustomerReassign({{ c.pk }}, '{{ c.name|escapejs }}')" class="flex-1 text-center py-2.5 bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700 rounded-xl text-sm font-bold active:bg-yellow-100 transition">ارجاع</button>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
        {% empty %}
        <div class="bg-white p-8 rounded-2xl text-center text-gray-400 border border-gray-100">مشتری یافت نشد.</div>
        {% endfor %}
    </div>
</div>
```

{% extends 'base.html' %}
{% load fa_numbers %}
{% block title %}مشتریان غیرفعال{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
    <div>
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">مشتریان غیرفعال</h1>
        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
            مشتریانی که غیرفعال شده‌اند — قابل بازگردانی ({{ total_inactive }} مورد)
        </p>
    </div>
    <a href="{% url 'customers:hub' %}?tab=info"
       class="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm">
        ← بازگشت به لیست فعال
    </a>
</div>

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm mb-6">
    <form method="get" class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center">
        <div class="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
            <input type="text" name="q" value="{{ search }}"
                   placeholder="جستجو نام، موبایل، ایمیل یا کد ملی..."
                   class="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm">
        </div>
        <button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-blue-700">
            جستجو
        </button>
        {% if search %}
        <a href="{% url 'customers:inactive_list' %}" class="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700">پاک کردن</a>
        {% endif %}
    </form>
</div>

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">مشتری</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">شماره تماس</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">تاریخ غیرفعال‌سازی</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">کارمند مسئول</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">عملیات</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for customer in page_obj %}
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition opacity-75">
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div class="w-9 h-9 bg-red-100 text-red-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold flex-shrink-0">
                            {{ customer.name|first|upper }}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div class="font-medium text-gray-800 line-through">{{ customer.name }}</div>
                            {% if customer.email %}
                            <div class="text-xs text-gray-400" dir="ltr">{{ customer.email }}</div>
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600 font-mono"><span dir="ltr">{{ customer.mobile }}</span></td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs text-gray-500">
                    {% if customer.deleted_at %}{{ customer.deleted_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}{% else %}—{% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs">
                    {% if customer.assigned_to %}
                        {{ customer.assigned_to.get_full_name|default:customer.assigned_to.username }}
                    {% else %}—{% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <a href="{% url 'customers:restore' customer.pk %}"
                       class="px-3 py-1.5 bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700 text-xs font-medium inline-block">
                        ♻️ بازگردانی
                    </a>
                </td>
            </tr>
            {% empty %}
            <tr><td colspan="5" class="text-center py-12 text-gray-400">مشتری غیرفعالی وجود ندارد</td></tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

{% if page_obj.has_other_pages %}
<div class="flex justify-center mt-6 gap-2">
    {% if page_obj.has_previous %}<a href="?page={{ page_obj.previous_page_number }}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">قبلی</a>{% endif %}
    <span class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm">صفحه {{ page_obj.number }} از {{ page_obj.paginator.num_pages }}</span>
    {% if page_obj.has_next %}<a href="?page={{ page_obj.next_page_number }}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">بعدی</a>{% endif %}
</div>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}
```

{% extends 'base.html' %}
{% load query_helpers %}
{% load fa_numbers %}
{% block title %}مشتریان{% endblock %}
{% block mobile_title %}مشتریان{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<!-- Header -->

            <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">

        </a>

    {% endif %}
</div>

<!-- Stat cards -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm flex items-center gap-4">
        <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-blue-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
            <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-blue-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                      d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"/>
            </svg>
        </div>
        <div>
            <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">کل مشتریان</div>
            <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">{{ total }}</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm flex items-center gap-4">
        <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-red-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
            <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-red-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                      d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z"/>
            </svg>
        </div>
        <div>
