```html
            <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">{{ leads }}</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm flex items-center gap-4">
        <div class="w-12 h-12 bg-green-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
            <svg class="w-6 h-6 text-green-500" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                      d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z"/>
            </svg>
        </div>
        <div>
            <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">مشتریان فعال</div>
            <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">{{ actives }}</div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

{% if 'customers.delete' in user_permissions and inactive_count > 0 %}
<div class="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-xl p-4 mb-6 flex items-center justify-between">
    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
        <div class="w-10 h-10 bg-red-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
            <span class="text-red-600 text-xl">&#128465;</span>
        </div>
        <div>
            <div class="font-bold text-red-800 text-sm">مشتریان غیرفعال</div>
            <div class="text-xs text-red-600">{{ inactive_count }} مشتری غیرفعال شده‌اند</div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <a href="{% url 'customers:inactive_list' %}" class="text-xs px-4 py-2 bg-red-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-700 font-medium">
        مشاهده و بازگردانی
    </a>
</div>
{% endif %}

<!-- Filters -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm mb-6">
    <form method="get" class="space-y-3">
        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row flex-wrap gap-3 sm:items-center">
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
                <input type="text" name="q" value="{{ search }}"
                       placeholder="جستجو نام، موبایل، ایمیل یا کد ملی..."
                       class="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm">
            </div>

            <select name="status" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
                <option value="">همه وضعیت‌ها</option>
                {% for value, label in status_choices %}
                    <option value="{{ value }}" {% if current_status == value %}selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>
                {% endfor %}
            </select>

            <select name="source" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
                <option value="">همه منابع</option>
                {% for value, label in source_choices %}
                    <option value="{{ value }}" {% if current_source == value %}selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>
                {% endfor %}
            </select>

            <select name="employee" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
                <option value="">همه کارمندان</option>
                {% for emp in employees %}
                    <option value="{{ emp.id }}" {% if current_employee == emp.id|stringformat:"s" %}selected{% endif %}>
                        {{ emp.get_full_name|default:emp.username }}
                    </option>
                {% endfor %}
            </select>

            <select name="has_invoice" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
                <option value="">فاکتور (همه)</option>
                <option value="yes" {% if current_has_invoice == 'yes' %}selected{% endif %}>دارای فاکتور</option>
                <option value="no" {% if current_has_invoice == 'no' %}selected{% endif %}>بدون فاکتور</option>
            </select>
        </div>

        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row flex-wrap gap-3 sm:items-center">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <label class="text-xs text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap">ثبت از:</label>
                <input type="text" name="from_date" value="{{ from_date }}" data-jdp
                       placeholder="۱۴۰۵/۰۱/۰۱" autocomplete="off"
                       class="flex-1 sm:flex-none sm:w-32 px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm" dir="ltr">
            </div>

            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <label class="text-xs text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap">تا:</label>
                <input type="text" name="to_date" value="{{ to_date }}" data-jdp
                       placeholder="۱۴۰۵/۱۲/۲۹" autocomplete="off"
                       class="flex-1 sm:flex-none sm:w-32 px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm" dir="ltr">
            </div>

            <button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-blue-700">
                اعمال فیلتر
            </button>

            {% if has_filters %}
            <a href="{% url 'customers:hub' %}?tab=info" class="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 text-center sm:text-right">پاک کردن فیلترها</a>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </form>

    {% if filtered_count %}
    <div class="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 text-sm">
        <span class="text-gray-500">نتیجه‌ی فیلتر:</span>
        <span class="font-bold text-blue-700 mr-1">{{ filtered_count }} مشتری</span>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<!-- Desktop: table -->
<div class="hidden md:block bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">مشتری</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">شماره تماس</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">منبع</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">وضعیت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">کارمند مسئول</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">تاریخ ثبت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">عملیات</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for customer in page_obj %}
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition">
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div class="w-9 h-9 bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold flex-shrink-0">
                            {{ customer.name|first|upper }}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ customer.name }}</div>
                            {% if customer.email %}
                            <div class="text-xs text-gray-400" dir="ltr">{{ customer.email }}</div>
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600 font-mono">
                    <span dir="ltr">{{ customer.mobile }}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600">{{ customer.get_source_display }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    {% if customer.status == 'lead' %}
                        <span class="inline-block px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">{{ customer.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% elif customer.status == 'active' %}
                        <span class="inline-block px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">{{ customer.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% elif customer.status == 'inactive' %}
                        <span class="inline-block px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">{{ customer.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% else %}
                        <span class="inline-block px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700">{{ customer.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600">
                    {% if customer.assigned_to %}
                        {{ customer.assigned_to.get_full_name|default:customer.assigned_to.username }}
                    {% else %}
                        --
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-500 text-xs whitespace-nowrap">
                    <div>{{ customer.created_at|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}</div>
                    <div class="text-gray-400 font-mono mt-0.5" dir="ltr">{{ customer.created_at|jdate:"H:i" }}</div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <a href="{% url 'customers:detail' customer.pk %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 text-xs">جزئیات</a>
                    {% if 'customers.delete' in user_permissions %}
                    <form method="post" action="{% url 'customers:deactivate' customer.pk %}" class="inline"
                          onsubmit="return confirm('مشتری «{{ customer.name }}» غیرفعال شود؟');">
                        {% csrf_token %}
                        <button type="submit" class="text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 text-xs mr-2">غیرفعال</button>
                    </form>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
            </tr>
            {% empty %}
            <tr>
                <td colspan="7" class="text-center py-12 text-gray-400">مشتری‌ای یافت نشد</td>
            </tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

<!-- ===== MOBILE CARDS START ===== -->
<div class="md:hidden space-y-3">
    {% for customer in page_obj %}
    <article class="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <!-- Header -->
        <header class="px-4 py-3 flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-gray-100">
            <div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-500 to-blue-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold flex-shrink-0">
                {{ customer.name|first|upper }}
            </div>
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div class="font-bold text-gray-900 truncate">{{ customer.name }}</div>
                {% if customer.email %}<div class="text-xs text-gray-500 truncate" dir="ltr">{{ customer.email }}</div>{% endif %}
            </div>
            {% if customer.status == 'lead' %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0">
                    <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500"></span>{{ customer.get_status_display }}
                </span>
            {% elif customer.status == 'active' %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-green-50 text-green-700 border border-green-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0">
                    <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-green-500"></span>{{ customer.get_status_display }}
                </span>
            {% elif customer.status == 'inactive' %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border border-gray-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0">
                    <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-gray-500"></span>{{ customer.get_status_display }}
                </span>
            {% else %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700 border border-yellow-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0">
                    <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-yellow-500"></span>{{ customer.get_status_display }}
                </span>
            {% endif %}
        </header>
        <!-- Hero: Phone -->
        <div class="px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-100">
            <div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 font-semibold mb-1">شماره تماس</div>
            <div class="font-mono text-lg font-bold text-gray-900" dir="ltr">{{ customer.mobile }}</div>
        </div>
        <!-- Meta -->
        <div class="px-4 py-2 space-y-1.5">
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs gap-3">
                <span class="text-gray-400">منبع</span>
                <span class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ customer.get_source_display }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs gap-3">
                <span class="text-gray-400">مسئول</span>
                <span class="font-medium text-gray-800 truncate">{% if customer.assigned_to %}{{ customer.assigned_to.get_full_name|default:customer.assigned_to.username }}{% else %}--{% endif %}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs gap-3">
                <span class="text-gray-400">تاریخ ثبت</span>
                <span class="font-medium text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ customer.created_at|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}</span>
            </div>
        </div>
        <!-- Action -->
        <div class="px-4 py-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex gap-2">
            <a href="{% url 'customers:detail' customer.pk %}" class="flex-1 text-center py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-medium active:bg-blue-700 transition">
                مشاهده جزئیات
            </a>
            {% if 'customers.delete' in user_permissions %}
            <form method="post" action="{% url 'customers:deactivate' customer.pk %}" class="flex-1"
                  onsubmit="return confirm('مشتری «{{ customer.name }}» غیرفعال شود؟');">
                {% csrf_token %}
                <button type="submit" class="w-full text-center py-2.5 bg-red-50 text-red-700 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium active:bg-red-100 transition">
                    غیرفعال
                </button>
            </form>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </article>
    {% empty %}
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 p-8 text-center text-gray-400 text-sm">مشتری‌ای یافت نشد</div>
    {% endfor %}
</div>
<!-- ===== MOBILE CARDS END ===== -->


{% if page_obj.has_other_pages %}
<div class="flex justify-center mt-6 gap-2 flex-wrap">
    {% if page_obj.has_previous %}
        <a href="?{% querystring page=page_obj.previous_page_number %}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 text-sm">قبلی</a>
    {% endif %}

    <span class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm">
        صفحه {{ page_obj.number }} از {{ page_obj.paginator.num_pages }}
    </span>

    {% if page_obj.has_next %}
        <a href="?{% querystring page=page_obj.next_page_number %}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 text-sm">بعدی</a>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}

{% block fab %}
{% if 'customers.add' in user_permissions %}
<a href="{% url 'customers:create' %}" class="app-fab" title="مشتری جدید" aria-label="مشتری جدید">
    <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
    </svg>
</a>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}
{% load fa_numbers %}

{% block title %}گزارش‌های BI{% endblock %}
{% block mobile_title %}گزارش BI{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<!-- ═══ سربرگ ═══ -->
<div class="page-header">
    <div>
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">گزارش‌های تحلیلی (BI)</h1>
        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
            تحلیل عمیق فروش، مشتریان و عملکرد کارمندان — {{ today }}
        </p>
    </div>
    <div class="action-buttons flex gap-2">
        <a href="{% url 'dashboard:bi_export' %}{% if filter_user_id %}?employee={{ filter_user_id }}{% endif %}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700 text-sm flex items-center gap-2">
            <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                      d="M12 10v6m0 0l-3-3m3 3l3-3m2 8H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"/>
            </svg>
            خروجی Excel
        </a>
        <a href="{% url 'dashboard:home' %}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm">
            ← داشبورد اصلی
        </a>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ فیلتر کاربر (فقط مدیرها) ═══ -->
{% if is_manager_view %}
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm mb-6">
    <form method="get" class="flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-center">
        <label class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 whitespace-nowrap">نمایش داده‌های:</label>
        <select name="employee" onchange="this.form.submit()"
                class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 bg-white">
            <option value="" {% if not filter_user_id %}selected{% endif %}>همه‌ی کارمندان</option>
            {% for u in filter_users_list %}
                <option value="{{ u.pk }}" {% if filter_user_id == u.pk|stringformat:"s" %}selected{% endif %}>
                    {{ u.get_full_name|default:u.username }}
                </option>
            {% endfor %}
        </select>

        {% if filter_user_selected %}
        <a href="{% url 'dashboard:bi' %}" class="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700">پاک کردن فیلتر</a>
        {% endif %}
    </form>

    {% if filter_user_selected %}
    <div class="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 text-sm text-blue-700 flex items-center gap-2">
        <span>🔍</span>
        <span>نمایش داده‌های: <strong>{{ filter_user_selected.get_full_name|default:filter_user_selected.username }}</strong></span>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endif %}

<!-- ═══ KPI Cards ═══ -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-blue-500">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
            <div class="w-9 h-9 bg-blue-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-blue-600">👥</div>
            <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs">کل مشتریان</div>
        </div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">{{ kpis.total_customers|fa_num }}</div>
        <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">
            فعال: <span class="text-green-600 font-bold">{{ kpis.active_customers|fa_num }}</span>
            • لید: <span class="text-yellow-600 font-bold">{{ kpis.lead_customers|fa_num }}</span>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-green-500">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
            <div class="w-9 h-9 bg-green-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-green-600">📈</div>
            <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs">نرخ تبدیل لید</div>
        </div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-green-700">{{ kpis.conversion_rate }}٪</div>
        <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">active / total</div>
    </div>

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-purple-500">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
            <div class="w-9 h-9 bg-purple-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-purple-600">💰</div>
            <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs">میانگین فاکتور</div>
        </div>
        <div class="text-xl font-bold text-purple-700" dir="ltr">{{ kpis.avg_invoice|floatformat:0 }}</div>
        <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">تومان</div>
    </div>

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-yellow-500">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
            <div class="w-9 h-9 bg-yellow-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-yellow-600">⏱</div>
            <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs">میانگین زمان تبدیل</div>
        </div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-yellow-700">{{ kpis.avg_conversion_days }} روز</div>
        <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">اولین تماس → اولین فاکتور</div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ Trend فروش ۱۲ ماه ═══ -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 mb-6">
    <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
        <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">📊</span>
        روند فروش ۱۲ ماه اخیر (مقایسه با سال قبل)
    </h2>
    <div id="trendChart" style="min-height: 320px;"></div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ Heatmap ساعت‌های طلایی ═══ -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 mb-6">
    <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-1 flex items-center gap-2">
        <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-red-100 text-red-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">🔥</span>
        ساعت‌های طلایی تماس‌گیری
    </h2>
    <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-4">رنگ‌های تیره‌تر = تماس‌های بیشتر در آن ساعت و روز</p>
    <div class="overflow-x-auto -mx-4 md:mx-0 px-4 md:px-0 pb-2">
        <div id="heatmapChart" style="min-width: 720px; min-height: 340px;"></div>
    </div>
    <p class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-2 text-center md:hidden">نمودار را افقی اسکرول کنید</p>
</div>

<!-- ═══ نرخ تبدیل منابع جذب ═══ -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 mb-6">
    <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
        <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-purple-100 text-purple-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">🎯</span>
        کارایی منابع جذب مشتری
    </h2>
    {% if source_data %}
    <div class="overflow-x-auto">
        <table class="w-full text-sm">
            <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                <tr class="text-gray-600">
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">منبع جذب</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">کل مشتری</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">تبدیل‌شده</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">نرخ تبدیل</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium w-48">نمودار</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                {% for s in source_data %}
                <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium text-gray-800">{{ s.label }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600">{{ s.total|fa_num }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-green-600 font-bold">{{ s.active|fa_num }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        <span class="font-bold {% if s.rate >= 50 %}text-green-700{% elif s.rate >= 25 %}text-yellow-700{% else %}text-red-600{% endif %}">
                            {{ s.rate }}٪
                        </span>
                    </td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3">
                        <div class="bg-gray-100 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden" dir="ltr">
                            <div class="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-400 to-blue-600"
                                 style="width: {{ s.rate }}%;"></div>
                        </div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
                {% endfor %}
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>
    {% else %}
    <div class="text-center py-8 text-gray-400">داده‌ای برای نمایش وجود ندارد</div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<!-- ═══ دو ستون: Top Customers + Top Products ═══ -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-6">

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
            <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-2">
                <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-green-100 text-green-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">🏆</span>
                برترین مشتریان
            </h2>
        </div>
        <div class="overflow-x-auto">
            <table class="w-full text-sm">
                <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                    <tr class="text-gray-600">
                        <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">#</th>
                        <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">مشتری</th>
                        <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">فاکتور</th>
                        <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">مجموع خرید</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">

                            <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono" dir="ltr">{{ c.mobile }}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600">{{ c.invoice_count|fa_num }}</td>
                        <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold text-green-700" dir="ltr">{{ c.total_purchase|floatformat:0 }}</td>
                    </tr>
                    {% empty %}
                    <tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center py-8 text-gray-400">داده‌ای نیست</td></tr>
                    {% endfor %}
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
            <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-2">
                <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">📦</span>
                پرفروش‌ترین کالاها
            </h2>
        </div>
        <div class="overflow-x-auto">
            <table class="w-full text-sm">
                <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                    <tr class="text-gray-600">
                        <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">#</th>
                        <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">کالا</th>
                        <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">تعداد</th>
                        <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">درآمد</th>
                    </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                    {% for p in top_products %}
                    <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
                        <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs text-gray-400">{{ forloop.counter }}</td>
                        <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                            <div class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ p.product__name }}</div>
                            <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono" dir="ltr">{{ p.product__code }}</div>
                        </td>
                        <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-700 font-bold">{{ p.total_qty|fa_num }}</td>
                        <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold text-blue-700" dir="ltr">{{ p.total_revenue|floatformat:0 }}</td>
                    </tr>
                    {% empty %}
                    <tr><td colspan="4" class="text-center py-8 text-gray-400">داده‌ای نیست</td></tr>
                    {% endfor %}
                </tbody>
            </table>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ Top Employees ═══ -->
{% if top_employees %}
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-6">
    <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">🥇</span>
            برترین کارمندان
        </h2>
    </div>
    <div class="overflow-x-auto">
        <table class="w-full text-sm">
            <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                <tr class="text-gray-600">
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">#</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">کارمند</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">تعداد فاکتور</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">مجموع فروش</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium w-48">سهم</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                {% for e in top_employees %}
                <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs text-gray-400">{{ forloop.counter }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        <div class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ e.name }}</div>
                        <div class="text-xs text-gray-400" dir="ltr">{{ e.username }}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600">{{ e.invoice_count|fa_num }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold text-green-700" dir="ltr">{{ e.total_sales|floatformat:0 }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3">
                        <div class="bg-gray-100 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden" dir="ltr">
                            <div class="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-green-400 to-green-600"
                                 style="width: {% if top_employees.0.total_sales %}{% widthratio e.total_sales top_employees.0.total_sales 100 %}{% else %}0{% endif %}%;"></div>
                        </div>
                    </td>
                </tr>
                {% endfor %}
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>
</div>
{% endif %}

<!-- ═══ مشتریان غیرفعال ═══ -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-6">
    <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex justify-between items-center">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-red-100 text-red-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">⚠️</span>
            مشتریان غیرفعال (بدون خرید ۹۰+ روز)
        </h2>
        <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">نیازمند پیگیری</span>
    </div>
    <div class="overflow-x-auto">
        <table class="w-full text-sm">
            <thead class="bg-gray-50">
                <tr class="text-gray-600">
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">مشتری</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">موبایل</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">آخرین خرید</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-2 font-medium">مسئول</th>
                    <th class="px-4 py-2"></th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                {% for c in inactive_customers %}
                <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                        <a href="{% url 'customers:detail' c.pk %}" class="font-medium text-gray-800 hover:text-blue-600">{{ c.name }}</a>
                    </td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600 font-mono text-xs" dir="ltr">{{ c.mobile }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs">
                        {% if c.last_invoice %}
                            <span class="text-gray-700" dir="ltr">{{ c.last_invoice|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}</span>
                        {% else %}
                            <span class="text-red-600 font-medium">هیچ‌وقت</span>
                        {% endif %}
                    </td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600 text-xs">
                        {% if c.assigned_to %}
                            {{ c.assigned_to.get_full_name|default:c.assigned_to.username }}
                        {% else %}—{% endif %}
                    </td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-left">
                        <a href="{% url 'calls:create' %}?customer={{ c.pk }}"
                           class="text-xs text-green-600 hover:text-green-800 font-medium">
                            📞 تماس
                        </a>
                    </td>
                </tr>
                {% empty %}
                <tr><td colspan="5" class="text-center py-8 text-gray-400">همه‌ی مشتریان فعال هستند ✅</td></tr>
                {% endfor %}
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>
</div>

{% endblock %}


{% block extra_js %}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {

    // ═══ ۱. نمودار Trend فروش ═══
    const trendLabels = {{ trend_labels_json|safe }};
    const trendCurrent = {{ trend_current_json|safe }};
    const trendPrevious = {{ trend_previous_json|safe }};

    new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#trendChart"), window.apexMobileMerge({
        chart: { type: 'area', height: 340, fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', toolbar: { show: false } },
        series: [
            { name: 'سال جاری', data: trendCurrent },
            { name: 'سال قبل', data: trendPrevious },
        ],
        xaxis: {
            categories: trendLabels,
            labels: { style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' } },
        },
        yaxis: {
            labels: {
                style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' },
                formatter: (val) => Number(val).toLocaleString('en-US'),
            },
        },
        colors: ['#3b82f6', '#94a3b8'],
        stroke: { curve: 'smooth', width: 3 },
        fill: { type: 'gradient', gradient: { opacityFrom: 0.5, opacityTo: 0.1 } },
        dataLabels: { enabled: false },
        legend: { position: 'top', horizontalAlign: 'right', fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' },
        tooltip: {
            y: { formatter: (val) => Number(val).toLocaleString('en-US') + ' تومان' },
        },
        grid: { borderColor: '#e5e7eb', strokeDashArray: 3 },
    })).render();

    // ═══ ۲. Heatmap ساعت‌های طلایی ═══
    const heatmapSeries = {{ heatmap_series_json|safe }};

    new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#heatmapChart"), window.apexMobileMerge({
        chart: { type: 'heatmap', height: 360, fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', toolbar: { show: false } },
        series: heatmapSeries,
        dataLabels: { enabled: false },
        colors: ['#3b82f6'],
        xaxis: {
            type: 'category',
            labels: { style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' } },
        },
        yaxis: {
            labels: { style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' } },
        },
        plotOptions: {
            heatmap: {
                shadeIntensity: 0.6,
                radius: 4,
                colorScale: {
                    ranges: [
                        { from: 0, to: 0, color: '#f3f4f6', name: 'صفر' },
                        { from: 1, to: 5, color: '#bfdbfe', name: 'کم' },
                        { from: 6, to: 15, color: '#60a5fa', name: 'متوسط' },
                        { from: 16, to: 999, color: '#1e40af', name: 'زیاد' },
                    ],
                },
            },
        },
        tooltip: {
            y: { formatter: (val) => val + ' تماس' },
        },
    })).render();

});
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

       class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-medium shadow-sm">
        <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                  d="M12 10v6m0 0l-3-3m3 3l3-3m2 8H7a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h5.586a1 1 0 01.707.293l5.414 5.414a1 1 0 01.293.707V19a2 2 0 01-2 2z"/>
        </svg>
        دانلود Excel
    </a>
</div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<!-- ═══ بنر: نمایش داده‌های شخصی (برای غیر مدیرها) ═══ -->
{% if not is_manager_view %}
<div class="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 text-blue-800 p-3 rounded-xl mb-6 flex items-start gap-3 text-sm">

            (مشتریان، تماس‌ها و فاکتورهای شما).

    </div>
</div>
{% endif %}

<!-- ═══ بنر: فیلتر کاربر فعال ═══ -->
{% if filter_user_selected %}
<div class="bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 text-yellow-800 p-3 rounded-xl mb-6 flex items-center gap-3 text-sm">
    <span class="text-lg flex-shrink-0">🔍</span>
    <div class="flex-1">
        <strong>فیلتر فعال:</strong>

        <strong>{{ filter_user_selected.get_full_name|default:filter_user_selected.username }}</strong>

       class="text-red-600 hover:underline text-xs px-3 py-1 bg-white rounded-lg">
        حذف فیلتر
    </a>
</div>
{% endif %}

<!-- ═══ فیلتر تاریخ و کاربر (چیدمان گرید حرفه‌ای) ═══ -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm mb-6">
    <form method="get" class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 items-end">
        <!-- فیلد از تاریخ -->
        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">از تاریخ</label>
            <input type="text" name="from_date" value="{{ from_date_jalali }}"
                   data-jdp data-jdp-time="false"
                   placeholder="۱۴۰۴/۰۱/۰۱"
                   class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm">
        </div>

        <!-- فیلد تا تاریخ -->
        <div>

                   class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm">
        </div>

        <!-- فیلد کارمند -->

                پاک کردن
            </a>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </form>
</div>

{% if kpis.overdue_tasks > 0 or kpis.pending_leaves > 0 %}

            مقایسه فروش
        </h3>
        <div id="compareChart"></div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ ردیف: منابع + قیف + وضعیت تماس‌ها ═══ -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm">
        <h3 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-green-100 text-green-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">🎯</span>
            منابع جذب مشتری
        </h3>
        <div id="sourceChart"></div>

        <h3 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-purple-100 text-purple-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">🔻</span>
            قیف فروش
        </h3>

        عملکرد کارمندان فروش
    </h3>
    <div id="employeeChart"></div>
</div>
{% endif %}

<!-- ═══ ردیف: پرفروش‌ترین کالاها + برترین کارمندان ═══ -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-4">

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm">
        <h3 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-orange-100 text-orange-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">🏆</span>
            پرفروش‌ترین کالاها
        </h3>

        {% if top_products %}
        <div class="space-y-3">
            {% for p in top_products %}
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold flex-shrink-0
                            {% if forloop.counter == 1 %}bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700
                            {% elif forloop.counter == 2 %}bg-gray-200 text-gray-700
                            {% elif forloop.counter == 3 %}bg-orange-100 text-orange-700
                            {% else %}bg-gray-50 text-gray-500{% endif %}">
                    {{ forloop.counter|fa_num }}
                </div>
                <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-800 truncate text-right">{{ p.name }}</div>
                    <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 text-right">
                        {{ p.qty|fa_num }} فروش | {{ p.revenue|fa_num }} تومان
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        </div>
        {% else %}
        <div class="text-center py-8 text-gray-400 text-sm">هنوز فروشی ثبت نشده</div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm">
        <h3 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">👥</span>
            {% if filter_user_selected %}
                اطلاعات فروش کاربر فیلترشده
            {% else %}
                برترین کارمندان فروش
            {% endif %}
        </h3>

        {% if employee_perf %}
        <div class="space-y-3">
            {% for e in employee_perf|slice:":5" %}
            <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold flex-shrink-0
                            {% if forloop.counter == 1 %}bg-purple-100 text-purple-600
                            {% else %}bg-blue-100 text-blue-600{% endif %}">
                    {{ e.name|first|upper }}
                </div>
                <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                    <div class="text-sm font-medium text-gray-800 text-right">{{ e.name }}</div>
                    <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 text-right">{{ e.invoice_count|fa_num }} فاکتور صادر شده</div>
                </div>
                <div class="text-sm font-bold text-blue-600 whitespace-nowrap">
                    {{ e.total_sales|fa_num }}
                </div>
            </div>
            {% endfor %}
        </div>
        {% else %}
        <div class="text-center py-8 text-gray-400 text-sm">
            {% if filter_user_selected %}
                برای این کاربر فروشی ثبت نشده
            {% else %}
                هنوز فروشی توسط کارمندان ثبت نشده
            {% endif %}
        </div>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ داده‌های JSON امن برای چارت‌ها ═══ -->
{{ compare_data|json_script:"compare-data" }}
{{ funnel|json_script:"funnel-data" }}

{% endblock %}


{% block extra_js %}
<script>
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
// توابع کمکی اعداد فارسی
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════
function toFaNum(val) {
    if (val === null || val === undefined) return '۰';
    return val.toString()
        .replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ',')
        .replace(/\d/g, d => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'[d]);
}

function toFaSimple(val) {
    if (val === null || val === undefined) return '۰';
    return val.toString().replace(/\d/g, d => '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'[d]);
}

// ═══ خواندن داده‌های JSON امن ═══
const compareData = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('compare-data').textContent);
const funnelData = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('funnel-data').textContent);

// ═══ تنظیمات مشترک محور Y ═══
var yaxisMillion = {
    title: {
        text: 'میلیون تومان',
        style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '12px', color: '#666' }
    },
    labels: {
        formatter: function (val) {
            if (val === 0) return '۰';
            return toFaNum((val / 1000000).toFixed(0));
        },
        style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' }
    }
};


// ═══ روند فروش ۱۲ ماه ═══
new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#salesChart"), window.apexMobileMerge({
    chart: { type: 'area', height: 300, fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', toolbar: { show: false } },
    series: [{ name: 'فروش', data: {{ sales_data_json|safe }} }],
    xaxis: {
        categories: {{ sales_labels_json|safe }},
        labels: {
            style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '11px' },
            formatter: function (val) { return toFaSimple(val); }
        }
    },
    yaxis: yaxisMillion,
    colors: ['#2E86AB'],
    stroke: { curve: 'smooth', width: 3 },
    fill: { type: 'gradient', gradient: { opacityFrom: 0.5, opacityTo: 0.05 } },
    dataLabels: { enabled: false },
    tooltip: {
        y: { formatter: function (val) { return toFaNum(val) + ' تومان'; } }
    }
})).render();


// ═══ مقایسه فروش ═══
new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#compareChart"), window.apexMobileMerge({
    chart: { type: 'bar', height: 300, fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', toolbar: { show: false } },
    series: [{ name: 'فروش', data: compareData.values }],
    xaxis: {
        categories: compareData.labels,
        labels: {
            style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '11px' },
            formatter: function (val) { return toFaSimple(val); }
        }
    },
    yaxis: yaxisMillion,
    colors: ['#8b5cf6'],
    plotOptions: {
        bar: { columnWidth: '50%', borderRadius: 6, distributed: true }
    },
    dataLabels: {
        enabled: true,
        offsetY: -25,
        formatter: function (val) {
            if (val === 0) return '۰';
            return toFaNum((val / 1000000).toFixed(1));
        },
        style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '13px', fontWeight: 'bold', colors: ['#333'] }
    },
    legend: { show: false },
    tooltip: {
        y: { formatter: function (val) { return toFaNum(val) + ' تومان'; } }
    }
})).render();


// ═══ منابع جذب مشتری ═══
new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#sourceChart"), window.apexMobileMerge({
    chart: { type: 'donut', height: 280, fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' },
    series: {{ source_data_json|safe }},
    labels: {{ source_labels_json|safe }},
    colors: ['#3b82f6', '#f59e0b', '#10b981', '#6b7280', '#ef4444', '#8b5cf6'],
    legend: { position: 'bottom', fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '12px' },
    dataLabels: {
        enabled: true,
        formatter: function (val, opts) {
            return toFaNum(opts.w.globals.series[opts.seriesIndex]);
        },
        style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' }
    },
    plotOptions: { pie: { donut: { size: '60%' } } }
})).render();


// ═══ قیف فروش ═══
new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#funnelChart"), window.apexMobileMerge({
    chart: { type: 'bar', height: 280, fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', toolbar: { show: false } },
    series: [{ name: 'تعداد', data: funnelData.values }],
    xaxis: {
        categories: funnelData.labels,
        labels: { style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '10px' } }
    },
    yaxis: {
        title: {
            text: 'تعداد',
            style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '12px', color: '#666' }
        },
        labels: {
            formatter: function (val) { return val === 0 ? '۰' : toFaNum(val); },
            style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' }
        }
    },
    colors: ['#8b5cf6'],
    plotOptions: { bar: { distributed: true, columnWidth: '60%', borderRadius: 6 } },
    dataLabels: {
        enabled: true,
        formatter: function (val) { return toFaNum(val); },
        style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' }
    },
    legend: { show: false }
})).render();


// ═══ وضعیت تماس‌ها ═══
new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#callStatusChart"), window.apexMobileMerge({
    chart: { type: 'pie', height: 280, fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' },
    series: {{ call_status_data_json|safe }},
    labels: {{ call_status_labels_json|safe }},
    colors: ['#10b981', '#ef4444', '#f59e0b', '#3b82f6', '#6b7280'],
    legend: { position: 'bottom', fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '12px' },
    dataLabels: {
        enabled: true,
        formatter: function (val, opts) {
            return toFaNum(opts.w.globals.series[opts.seriesIndex]);
        },
        style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn' }
    }
})).render();


// ═══ عملکرد کارمندان فروش (فقط مدیرها بدون فیلتر) ═══
{% if is_manager_view and not filter_user_selected and employee_perf %}
new ApexCharts(document.querySelector("#employeeChart"), window.apexMobileMerge({
    chart: { type: 'bar', height: 350, fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', toolbar: { show: false } },
    series: [{ name: 'فروش', data: {{ emp_chart_values_json|safe }} }],
    xaxis: {
        categories: {{ emp_chart_names_json|safe }},
        labels: {
            style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '12px' },
            formatter: function (val) { return toFaSimple(val); }
        }
    },
    yaxis: yaxisMillion,
    colors: ['#2E86AB'],
    plotOptions: {
        bar: {
            horizontal: false,
            columnWidth: '50%',
            borderRadius: 6,
            dataLabels: { position: 'top' }
        }
    },
    dataLabels: {
        enabled: true,
        offsetY: -25,
        formatter: function (val) {
            if (val === 0) return '۰';
            return toFaNum((val / 1000000).toFixed(1));
        },
        style: { fontFamily: 'Vazirmatn', fontSize: '13px', fontWeight: 'bold', colors: ['#2E86AB'] }
    },
    tooltip: {
        y: { formatter: function (val) { return toFaNum(val) + ' تومان'; } }
    }
})).render();
{% endif %}
</script>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}جستجو{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="mb-6">
    <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">نتایج جستجو</h1>
    <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
        {% if query %}
            {% if results.total > 0 %}
                <strong class="text-blue-600">{{ results.total }}</strong> نتیجه برای «{{ query }}» پیدا شد
            {% else %}
                نتیجه‌ای برای «{{ query }}» یافت نشد
            {% endif %}
        {% else %}
            حداقل ۲ حرف وارد کنید تا جستجو شروع شود
        {% endif %}
    </p>
</div>

{% if query and results.total > 0 %}

    <!-- ═══ مشتریان ═══ -->
    {% if results.customers %}
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm mb-6 overflow-hidden">
        <div class="bg-blue-50 px-5 py-3 border-b border-blue-100 flex items-center gap-2">
            <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                      d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z"/>
            </svg>
            <h2 class="font-bold text-blue-800">مشتریان ({{ results.customers|length }})</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for c in results.customers %}
            <a href="{% url 'customers:detail' c.pk %}" class="block px-5 py-3 hover:bg-gray-50 transition">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div class="w-9 h-9 bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold flex-shrink-0">
                            {{ c.name|first|upper }}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ c.name }}</div>
                            <div class="text-xs text-gray-500 font-mono" dir="ltr">{{ c.mobile }}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <span class="text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded-full
                            {% if c.status == 'lead' %}bg-red-100 text-red-700
                            {% elif c.status == 'active' %}bg-green-100 text-green-700
                            {% else %}bg-gray-100 text-gray-700{% endif %}">
                            {{ c.get_status_display }}
                        </span>
                        <span class="text-xs text-blue-600 font-medium">مشاهده →</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </a>
            {% endfor %}
        </div>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- ═══ تماس‌ها ═══ -->
    {% if results.calls %}
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm mb-6 overflow-hidden">
        <div class="bg-green-50 px-5 py-3 border-b border-green-100 flex items-center gap-2">
            <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-green-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                      d="M3 5a2 2 0 012-2h3.28a1 1 0 01.948.684l1.498 4.493a1 1 0 01-.502 1.21l-2.257 1.13a11.042 11.042 0 005.516 5.516l1.13-2.257a1 1 0 011.21-.502l4.493 1.498a1 1 0 01.684.949V19a2 2 0 01-2 2h-1C9.716 21 3 14.284 3 6V5z"/>
            </svg>
            <h2 class="font-bold text-green-800">تماس‌ها ({{ results.calls|length }})</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for c in results.calls %}
            <a href="{% url 'calls:detail' c.pk %}" class="block px-5 py-3 hover:bg-gray-50 transition">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <div class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ c.caller_name }}</div>
                        <div class="text-xs text-gray-500 font-mono" dir="ltr">{{ c.call_number }}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <span class="text-xs text-gray-500">{{ c.call_date|date:"Y/m/d" }}</span>
                        <span class="text-xs text-green-600 font-medium">مشاهده →</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </a>
            {% endfor %}
        </div>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- ═══ کالاها ═══ -->
    {% if results.products %}
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm mb-6 overflow-hidden">
        <div class="bg-yellow-50 px-5 py-3 border-b border-yellow-100 flex items-center gap-2">
            <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-yellow-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                      d="M20 7l-8-4-8 4m16 0l-8 4m8-4v10l-8 4m0-10L4 7m8 4v10M4 7v10l8 4"/>
            </svg>
            <h2 class="font-bold text-yellow-800">کالاها ({{ results.products|length }})</h2>
        </div>
        <div class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for p in results.products %}
            <a href="{% url 'products:detail' p.pk %}" class="block px-5 py-3 hover:bg-gray-50 transition">
                <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                        <div class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ p.name }}</div>
                        <div class="text-xs text-gray-500 font-mono" dir="ltr">{{ p.code }}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <span class="text-xs text-gray-500" dir="ltr">{{ p.price|floatformat:0 }} تومان</span>
                        <span class="text-xs text-yellow-600 font-medium">مشاهده →</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </a>
            {% endfor %}
        </div>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

{% elif query %}
    <!-- ═══ نتیجه‌ای یافت نشد ═══ -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-12 text-center">
        <div class="text-6xl mb-4">🔍</div>
        <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">نتیجه‌ای پیدا نشد</h2>
        <p class="text-gray-500 text-sm mb-6">
            برای «<strong>{{ query }}</strong>» هیچ نتیجه‌ای در مشتریان، تماس‌ها یا کالاها یافت نشد.
        </p>
        <div class="flex justify-center gap-3">
            <a href="{% url 'customers:hub' %}?tab=info" class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-blue-100">مشاهده مشتریان</a>
            <a href="{% url 'customers:hub' %}?tab=followup" class="px-4 py-2 bg-green-50 text-green-700 rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-green-100">مشاهده تماس‌ها</a>
            <a href="{% url 'products:list' %}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700 rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-yellow-100">مشاهده کالاها</a>
        </div>
    </div>

{% else %}
    <!-- ═══ حالت اولیه (بدون جستجو) ═══ -->
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-12 text-center">
        <div class="text-6xl mb-4">🔍</div>
        <h2 class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2">جستجوی سراسری</h2>
        <p class="text-gray-500 text-sm">
            نام مشتری، شماره تماس، کد کالا یا هر چیزی که می‌خواهید را در نوار بالای صفحه تایپ کنید.
        </p>
        <div class="mt-6 flex justify-center gap-3 text-sm">
            <span class="px-3 py-1 bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 rounded-full">👥 مشتریان</span>
            <span class="px-3 py-1 bg-green-50 text-green-700 rounded-full">📞 تماس‌ها</span>
            <span class="px-3 py-1 bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700 rounded-full">📦 کالاها</span>
        </div>
    </div>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}دسترسی غیرمجاز{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="flex items-center justify-center min-h-[60vh]">
    <div class="max-w-lg w-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm p-8 text-center">

        <!-- آیکون -->
        <div class="w-24 h-24 bg-red-100 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-6">
            <svg class="w-12 h-12 text-red-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                      d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8z"/>
            </svg>
        </div>

        <!-- کد خطا -->
        <div class="text-6xl font-bold text-red-600 mb-2" dir="ltr">403</div>

        <!-- عنوان -->
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-3">
            دسترسی غیرمجاز
        </h1>

        <p class="text-gray-600 text-sm leading-relaxed mb-6">

                در صورت نیاز به دسترسی، با مدیر سیستم تماس بگیرید.
            {% endif %}
        </p>

        <!-- اطلاعات کاربر (فقط برای شفافیت) -->

            <span>👤</span>

            {% if user_role_display %}
            <span class="text-gray-400">|</span>
            <span>نقش: <span class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ user_role_display }}</span></span>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
        {% endif %}

        <!-- دکمه‌ها -->
        <div class="flex gap-3 justify-center flex-wrap">
            <a href="{% url 'dashboard:home' %}"
               class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm font-medium flex items-center gap-2">
                <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                          d="M3 12l2-2m0 0l7-7 7 7M5 10v10a1 1 0 001 1h3m10-11l2 2m-2-2v10a1 1 0 01-1 1h-3m-6 0a1 1 0 001-1v-4a1 1 0 011-1h2a1 1 0 011 1v4a1 1 0 001 1m-6 0h6"/>
                </svg>
                بازگشت به داشبورد
            </a>
            <button onclick="history.back()"
                    class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm font-medium">
                ← بازگشت به صفحه قبل

        </div>

    </div>
</div>

{% endblock %}
```

```html
</div>

<h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-6">{{ title }}</h1>

<form method="post" class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
    {% csrf_token %}

    {% if form.errors %}
    <div class="bg-red-50 text-red-700 p-4 rounded-lg mb-6 text-sm">
        <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
            {% for field, errors in form.errors.items %}{% for error in errors %}<li>{{ field }}: {{ error }}</li>{% endfor %}{% endfor %}
        </ul>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">کارمند <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
            {{ form.employee }}
        </div>
        
        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">ساعت ورود</label>
            {{ form.check_in }}
        </div>
        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">ساعت خروج</label>
            {{ form.check_out }}
        </div>
        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">وضعیت</label>
            {{ form.status }}
        </div>
        <div class="md:col-span-2">
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">یادداشت</label>
            {{ form.notes }}
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="flex gap-3 mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-100">
        <button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm font-medium">{{ submit_label }}</button>
        <a href="{% url 'hr:attendance_list' %}" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm font-medium">انصراف</a>
    </div>
</form>

{% endblock %}
```

#### `templates/hr/attendance_list.html` _(7,884 bytes, text)_

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}
{% load fa_numbers %}
{% block title %}حضور و غیاب{% endblock %}
{% block mobile_title %}حضور و غیاب{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="page-header">
    <div>
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">حضور و غیاب</h1>
        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">ثبت و مدیریت حضور کارمندان</p>
    </div>
    <div class="action-buttons action-buttons-hidden-mobile flex gap-2">
        <a href="{% url 'hr:attendance_report' %}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-purple-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-purple-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm">
            گزارش ماهانه
        </a>
        <a href="{% url 'hr:attendance_create' %}"
           class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
            </svg>
            ثبت حضور
        </a>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="stats-grid stats-grid-4">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-blue-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">ثبت‌شده امروز</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.today }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-green-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">حاضر</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.present_today }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-yellow-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">تاخیر</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.late_today }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-red-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">غایب</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.absent_today }}</div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm mb-6">
    <form method="get" class="filters-row">
        <div>
            <input type="text" name="from" value="{{ from_date }}" placeholder="از تاریخ ۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۰۱"
                   data-jdp data-jdp-time="false"
                   class="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
        </div>
        <div>
            <input type="text" name="to" value="{{ to_date }}" placeholder="تا تاریخ ۱۴۰۵/۰۷/۳۰"
                   data-jdp data-jdp-time="false"
                   class="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
        </div>
        <select name="employee" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">
            <option value="">همه کارمندان</option>
            {% for emp in employees %}<option value="{{ emp.id }}" {% if current_employee == emp.id|stringformat:"s" %}selected{% endif %}>{{ emp.full_name }}</option>{% endfor %}
        </select>
        <select name="status" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">
            <option value="">همه وضعیت‌ها</option>
            {% for value, label in status_choices %}<option value="{{ value }}" {% if current_status == value %}selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>{% endfor %}
        </select>
        <button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-blue-700">اعمال</button>
    </form>
</div>

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="responsive-table w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">کارمند</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">تاریخ و زمان ثبت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">ورود</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">خروج</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">ساعت کاری</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">وضعیت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">عملیات</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for att in page_obj %}
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-medium">{{ att.employee.full_name }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs" data-label="تاریخ" dir="ltr">{{ att.date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }} <span class="text-gray-400 mx-1">|</span> {{ att.created_at|jdate:"H:i" }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs" data-label="ورود" dir="ltr">{{ att.check_in|time:"H:i"|default:"--" }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs" data-label="خروج" dir="ltr">{{ att.check_out|time:"H:i"|default:"--" }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs" data-label="ساعت کاری">{{ att.work_hours_display }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right" data-label="وضعیت">
                    {% if att.status == 'present' %}<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">حاضر</span>
                    {% elif att.status == 'late' %}<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700">تاخیر</span>
                    {% elif att.status == 'absent' %}<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">غایب</span>
                    {% elif att.status == 'leave' %}<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-700">مرخصی</span>
                    {% else %}<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">تعطیل</span>{% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                    <a href="{% url 'hr:attendance_edit' att.pk %}" class="text-yellow-600 hover:text-yellow-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-yellow-50">ویرایش</a>
                    <a href="{% url 'hr:attendance_delete' att.pk %}" class="text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-red-50">حذف</a>
                </td>
            </tr>
            {% empty %}
            <tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center py-12 text-gray-400">رکوردی یافت نشد</td></tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

{% if page_obj.has_other_pages %}
<div class="flex justify-center mt-6 gap-2">
    {% if page_obj.has_previous %}<a href="?page={{ page_obj.previous_page_number }}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">قبلی</a>{% endif %}
    <span class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm">صفحه {{ page_obj.number }} از {{ page_obj.paginator.num_pages }}</span>
    {% if page_obj.has_next %}<a href="?page={{ page_obj.next_page_number }}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">بعدی</a>{% endif %}
</div>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}

{% block fab %}
{% if 'hr.attendance' in user_permissions %}
<a href="{% url 'hr:attendance_create' %}" class="app-fab" title="ثبت حضور" aria-label="ثبت حضور">
    <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
    </svg>
</a>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}گزارش ماهانه حضور{% endblock %}
{% load fa_numbers %}
{% block content %}

<div class="page-header">
    <div>
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">گزارش ماهانه حضور</h1>
        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1" dir="ltr">
            {{ month_start|jdate:"Y/m/d" }} -- {{ month_end|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}
        </p>
    </div>
    <div class="action-buttons flex gap-2">
        <a href="{% url 'hr:attendance_list' %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm">بازگشت به لیست</a>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm mb-6">
    <form method="get" class="filters-row">
        <div class="w-full sm:w-auto">
            <label class="block text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1.5">سال</label>
            <select name="year" id="year-select"
                    class="w-full sm:w-28 px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 bg-white cursor-pointer"
                    dir="ltr">
                {% for y in year_choices %}
                    <option value="{{ y }}" {% if y == selected_year %}selected{% endif %}>{{ y }}</option>
                {% endfor %}
            </select>
        </div>

        <div class="w-full sm:w-auto">
            <label class="block text-xs text-gray-500 mb-1.5">ماه</label>
            <select name="month_num" id="month-select"
                    class="w-full sm:w-40 px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 bg-white cursor-pointer">
                {% for num, label in month_choices %}
                    <option value="{{ num }}" {% if num == selected_month_num %}selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>
                {% endfor %}
            </select>
        </div>

        <div class="w-full sm:w-auto flex flex-col justify-end">
            <button type="submit" class="w-full sm:w-auto px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-blue-700">
                نمایش
            </button>
        </div>

        <span class="text-xs text-gray-400 w-full sm:w-auto text-center sm:text-right">ماه و سال را انتخاب کنید</span>
    </form>
</div>

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="responsive-table w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">کارمند</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">سمت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">روزهای ثبت‌شده</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">حاضر</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">تاخیر</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">غایب</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">مرخصی</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">جمع ساعت</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for row in report %}
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <a href="{% url 'hr:employee_detail' row.employee.pk %}" class="font-medium text-gray-800 hover:text-blue-600">
                        {{ row.employee.full_name }}
                    </a>
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs text-gray-600" data-label="سمت">{{ row.employee.get_position_display }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold" data-label="روزهای ثبت‌شده">{{ row.total_days }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-green-600 font-bold" data-label="حاضر">{{ row.present }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-yellow-600" data-label="تاخیر">{{ row.late }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-red-600" data-label="غایب">{{ row.absent }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-blue-600" data-label="مرخصی">{{ row.leave }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs" data-label="جمع ساعت">{{ row.total_hours }} ساعت</td>
            </tr>
            {% empty %}
            <tr><td colspan="8" class="text-center py-12 text-gray-400">کارمندی یافت نشد</td></tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

{% endblock %}
```

```html
                {% endif %}

            </div>

        </div>

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-purple-500">
        <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
            <div class="w-11 h-11 bg-purple-100 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center">
                <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-purple-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                          d="M8 7V3m8 4V3m-9 8h10M5 21h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v12a2 2 0 002 2z"/>

                <dd class="text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ employee.email|default:"—" }}</dd>

            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">تاریخ تولد:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ employee.birth_date|jdate:"Y/m/d"|default:"—" }}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
                <dt class="text-gray-500 mb-1">آدرس:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800">{{ employee.address|default:"—" }}</dd>
            </div>
        </dl>
    </div>

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4">اطلاعات شغلی</h2>
        <dl class="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">سمت:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800">{{ employee.get_position_display }}</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">نوع قرارداد:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800">{{ employee.get_contract_type_display }}</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">حقوق پایه:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ employee.salary|floatformat:0|default:"—" }} تومان</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">حساب کاربری:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800">{{ employee.user.username|default:"—" }}</dd>
            </div>
        </dl>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ وظایف باز ═══ -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-6">
    <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100 flex justify-between items-center">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">✅</span>
            وظایف باز
            {% if open_tasks_count > 0 %}<span class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-normal">({{ open_tasks_count }})</span>{% endif %}
        </h2>
        {% if 'hr.manage_tasks' in user_permissions %}
        <a href="{% url 'hr:task_create' %}" class="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline">+ وظیفه جدید</a>
        {% endif %}
    </div>

    {% if open_tasks %}
    <table class="w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">عنوان</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">اولویت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">وضعیت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">مهلت</th>
                <th class="px-6 py-2.5"></th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for task in open_tasks %}
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 {% if task.is_overdue %}bg-red-50{% endif %}">
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right">
                    <a href="{% url 'hr:task_detail' task.pk %}" class="text-gray-800 hover:text-blue-600 font-medium">{{ task.title }}</a>
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right">
                    {% if task.priority == 'urgent' %}<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">فوری</span>
                    {% elif task.priority == 'high' %}<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-orange-100 text-orange-700">زیاد</span>
                    {% elif task.priority == 'medium' %}<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-700">متوسط</span>
                    {% else %}<span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">کم</span>{% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs">{{ task.get_status_display }}</td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs {% if task.is_overdue %}text-red-600 font-bold{% else %}text-gray-500{% endif %}" dir="ltr">
                    {{ task.due_date|jdate:"Y/m/d"|default:"—" }}
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-left">
                    <a href="{% url 'hr:task_detail' task.pk %}" class="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline">مشاهده</a>
                </td>
            </tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
    {% else %}
    <div class="text-center py-8 text-gray-400 text-sm">
        وظیفه بازی برای این کارمند نیست
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

{% if employee.notes %}
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
    <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4">یادداشت</h2>
    <p class="text-gray-700 text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{{ employee.notes }}</p>
</div>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="mb-6">

</div>

<h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-6">{{ title }}</h1>

<form method="post" class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
    {% csrf_token %}

    {% if form.errors %}
    <div class="bg-red-50 text-red-700 p-4 rounded-lg mb-6 text-sm">
        <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
            {% for field, errors in form.errors.items %}{% for error in errors %}<li>{{ field }}: {{ error }}</li>{% endfor %}{% endfor %}
        </ul>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
```
