```html
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">کاربر مرتبط <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">(اختیاری)</span></label>
            {{ form.user }}
        </div>
        <div><label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">نام <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>{{ form.first_name }}</div>
        <div><label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">نام خانوادگی <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>{{ form.last_name }}</div>
        <div><label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">کد ملی</label>{{ form.national_id }}</div>
        <div><label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">موبایل</label>{{ form.mobile }}</div>
        <div><label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">ایمیل</label>{{ form.email }}</div>
        <div><label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">تاریخ تولد</label>{{ form.birth_date }}</div>
        <div><label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">سمت</label>{{ form.position }}</div>
        <div><label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">نوع قرارداد</label>{{ form.contract_type }}</div>
        
        <div><label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">حقوق پایه (تومان)</label>{{ form.salary }}</div>
        <div class="flex items-end pb-3">
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm cursor-pointer">
                {{ form.is_active }} <span>کارمند فعال</span>
            </label>
        </div>
        <div class="md:col-span-2"><label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">آدرس</label>{{ form.address }}</div>
        <div class="md:col-span-2"><label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">یادداشت</label>{{ form.notes }}</div>
    </div>

    <div class="flex gap-3 mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-100">
        <button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm font-medium">{{ submit_label }}</button>
        <a href="{% url 'hr:employee_list' %}" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm font-medium">انصراف</a>
    </div>
</form>

{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}پرسنل{% endblock %}
{% block mobile_title %}پرسنل{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

{% load fa_numbers %}

<div class="page-header">
    <div>
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">پرسنل</h1>
        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">مدیریت کارمندان و تیم</p>
    </div>
    {% if 'hr.manage_employees' in user_permissions %}
    <div class="action-buttons action-buttons-hidden-mobile flex gap-2">
        <a href="{% url 'hr:employee_create' %}"
           class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
            </svg>
            کارمند جدید
        </a>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<div class="stats-grid stats-grid-3">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-blue-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">کل کارمندان</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.total }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-green-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">فعال</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.active }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-gray-400">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">غیرفعال</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.inactive }}</div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm mb-6">
    <form method="get" class="filters-row">
        <div class="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
            <input type="text" name="q" value="{{ search }}"
                   placeholder="جستجو نام، موبایل یا کد ملی..."
                   class="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm">
        </div>
        <select name="position" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
            <option value="">همه سمت‌ها</option>
            {% for value, label in position_choices %}
                <option value="{{ value }}" {% if current_position == value %}selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>
            {% endfor %}
        </select>
        <select name="status" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
            <option value="">همه</option>
            <option value="active" {% if current_status == 'active' %}selected{% endif %}>فعال</option>
            <option value="inactive" {% if current_status == 'inactive' %}selected{% endif %}>غیرفعال</option>
        </select>
        <button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-blue-700">اعمال</button>
        {% if search or current_position or current_status %}
        <a href="{% url 'hr:employee_list' %}" class="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700">پاک کردن</a>
        {% endif %}
    </form>
</div>

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="responsive-table w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">کارمند</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">سمت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">موبایل</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">وظایف باز</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">تاریخ استخدام</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">وضعیت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">عملیات</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for emp in page_obj %}
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <div class="w-9 h-9 bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-sm font-bold flex-shrink-0">
                            {{ emp.first_name|first|upper }}
                        </div>
                        <div>
                            <div class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ emp.full_name }}</div>
                            {% if emp.email %}<div class="text-xs text-gray-400" dir="ltr">{{ emp.email }}</div>{% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600 text-xs" data-label="سمت">{{ emp.get_position_display }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600 font-mono text-xs" data-label="موبایل"><span dir="ltr">{{ emp.mobile|default:"--" }}</span></td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right" data-label="وظایف باز">
                    {% if emp.open_tasks_count > 0 %}
                        <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-700">{{ emp.open_tasks_count }} وظیفه</span>
                    {% else %}
                        <span class="text-xs text-gray-300">--</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-500 text-xs" data-label="تاریخ استخدام" dir="ltr">{{ emp.hire_date|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right" data-label="وضعیت">
                    {% if emp.is_active %}
                        <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">فعال</span>
                    {% else %}
                        <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">غیرفعال</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                    <a href="{% url 'hr:employee_detail' emp.pk %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-blue-50">جزئیات</a>
                    {% if 'hr.manage_employees' in user_permissions %}
                    <a href="{% url 'hr:employee_edit' emp.pk %}" class="text-yellow-600 hover:text-yellow-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-yellow-50">ویرایش</a>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
            </tr>
            {% empty %}
            <tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center py-12 text-gray-400">کارمندی یافت نشد</td></tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

{% if page_obj.has_other_pages %}
<div class="flex justify-center mt-6 gap-2">
    {% if page_obj.has_previous %}<a href="?page={{ page_obj.previous_page_number }}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 text-sm">قبلی</a>{% endif %}
    <span class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm">صفحه {{ page_obj.number }} از {{ page_obj.paginator.num_pages }}</span>
    {% if page_obj.has_next %}<a href="?page={{ page_obj.next_page_number }}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 text-sm">بعدی</a>{% endif %}
</div>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}

{% block fab %}
{% if 'hr.manage_employees' in user_permissions %}
<a href="{% url 'hr:employee_create' %}" class="app-fab" title="کارمند جدید" aria-label="کارمند جدید">
    <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
    </svg>
</a>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}
```

```html
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs" data-label="نوع">{{ leave.get_leave_type_display }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs" data-label="از تاریخ" dir="ltr">{{ leave.start_date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs" data-label="تا تاریخ" dir="ltr">{{ leave.end_date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs font-bold" data-label="تعداد روز">{{ leave.days_count }} روز</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right" data-label="وضعیت">
                    {% if leave.status == 'pending' %}
                        <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700">در انتظار</span>
                    {% elif leave.status == 'approved' %}
                        <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">تایید شده</span>
                    {% elif leave.status == 'rejected' %}
                        <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">رد شده</span>
                    {% else %}
                        <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">لغو شده</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                    {% if leave.is_pending and 'hr.review_leaves' in user_permissions %}
                        <a href="{% url 'hr:leave_review' leave.pk %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-blue-50">بررسی</a>
                    {% elif leave.is_pending %}
                        <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">در انتظار بررسی</span>
                    {% else %}
                        <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">بررسی شده</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
            </tr>
            {% empty %}
            <tr><td colspan="7" class="text-center py-12 text-gray-400">درخواستی یافت نشد</td></tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

{% if page_obj.has_other_pages %}
<div class="flex justify-center mt-6 gap-2">
    {% if page_obj.has_previous %}<a href="?page={{ page_obj.previous_page_number }}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">قبلی</a>{% endif %}
    <span class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm">صفحه {{ page_obj.number }} از {{ page_obj.paginator.num_pages }}</span>
    {% if page_obj.has_next %}<a href="?page={{ page_obj.next_page_number }}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">بعدی</a>{% endif %}
</div>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}

{% block fab %}
<a href="{% url 'hr:leave_create' %}" class="app-fab" title="درخواست مرخصی" aria-label="درخواست مرخصی">
    <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
    </svg>
</a>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
<!-- ═══ وظایف باز ═══ -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-6">

        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">✅</span>
            وظایف باز من
            <span class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-normal">({{ open_tasks|length }})</span>
        </h2>
        <a href="{% url 'hr:task_list' %}" class="text-xs text-blue-600 hover:underline">مشاهده همه</a>
    </div>

    {% if open_tasks %}
    <div class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
        {% for task in open_tasks %}
        <a href="{% url 'hr:task_detail' task.pk %}" class="block px-6 py-3 hover:bg-gray-50 transition">
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                    <div class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ task.title }}</div>
                    {% if task.description %}
                        <div class="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">{{ task.description|truncatechars:60 }}</div>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
                <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                    {% if task.priority == 'urgent' %}
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">فوری</span>
                    {% elif task.priority == 'high' %}
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-orange-100 text-orange-700">زیاد</span>
                    {% elif task.priority == 'medium' %}
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-700">متوسط</span>
                    {% else %}
                        <span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">کم</span>
                    {% endif %}

                    {% if task.due_date %}
                        <span class="text-xs {% if task.is_overdue %}text-red-600 font-bold{% else %}text-gray-400{% endif %}" dir="ltr">
                            {{ task.due_date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}
                            {% if task.is_overdue %} ⚠️{% endif %}
                        </span>
                    {% endif %}
                </div>
            </div>
        </a>
        {% endfor %}
    </div>
    {% else %}
    <div class="text-center py-10">
        <div class="text-5xl mb-2">🎉</div>
        <p class="text-gray-500 text-sm">هیچ وظیفه بازی نداری!</p>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

<!-- ═══ اطلاعات شخصی ═══ -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4">اطلاعات شخصی</h2>
        <dl class="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">کد ملی:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ employee.national_id|default:"—" }}</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">موبایل:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800 font-mono" dir="ltr">{{ employee.mobile|default:"—" }}</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">ایمیل:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ employee.email|default:"—" }}</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">تاریخ تولد:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ employee.birth_date|jdate:"Y/m/d"|default:"—" }}</dd>
            </div>
        </dl>
    </div>

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4">اطلاعات شغلی</h2>
        <dl class="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">سمت:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800">{{ employee.get_position_display }}</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">نوع قرارداد:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800">{{ employee.get_contract_type_display }}</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">تاریخ استخدام:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ employee.hire_date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">حقوق پایه:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ employee.salary|floatformat:0|default:"—" }} تومان</dd>
            </div>
        </dl>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ امنیت — 2FA و تغییر رمز ═══ -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 mt-6">
    <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4 flex items-center gap-2">
        <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">🔐</span>
        امنیت حساب
    </h2>

    <!-- بخش 2FA -->
    <div class="flex items-start justify-between gap-4 p-4 rounded-lg mb-4 {% if has_2fa %}bg-green-50 border border-green-200{% else %}bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200{% endif %}">
        <div class="flex-1">
            <div class="font-medium text-gray-800 mb-1">
                {% if has_2fa %}
                    ✅ ورود دو مرحله‌ای (2FA) فعال است
                {% else %}
                    ⚠️ ورود دو مرحله‌ای (2FA) غیرفعال است
                {% endif %}
            </div>
            <div class="text-xs text-gray-600 leading-relaxed">
                {% if has_2fa %}
                    هنگام ورود، علاوه بر رمز عبور، کد ۶ رقمی از اپلیکیشن Authenticator خواسته می‌شود.
                    {% if recovery_codes_count %}
                        <br>تعداد کدهای بازیابی موجود: <strong>{{ recovery_codes_count }}</strong>
                    {% endif %}
                {% else %}
                    با فعال‌سازی 2FA، امنیت حساب شما به‌طور چشمگیری افزایش می‌یابد.
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col gap-2">
            {% if has_2fa %}
                <a href="{% url 'accounts:twofa_disable' %}"
                   class="px-4 py-2 bg-red-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-700 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
                    غیرفعال‌سازی
                </a>
                <a href="{% url 'accounts:twofa_regenerate_recovery' %}"
                   class="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm whitespace-nowrap text-center">
                    کد بازیابی جدید
                </a>
            {% else %}
                <a href="{% url 'accounts:twofa_setup' %}"
                   class="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-indigo-700 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
                    فعال‌سازی 2FA
                </a>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- بخش تغییر رمز عبور -->
    <div class="flex items-center justify-between gap-4 p-4 rounded-lg bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200">
        <div class="flex-1">
            <div class="font-medium text-gray-800 mb-1">
                🔑 تغییر رمز عبور
            </div>
            <div class="text-xs text-gray-600 leading-relaxed">
                در صورت نیاز به تغییر رمز عبور، از این بخش استفاده کنید.
            </div>
        </div>
        <a href="{% url 'accounts:password_change' %}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap">
            تغییر رمز
        </a>
    </div>
</div>
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}ویرایش پروفایل{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="max-w-2xl mx-auto">
    <div class="mb-6">
        <a href="{% url 'hr:my_profile' %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm">← بازگشت به پروفایل</a>
    </div>

    <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-6">ویرایش اطلاعات شخصی</h1>

    <form method="post" class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        {% csrf_token %}

        {% if form.errors %}
        <div class="bg-red-50 text-red-700 p-4 rounded-lg mb-6 text-sm">
            <ul class="list-disc list-inside">
                {% for field, errors in form.errors.items %}{% for error in errors %}<li>{{ field }}: {{ error }}</li>{% endfor %}{% endfor %}
            </ul>
        </div>
        {% endif %}

        <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">نام <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
                {{ form.first_name }}
            </div>
            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">نام خانوادگی <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
                {{ form.last_name }}
            </div>
            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">شماره موبایل</label>
                {{ form.mobile }}
            </div>
            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">ایمیل</label>
                {{ form.email }}
            </div>
            <div>
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">تاریخ تولد</label>
                {{ form.birth_date }}
            </div>
            <div class="md:col-span-2">
                <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">آدرس</label>
                {{ form.address }}
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 text-blue-800 p-3 rounded-lg mt-6 text-xs">
            ℹ️ برای تغییر کد ملی، سمت شغلی یا نوع قرارداد، با مدیر منابع انسانی تماس بگیرید.
        </div>

        <div class="flex gap-3 mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-100">
            <button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm font-medium">
                ذخیره تغییرات
            </button>
```

#### `templates/hr/task_detail.html` _(7,728 bytes, text)_

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}{{ task.title }}{% endblock %}

{% block mobile_leading %}
<a href="{% url 'hr:task_list' %}" class="app-topbar-btn" aria-label="بازگشت">
    <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/>
    </svg>
</a>
{% endblock %}

{% block mobile_title %}{{ task.title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

{% load fa_numbers %}

<div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
    <a href="{% url 'hr:task_list' %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm">← بازگشت به وظایف</a>
    <div class="flex gap-2 flex-wrap">
        {% if 'hr.manage_tasks' in user_permissions %}
        <a href="{% url 'hr:task_edit' task.pk %}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-yellow-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-yellow-600 text-sm">✏️ ویرایش</a>
        <a href="{% url 'hr:task_delete' task.pk %}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-red-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-600 text-sm">🗑 حذف</a>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ هدر وظیفه ═══ -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 mb-6">
    <div class="flex items-start gap-5">
        <div class="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-white text-2xl font-bold flex-shrink-0
                    {% if task.status == 'done' %}bg-green-500
                    {% elif task.status == 'in_progress' %}bg-yellow-500
                    {% elif task.status == 'cancelled' %}bg-gray-400
                    {% else %}bg-blue-500{% endif %}">
            {% if task.status == 'done' %}✓{% elif task.status == 'cancelled' %}✕{% else %}📋{% endif %}
        </div>
        <div class="flex-1">
            <h1 class="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 {% if task.status == 'done' %}line-through text-gray-400{% endif %}">{{ task.title }}</h1>

            <div class="flex gap-2 mt-3 flex-wrap">
                {% if task.status == 'pending' %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">در انتظار</span>
                {% elif task.status == 'in_progress' %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700">در حال انجام</span>
                {% elif task.status == 'done' %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">انجام شده</span>
                {% else %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">لغو شده</span>
                {% endif %}

                {% if task.priority == 'urgent' %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">🔥 فوری</span>
                {% elif task.priority == 'high' %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-orange-100 text-orange-700">اولویت زیاد</span>
                {% elif task.priority == 'medium' %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-700">اولویت متوسط</span>
                {% else %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">اولویت کم</span>
                {% endif %}

                {% if task.is_overdue %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">⚠️ عقب‌افتاده</span>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ تغییر سریع وضعیت (فقط برای دسترسی‌دارها) ═══ -->
{% if 'hr.manage_tasks' in user_permissions %}
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 mb-6">
    <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-3 text-sm">تغییر سریع وضعیت</h2>
    <form method="post" action="{% url 'hr:task_toggle' task.pk %}" class="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        {% csrf_token %}
        <button type="submit" name="status" value="pending"
                class="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm {% if task.status == 'pending' %}bg-gray-500 text-white{% else %}bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-200{% endif %}">
            در انتظار
        </button>
        <button type="submit" name="status" value="in_progress"
                class="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm {% if task.status == 'in_progress' %}bg-yellow-500 text-white{% else %}bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700 hover:bg-yellow-100{% endif %}">
            در حال انجام
        </button>
        <button type="submit" name="status" value="done"
                class="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm {% if task.status == 'done' %}bg-green-500 text-white{% else %}bg-green-50 text-green-700 hover:bg-green-100{% endif %}">
            ✅ انجام شده
        </button>
        <button type="submit" name="status" value="cancelled"
                class="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm {% if task.status == 'cancelled' %}bg-gray-400 text-white{% else %}bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-100{% endif %}">
            لغو شده
        </button>
    </form>
</div>
{% endif %}

<!-- ═══ اطلاعات ═══ -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 mb-6">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4">اطلاعات وظیفه</h2>
        <dl class="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">مسئول:</dt>
                <dd>
                    <a href="{% url 'hr:employee_detail' task.assigned_to.pk %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline font-medium">
                        {{ task.assigned_to.full_name }}
                    </a>
                </dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">مهلت انجام:</dt>
                <dd class="{% if task.is_overdue %}text-red-600 font-bold{% else %}text-gray-800{% endif %}" dir="ltr">
                    {{ task.due_date|jdate:"Y/m/d"|default:"—" }}
                </dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">ایجادکننده:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800">{{ task.created_by.get_full_name|default:task.created_by.username|default:"—" }}</dd>
            </div>
        </dl>
    </div>

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4">زمان‌ها</h2>
        <dl class="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">تاریخ ایجاد:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800 text-xs">{{ task.created_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</dd>
            </div>
            {% if task.completed_at %}
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">تاریخ اتمام:</dt>
                <dd class="text-green-600 text-xs">{{ task.completed_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</dd>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">آخرین ویرایش:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800 text-xs">{{ task.updated_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</dd>
            </div>
        </dl>
    </div>
</div>

{% if task.description %}
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
    <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4">توضیحات</h2>
    <p class="text-gray-700 text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{{ task.description }}</p>
</div>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="mb-6">
    <a href="{% url 'hr:task_list' %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm">← بازگشت به لیست</a>
</div>

<h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-6">{{ title }}</h1>

<form method="post" class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">

            {{ form.assigned_to }}
        </div>

            {{ form.due_date }}

        <a href="{% url 'hr:task_list' %}" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm font-medium">انصراف</a>
    </div>
</form>

{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}وظایف{% endblock %}
{% block mobile_title %}وظایف{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

{% load fa_numbers %}

<div class="page-header">
    <div>
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">وظایف</h1>
        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">مدیریت تسک‌ها و پیگیری‌ها</p>
    </div>
    {% if 'hr.manage_tasks' in user_permissions %}
    <div class="action-buttons action-buttons-hidden-mobile flex gap-2">
        <a href="{% url 'hr:task_create' %}"
           class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
            </svg>
            وظیفه جدید
        </a>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<div class="stats-grid stats-grid-4">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-blue-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">کل وظایف</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.total }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-gray-400">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">در انتظار</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.pending }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-yellow-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">در حال انجام</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.in_progress }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-red-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">عقب‌افتاده</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.overdue }}</div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm mb-6">
    <form method="get" class="filters-row">
        <div class="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
            <input type="text" name="q" value="{{ search }}" placeholder="جستجو عنوان یا توضیحات..."
                   class="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm">
        </div>
        <select name="status" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">
            <option value="">همه وضعیت‌ها</option>
            {% for value, label in status_choices %}<option value="{{ value }}" {% if current_status == value %}selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>{% endfor %}
        </select>
        <select name="priority" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">
            <option value="">همه اولویت‌ها</option>
            {% for value, label in priority_choices %}<option value="{{ value }}" {% if current_priority == value %}selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>{% endfor %}
        </select>
        <select name="employee" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">
            <option value="">همه کارمندان</option>
            {% for emp in employees %}<option value="{{ emp.id }}" {% if current_employee == emp.id|stringformat:"s" %}selected{% endif %}>{{ emp.full_name }}</option>{% endfor %}
        </select>
        <button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-blue-700">اعمال</button>
    </form>
</div>

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="responsive-table w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">عنوان</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">مسئول</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">اولویت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">وضعیت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">مهلت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">عملیات</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for task in page_obj %}
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 {% if task.is_overdue %}bg-red-50{% endif %}">
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <a href="{% url 'hr:task_detail' task.pk %}" class="font-medium text-gray-800 hover:text-blue-600">{{ task.title }}</a>
                    {% if task.description %}<div class="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-0.5">{{ task.description|truncatechars:50 }}</div>{% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs" data-label="مسئول">{{ task.assigned_to.full_name }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right" data-label="اولویت">
                    {% if task.priority == 'urgent' %}<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">فوری</span>
                    {% elif task.priority == 'high' %}<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-orange-100 text-orange-700">زیاد</span>
                    {% elif task.priority == 'medium' %}<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-700">متوسط</span>
                    {% else %}<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">کم</span>{% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right" data-label="وضعیت">
                    {% if task.status == 'done' %}<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">انجام شده</span>
                    {% elif task.status == 'in_progress' %}<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700">در حال انجام</span>
                    {% elif task.status == 'cancelled' %}<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">لغو شده</span>
                    {% else %}<span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">در انتظار</span>{% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs {% if task.is_overdue %}text-red-600 font-bold{% else %}text-gray-500{% endif %}" data-label="مهلت" dir="ltr">
                    {{ task.due_date|jdate:"Y/m/d"|default:"--" }}
                    {% if task.is_overdue %}<span class="block text-xs">! عقب‌افتاده</span>{% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                    <a href="{% url 'hr:task_detail' task.pk %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-blue-50">جزئیات</a>
                    {% if 'hr.manage_tasks' in user_permissions %}
                    <a href="{% url 'hr:task_edit' task.pk %}" class="text-yellow-600 hover:text-yellow-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-yellow-50">ویرایش</a>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
            </tr>
            {% empty %}
            <tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center py-12 text-gray-400">وظیفه‌ای یافت نشد</td></tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

{% if page_obj.has_other_pages %}
<div class="flex justify-center mt-6 gap-2">
    {% if page_obj.has_previous %}<a href="?page={{ page_obj.previous_page_number }}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">قبلی</a>{% endif %}
    <span class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm">صفحه {{ page_obj.number }} از {{ page_obj.paginator.num_pages }}</span>
    {% if page_obj.has_next %}<a href="?page={{ page_obj.next_page_number }}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">بعدی</a>{% endif %}
</div>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}

{% block fab %}
{% if 'hr.manage_tasks' in user_permissions %}
<a href="{% url 'hr:task_create' %}" class="app-fab" title="وظیفه جدید" aria-label="وظیفه جدید">
    <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
    </svg>
</a>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}
```

```html
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-8 text-center">
        <div class="w-16 h-16 bg-red-100 rounded-full mx-auto flex items-center justify-center mb-4">
            <svg class="w-8 h-8 text-red-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                      d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z"/>
            </svg>
        </div>

        <h1 class="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-2">حذف دسته‌بندی؟</h1>
        <p class="text-gray-500 text-sm mb-4">

        </p>

        {% if products_count > 0 %}
        <div class="bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 text-yellow-800 p-3 rounded-lg mb-6 text-xs text-right">
            <strong>⚠️ توجه:</strong>
            <ul class="list-disc list-inside mt-1 space-y-1">
                <li>این دسته دارای <strong>{{ products_count }} کالا</strong> است</li>
                <li>حذف ممکن نیست — ابتدا کالاها را منتقل کنید یا دسته را غیرفعال کنید</li>
            </ul>

        {% else %}
        <div class="bg-red-50 text-red-700 p-3 rounded-lg mb-6 text-xs text-right">
            <strong>⚠️ توجه:</strong>
            <ul class="list-disc list-inside mt-1 space-y-1">
                <li>این عمل قابل بازگشت نیست</li>
                <li>هیچ کالایی به این دسته متصل نیست</li>
            </ul>
        </div>
        {% endif %}

        <form method="post" class="flex justify-center gap-3">
            {% csrf_token %}
            {% if products_count == 0 %}
            <button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-red-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-700 text-sm font-medium">
                بله، حذف کن
            </button>
            {% endif %}
            <a href="{% url 'products:category_list' %}" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm font-medium">
                {% if products_count > 0 %}بازگشت{% else %}انصراف{% endif %}
            </a>
        </form>
    </div>
</div>

{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

        </div>

        <div class="flex items-end pb-3">
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm cursor-pointer">
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}دسته‌بندی‌ها{% endblock %}
{% block mobile_title %}دسته‌بندی‌ها{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="page-header">
    <div>
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">دسته‌بندی کالاها</h1>
        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">مدیریت دسته‌بندی‌های محصولات</p>
    </div>
    <div class="action-buttons action-buttons-hidden-mobile flex gap-2">
        <a href="{% url 'products:list' %}"
           class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm flex items-center justify-center">
            بازگشت به کالاها
        </a>
        {% if 'categories.manage' in user_permissions %}
        <a href="{% url 'products:category_create' %}"
           class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
            </svg>
            دسته‌بندی جدید
        </a>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>

<div class="stats-grid stats-grid-3">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-blue-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">کل دسته‌ها</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.total }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-green-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">فعال</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.active }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-gray-400">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">غیرفعال</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.inactive }}</div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm mb-6">
    <form method="get" class="filters-row">
        <div class="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
            <input type="text" name="q" value="{{ search }}"
                   placeholder="جستجو نام یا slug..."
                   class="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm">
        </div>
        <select name="status" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm">
            <option value="">همه وضعیت‌ها</option>
            <option value="active" {% if current_status == 'active' %}selected{% endif %}>فعال</option>
            <option value="inactive" {% if current_status == 'inactive' %}selected{% endif %}>غیرفعال</option>
        </select>
        <button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-blue-700">اعمال</button>
        {% if search or current_status %}
        <a href="{% url 'products:category_list' %}" class="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700">پاک کردن</a>
        {% endif %}
    </form>
</div>

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="responsive-table w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">دسته</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">نام کوتاه (slug)</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">ترتیب</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">تعداد کالا</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">وضعیت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">عملیات</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for cat in categories %}
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span class="text-2xl">{{ cat.icon }}</span>
                        <div>
                            <div class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ cat.name }}</div>
                            {% if cat.description %}
                            <div class="text-xs text-gray-400">{{ cat.description|truncatechars:40 }}</div>
                            {% endif %}
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600 font-mono text-xs" data-label="slug" dir="ltr">{{ cat.slug }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600" data-label="ترتیب">{{ cat.order }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right" data-label="تعداد کالا">
                    {% if cat.products_count > 0 %}
                        <a href="{% url 'products:list' %}?category={{ cat.slug }}"
                           class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-xs">
                            {{ cat.products_count }} کالا
                        </a>
                    {% else %}
                        <span class="text-xs text-gray-300">--</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right" data-label="وضعیت">
                    {% if cat.is_active %}
                        <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">فعال</span>
                    {% else %}
                        <span class="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">غیرفعال</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                    {% if 'categories.manage' in user_permissions %}
                        <a href="{% url 'products:category_edit' cat.pk %}"
                           class="text-yellow-600 hover:text-yellow-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-yellow-50">ویرایش</a>
                        {% if cat.products_count == 0 %}
                        <a href="{% url 'products:category_delete' cat.pk %}"
                           class="text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-red-50">حذف</a>
                        {% endif %}
                    {% else %}
                    <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">--</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
            </tr>
            {% empty %}
            <tr>
                <td colspan="6" class="text-center py-12 text-gray-400">دسته‌بندی‌ای یافت نشد</td>
            </tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

{% endblock %}

{% block fab %}
{% if 'categories.manage' in user_permissions %}
<a href="{% url 'products:category_create' %}" class="app-fab" title="دسته‌بندی جدید" aria-label="دسته‌بندی جدید">
    <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
    </svg>
</a>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}{{ product.name }}{% endblock %}

{% block mobile_leading %}
<a href="{% url 'products:list' %}" class="app-topbar-btn" aria-label="بازگشت">
    <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/>
    </svg>
</a>
{% endblock %}

{% block mobile_title %}{{ product.name }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

{% load fa_numbers %}

<div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
    <a href="{% url 'products:list' %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm">← بازگشت به لیست</a>
    <div class="flex gap-2">
        {% if product.is_deleted and 'products.delete' in user_permissions %}
        <a href="{% url 'products:restore' product.pk %}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700 text-sm">♻️ بازگرداندن</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if 'products.edit' in user_permissions and not product.is_deleted %}
        <a href="{% url 'products:edit' product.pk %}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-yellow-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-yellow-600 text-sm">✏️ ویرایش</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if 'products.delete' in user_permissions and not product.is_deleted %}
        <a href="{% url 'products:delete' product.pk %}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-red-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-600 text-sm">🗑 حذف</a>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>

{% if product.is_deleted %}
<div class="bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-800 p-4 rounded-xl mb-6 flex items-start gap-3">
    <span class="text-2xl flex-shrink-0">⚠️</span>
    <div>
        <div class="font-bold">این کالا حذف نرم شده است</div>
        <div class="text-sm mt-1">
            تاریخ حذف:
            <strong>{{ product.deleted_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</strong>
            {% if product.is_used %}
            — این کالا در فاکتورها یا گردش انبار استفاده شده و به‌همین‌دلیل حذف کامل نشده.
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </div>
</div>
{% endif %}

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 mb-6">
    <div class="flex items-start gap-5">
        <div class="w-16 h-16 bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center text-2xl">
            📦
        </div>
        <div class="flex-1">
            <h1 class="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800">{{ product.name }}</h1>
            <p class="text-gray-500 font-mono text-sm mt-1" dir="ltr">{{ product.code }}</p>
            <div class="flex gap-2 mt-3 flex-wrap">
                {% if product.category %}
                <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-700">
                    {{ product.category.icon }} {{ product.category.name }}
                </span>
                {% endif %}
                {% if not product.is_active %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-200 text-gray-700">غیرفعال</span>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 mb-6">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm mb-1">قیمت فروش</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ product.price|floatformat:0 }} <span class="text-sm font-normal text-gray-500">تومان</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm mb-1">قیمت خرید</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ product.cost_price|floatformat:0 }} <span class="text-sm font-normal text-gray-500">تومان</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm mb-1">حاشیه سود</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold {% if product.profit_margin > 0 %}text-green-600{% else %}text-red-600{% endif %}">
            {{ product.profit_margin }}%
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4">موجودی</h2>
        <dl class="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">موجودی فعلی:</dt>
                <dd class="font-bold {% if product.stock_status == 'out' %}text-red-600{% elif product.stock_status == 'low' %}text-yellow-600{% else %}text-green-600{% endif %}">
                    {{ product.stock }} {{ product.unit }}
                </dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">حداقل موجودی:</dt>

                <dt class="text-gray-500">وضعیت:</dt>
                <dd>
                    {% if product.stock_status == 'out' %}
                        <span class="text-red-600">❌ ناموجود</span>
                    {% elif product.stock_status == 'low' %}
                        <span class="text-yellow-600">⚠️ موجودی کم</span>
                    {% else %}
                        <span class="text-green-600">✅ موجود</span>
                    {% endif %}

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4">اطلاعات</h2>
        <dl class="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">واحد:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800">{{ product.unit }}</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">تاریخ ایجاد:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800">{{ product.created_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">آخرین ویرایش:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800">{{ product.updated_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</dd>
            </div>
        </dl>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- کارت‌های آمار فروش -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6 mt-6">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-blue-500">

                <svg class="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                    <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"

<!-- آخرین فاکتورهای مرتبط -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-6">
    <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">📄</span>
            آخرین فاکتورها
        </h2>
    </div>

    {% if recent_items %}
    <table class="w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">فاکتور</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">مشتری</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">تعداد</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">مبلغ</th>
                <th class="text-right px-6 py-2.5 font-medium">تاریخ</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for item in recent_items %}
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50">
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right">
                    <a href="{% url 'sales:detail' item.invoice.pk %}" class="text-blue-600 font-mono text-xs hover:underline" dir="ltr">{{ item.invoice.number }}</a>
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs">
                    <a href="{% url 'customers:detail' item.invoice.customer.pk %}" class="text-gray-700 hover:text-blue-600">{{ item.invoice.customer.name }}</a>
                </td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs">{{ item.quantity }} {{ product.unit }}</td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs font-bold" dir="ltr">{{ item.total_price|floatformat:0 }}</td>
                <td class="px-6 py-3 text-right text-xs text-gray-500" dir="ltr">{{ item.invoice.issue_date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}</td>
            </tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
    {% else %}
    <div class="text-center py-8 text-gray-400 text-sm">
        این کالا هنوز در هیچ فاکتوری ثبت نشده
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

{% if product.description %}
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 mt-6">
    <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4">توضیحات</h2>
    <p class="text-gray-700 text-sm leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap">{{ product.description }}</p>
</div>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}ورود کالاها از Excel{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="mb-6">

</div>

<h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-6">ورود کالاها از Excel</h1>

<div class="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">📤</span>

        </h2>

        <form method="post" enctype="multipart/form-data" class="space-y-4">

                       class="w-full px-4 py-2.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-lg file:border-0 file:bg-blue-50 file:text-blue-700 file:font-medium hover:file:bg-blue-100 cursor-pointer text-sm">
            </div>

            <div class="flex gap-3 pt-2 flex-wrap">
                <button type="submit"
                        class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm font-medium">

                <a href="{% url 'products:excel_template' %}"
                   class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm font-medium flex items-center gap-2">

    <div class="bg-blue-50 rounded-xl p-6 text-sm text-blue-900 h-fit">
        <h2 class="font-bold mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">💡 راهنما</h2>
        <ol class="space-y-2 list-decimal list-inside leading-relaxed">
            <li>قالب Excel را دانلود کنید</li>
            <li>ردیف‌ها را طبق ستون‌ها پر کنید</li>
            <li>فایل را اینجا بارگذاری کنید</li>
            <li>پیش‌نمایش را بررسی کنید</li>
            <li>فقط ردیف‌های معتبر ذخیره می‌شوند</li>
        </ol>

        <div class="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-blue-200">
            <div class="font-medium mb-2">ستون‌های الزامی:</div>
            <div class="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 bg-blue-200 rounded text-xs">نام کالا</span>
                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 bg-blue-200 rounded text-xs">کد کالا</span>
                <span class="px-2 py-0.5 bg-blue-200 rounded text-xs">دسته‌بندی</span>

        </div>

        <div class="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-blue-200">
            <div class="font-medium mb-2">نکات مهم:</div>
            <ul class="space-y-1 text-xs leading-relaxed">
                <li>• دسته‌بندی: نام یا slug دسته</li>
                <li>• موجودی اولیه در انبار ثبت می‌شود</li>
                <li>• کد کالا باید یکتا باشد</li>
            </ul>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}پیش‌نمایش ورود کالاها{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="mb-6">
    <a href="{% url 'products:excel_import' %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm">← بارگذاری فایل دیگر</a>
</div>

<h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-6">پیش‌نمایش ورود کالاها</h1>

<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 mb-6">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-gray-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">کل ردیف‌ها</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ result.total }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-green-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">معتبر (قابل ذخیره)</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600 mt-1">{{ result.valid }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-red-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-sm">نامعتبر (نادیده گرفته می‌شود)</div>
        <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-red-600 mt-1">{{ result.invalid }}</div>
    </div>
</div>

{% if result.invalid %}
<div class="bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-xl p-4 mb-6 text-sm text-yellow-800 flex items-start gap-3">
    <span class="text-lg">⚠️</span>
    <div>
        ردیف‌های نامعتبر با پس‌زمینه‌ی قرمز مشخص شده‌اند. این ردیف‌ها هنگام ذخیره نادیده گرفته می‌شوند.
    </div>
</div>
{% endif %}

<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-6">
    <div class="overflow-x-auto">
        <table class="w-full text-sm">
            <thead class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
                <tr class="text-gray-600">
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">#</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">وضعیت</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">نام کالا</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">کد</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">دسته</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">قیمت</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">موجودی</th>
                    <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">خطاها</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
                {% for row in result.rows %}
                <tr class="{% if not row.is_valid %}bg-red-50{% endif %}">
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-xs text-gray-500 text-right">{{ row.row_num }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                        {% if row.is_valid %}
                            <span class="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">✓ معتبر</span>
                        {% else %}
                            <span class="inline-block px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">✗ نامعتبر</span>
                        {% endif %}
                    </td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">{{ row.data.name|default:"—" }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs" dir="ltr">{{ row.data.code|default:"—" }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs">
                        {% if row.data.category %}
                            {{ row.data.category.icon }} {{ row.data.category.name }}
                        {% else %}
                            —
                        {% endif %}
                    </td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs" dir="ltr">{{ row.data.price|default:"—" }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs" dir="ltr">{{ row.data.stock|default:0 }}</td>
                    <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-xs">
                        {% if row.errors %}
                            <ul class="text-red-700 space-y-0.5">
                                {% for err in row.errors %}
                                    <li>• {{ err }}</li>
                                {% endfor %}
                            </ul>
                        {% else %}
                            <span class="text-green-600">—</span>
                        {% endif %}
                    </td>
                </tr>
                {% endfor %}
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>
</div>

<form method="post" class="flex gap-3 flex-wrap">
    {% csrf_token %}
    {% if result.valid %}
        <button type="submit" name="action" value="confirm"
                class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700 text-sm font-medium">
            ✓ ذخیره‌ی {{ result.valid }} ردیف معتبر
        </button>
    {% endif %}
    <button type="submit" name="action" value="cancel"
            class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm font-medium">
        انصراف
    </button>
</form>

{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}{{ title }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

<div class="mb-6">
    <a href="{% url 'products:list' %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm">← بازگشت به لیست</a>
</div>

<h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-6">{{ title }}</h1>

<form method="post" class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
    {% csrf_token %}

    {% if form.errors %}
    <div class="bg-red-50 text-red-700 p-4 rounded-lg mb-6 text-sm">
        <strong>لطفاً خطاهای زیر را برطرف کنید:</strong>
        <ul class="mt-2 list-disc list-inside">
            {% for field, errors in form.errors.items %}
                {% for error in errors %}
                    <li>{{ field }}: {{ error }}</li>
                {% endfor %}
            {% endfor %}
        </ul>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-5">
        <div class="md:col-span-2">
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">نام کالا <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
            {{ form.name }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">کد کالا (SKU) <span class="text-red-500">*</span></label>
            {{ form.code }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">دسته‌بندی</label>
            {{ form.category }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">قیمت فروش (تومان)</label>
            {{ form.price }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">قیمت خرید (تومان)</label>
            {{ form.cost_price }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">موجودی</label>
            {{ form.stock }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">واحد</label>
            {{ form.unit }}
        </div>

        <div>
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">حداقل موجودی (هشدار)</label>
            {{ form.min_stock }}
        </div>

        <div class="flex items-end pb-3">
            <label class="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm cursor-pointer">
                {{ form.is_active }}
                <span>کالای فعال</span>
            </label>
        </div>

        <div class="md:col-span-2">
            <label class="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1.5">توضیحات</label>
            {{ form.description }}
        </div>
    </div>

    <div class="flex gap-3 mt-8 pt-6 border-t border-gray-100">
        <button type="submit" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 text-sm font-medium">
            {{ submit_label }}
        </button>
        <a href="{% url 'products:list' %}" class="px-6 py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-200 text-sm font-medium">
            انصراف
        </a>
    </div>
</form>

{% endblock %}
```
