```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}کالاها{% endblock %}
{% block mobile_title %}کالاها{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

{% load fa_numbers %}

<!-- Header -->
<div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:justify-between md:items-center gap-4 mb-6">
    <div>
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">
            {% if show_deleted %}
                کالاهای حذف‌شده
            {% else %}
                کالاها و موجودی
            {% endif %}
        </h1>
        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
            {% if show_deleted %}
                کالاهایی که حذف نرم شده‌اند -- قابل بازگرداندن
            {% else %}
                مدیریت محصولات و کنترل انبار
            {% endif %}
        </p>
    </div>
    <div class="action-buttons action-buttons-hidden-mobile flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-2 flex-wrap">
        {% if 'categories.view' in user_permissions %}
        <a href="{% url 'products:category_list' %}"
           class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-purple-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-purple-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm">
            دسته‌بندی‌ها
        </a>
        {% endif %}

        {% if stats.deleted > 0 and 'products.delete' in user_permissions %}
            {% if show_deleted %}
                <a href="{% url 'products:list' %}"
                   class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-gray-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm">
                    بازگشت به کالاهای فعال
                </a>
            {% else %}
                <a href="{% url 'products:list' %}?show=deleted"
                   class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-red-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm">
                    کالاهای حذف‌شده ({{ stats.deleted }})
                </a>
            {% endif %}
        {% endif %}

        {% if 'products.add' in user_permissions and not show_deleted %}
        <a href="{% url 'products:excel_import' %}"
           class="px-4 py-2.5 bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm">
            <svg class="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2"
                      d="M7 16a4 4 0 01-.88-7.903A5 5 0 1115.9 6L16 6a5 5 0 011 9.9M15 13l-3-3m0 0l-3 3m3-3v12"/>
            </svg>
            ورود از Excel
        </a>
        {% endif %}

        {% if 'products.add' in user_permissions and not show_deleted %}
        <a href="{% url 'products:create' %}"
           class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
            <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
                <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
            </svg>
            کالای جدید
        </a>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>

<!-- Stat cards -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3 md:gap-4 mb-6">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-blue-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs md:text-sm">کل کالاها</div>
        <div class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.total }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-green-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs md:text-sm">فعال</div>
        <div class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.active }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-yellow-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs md:text-sm">موجودی کم</div>
        <div class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.low_stock }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-red-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs md:text-sm">ناموجود</div>
        <div class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.out_of_stock }}</div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- Filters -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm mb-6">
    <form method="get" class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row flex-wrap gap-3 sm:items-center">
        {% if show_deleted %}
            <input type="hidden" name="show" value="deleted">
        {% endif %}

        <div class="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
            <input type="text" name="q" value="{{ search }}"
                   placeholder="جستجو نام، کد یا توضیحات..."
                   class="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm">
        </div>

        <select name="category" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
            <option value="">همه دسته‌ها</option>
            {% for cat in categories %}
                <option value="{{ cat.slug }}" {% if current_category == cat.slug %}selected{% endif %}>
                    {{ cat.icon }} {{ cat.name }}
                </option>
            {% endfor %}
        </select>

        <select name="status" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
            <option value="">همه وضعیت‌ها</option>
            <option value="active" {% if current_status == 'active' %}selected{% endif %}>فعال</option>
            <option value="inactive" {% if current_status == 'inactive' %}selected{% endif %}>غیرفعال</option>
            <option value="low_stock" {% if current_status == 'low_stock' %}selected{% endif %}>موجودی کم</option>
            <option value="out_of_stock" {% if current_status == 'out_of_stock' %}selected{% endif %}>ناموجود</option>
        </select>

        <button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-blue-700">
            اعمال فیلتر
        </button>

        {% if search or current_category or current_status %}
        <a href="{% url 'products:list' %}{% if show_deleted %}?show=deleted{% endif %}"
           class="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 text-center sm:text-right">پاک کردن</a>
        {% endif %}
    </form>
</div>

<!-- Desktop: table -->
<div class="hidden md:block bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">نام کالا</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">کد</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">دسته</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">قیمت فروش</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">موجودی</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">وضعیت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">عملیات</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for product in page_obj %}
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition {% if product.is_deleted %}opacity-75{% endif %}">
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <div class="font-medium {% if product.is_deleted %}line-through text-gray-400{% else %}text-gray-800{% endif %}">
                        {{ product.name }}
                    </div>
                    {% if product.is_deleted %}
                    <div class="text-xs text-red-600 mt-0.5">
                        حذف‌شده -- {{ product.deleted_at|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}
                    </div>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600 font-mono text-xs">
                    <span dir="ltr">{{ product.code }}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600 text-xs">
                    {% if product.category %}
                        {{ product.category.icon }} {{ product.category.name }}
                    {% else %}
                        --
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-800 font-medium">
                    <span dir="ltr">{{ product.price|floatformat:0 }}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <span class="font-bold {% if product.stock_status == 'out' %}text-red-600{% elif product.stock_status == 'low' %}text-yellow-600{% else %}text-green-600{% endif %}">
                        {{ product.stock }}
                    </span>
                    <span class="text-xs text-gray-400">{{ product.unit }}</span>
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                    {% if product.is_deleted %}
                        <span class="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">حذف‌شده</span>
                    {% elif product.stock_status == 'out' %}
                        <span class="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">ناموجود</span>
                    {% elif product.stock_status == 'low' %}
                        <span class="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-700">موجودی کم</span>
                    {% elif not product.is_active %}
                        <span class="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-200 text-gray-700">غیرفعال</span>
                    {% else %}
                        <span class="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">موجود</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                    <div class="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <a href="{% url 'products:detail' product.pk %}"
                           class="text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-blue-50">
                            جزئیات
                        </a>
                        {% if product.is_deleted %}
                            {% if 'products.delete' in user_permissions %}
                            <a href="{% url 'products:restore' product.pk %}"
                               class="text-green-600 hover:text-green-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-green-50">
                                بازگردان
                            </a>
                            {% endif %}
                        {% else %}
                            {% if 'products.edit' in user_permissions %}
                            <a href="{% url 'products:edit' product.pk %}"
                               class="text-yellow-600 hover:text-yellow-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-yellow-50">
                                ویرایش
                            </a>
                            {% endif %}
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                </td>
            </tr>
            {% empty %}
            <tr>
                <td colspan="7" class="text-center py-12 text-gray-400">
                    {% if show_deleted %}
                        کالای حذف‌شده‌ای وجود ندارد
                    {% else %}
                        کالایی یافت نشد
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
            </tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

<!-- ===== MOBILE CARDS START ===== -->
<div class="md:hidden space-y-3">
    {% for product in page_obj %}
    <article class="bg-white rounded-2xl border shadow-sm overflow-hidden
        {% if product.is_deleted %}opacity-75 border-red-200
        {% elif product.stock_status == 'out' %}border-red-200
        {% elif product.stock_status == 'low' %}border-yellow-200
        {% else %}border-gray-100{% endif %}">
        <!-- Header -->
        <header class="px-4 py-3 flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-gray-100">
            <div class="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-500 to-blue-600 text-white flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M20 7l-8-4-8 4m16 0l-8 4m8-4v10l-8 4m0-10L4 7m8 4v10M4 7v10l8 4"/></svg>
            </div>
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div class="font-bold text-gray-900 truncate {% if product.is_deleted %}line-through text-gray-400{% endif %}">{{ product.name }}</div>
                <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono truncate" dir="ltr">{{ product.code }}</div>
            </div>
            {% if product.is_deleted %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500"></span>حذف‌شده</span>
            {% elif product.stock_status == 'out' %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500"></span>ناموجود</span>
            {% elif product.stock_status == 'low' %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-700 border border-yellow-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-yellow-500"></span>موجودی کم</span>
            {% elif not product.is_active %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border border-gray-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-gray-500"></span>غیرفعال</span>
            {% else %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-green-50 text-green-700 border border-green-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-green-500"></span>موجود</span>
            {% endif %}
        </header>
        <!-- Hero: Price -->
        <div class="px-4 py-3 border-b border-gray-100 flex items-end justify-between gap-3">
            <div>
                <div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 font-semibold mb-1">قیمت فروش</div>
                <div class="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900" dir="ltr">{{ product.price|floatformat:0 }} <span class="text-xs font-normal text-gray-500">تومان</span></div>
            </div>
            <div class="text-left">
                <div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 font-semibold mb-1">موجودی</div>
                <div class="text-base font-bold {% if product.stock_status == 'out' %}text-red-600{% elif product.stock_status == 'low' %}text-yellow-600{% else %}text-green-600{% endif %}">
                    {{ product.stock }} <span class="text-xs font-normal text-gray-400">{{ product.unit }}</span>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
        <!-- Meta -->
        <div class="px-4 py-2 space-y-1.5">
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs gap-3">
                <span class="text-gray-400">دسته</span>
                <span class="font-medium text-gray-800 truncate">{% if product.category %}{{ product.category.icon }} {{ product.category.name }}{% else %}--{% endif %}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs gap-3">
                <span class="text-gray-400">حداقل موجودی</span>
                <span class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ product.min_stock }} {{ product.unit }}</span>
            </div>
            {% if product.is_deleted %}
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs gap-3">
                <span class="text-gray-400">تاریخ حذف</span>
                <span class="font-medium text-red-600" dir="ltr">{{ product.deleted_at|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
        <!-- Actions -->
        <div class="px-4 py-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex gap-2">
            <a href="{% url 'products:detail' product.pk %}" class="flex-1 text-center py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-medium active:bg-blue-700 transition">جزئیات</a>
            {% if product.is_deleted %}
                {% if 'products.delete' in user_permissions %}
                <a href="{% url 'products:restore' product.pk %}" class="flex-1 text-center py-2.5 bg-green-50 text-green-700 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium active:bg-green-100 transition">بازگردان</a>
                {% endif %}
            {% else %}
                {% if 'products.edit' in user_permissions %}
                <a href="{% url 'products:edit' product.pk %}" class="flex-1 text-center py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium active:bg-gray-200 transition">ویرایش</a>
                {% endif %}
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </article>
    {% empty %}
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 p-8 text-center text-gray-400 text-sm">{% if show_deleted %}کالای حذف‌شده‌ای وجود ندارد{% else %}کالایی یافت نشد{% endif %}</div>
    {% endfor %}
</div>
<!-- ===== MOBILE CARDS END ===== -->


{% if page_obj.has_other_pages %}
<div class="flex justify-center mt-6 gap-2 flex-wrap">
    {% if page_obj.has_previous %}
        <a href="?page={{ page_obj.previous_page_number }}{% if show_deleted %}&show=deleted{% endif %}{% if search %}&q={{ search }}{% endif %}{% if current_category %}&category={{ current_category }}{% endif %}{% if current_status %}&status={{ current_status }}{% endif %}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 text-sm">
            قبلی
        </a>
    {% endif %}
    <span class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm">
        صفحه {{ page_obj.number }} از {{ page_obj.paginator.num_pages }}
    </span>
    {% if page_obj.has_next %}
        <a href="?page={{ page_obj.next_page_number }}{% if show_deleted %}&show=deleted{% endif %}{% if search %}&q={{ search }}{% endif %}{% if current_category %}&category={{ current_category }}{% endif %}{% if current_status %}&status={{ current_status }}{% endif %}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 text-sm">
            بعدی
        </a>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}

{% block fab %}
{% if 'products.add' in user_permissions %}
<a href="{% url 'products:create' %}" class="app-fab" title="کالای جدید" aria-label="کالای جدید">
    <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
    </svg>
</a>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}
```

```html
            <span class="text-3xl">♻️</span>

        <h1 class="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800 mb-2">بازگرداندن کالا؟</h1>
```

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}

{% block title %}{{ invoice.number }}{% endblock %}

{% block mobile_leading %}
<a href="{% url 'customers:hub' %}?tab=invoice" class="app-topbar-btn" aria-label="بازگشت">
    <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M9 5l7 7-7 7"/>
    </svg>
</a>
{% endblock %}

{% block mobile_title %}{{ invoice.number }}{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

{% load fa_numbers %}

<div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-6">
    <a href="{% url 'customers:hub' %}?tab=invoice" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline text-sm">← بازگشت به لیست</a>
    <div class="flex gap-2">
        {% if 'invoices.print' in user_permissions %}
        <a href="{% url 'sales:print' invoice.pk %}" target="_blank" class="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-700 text-sm">🖨 چاپ</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if 'invoices.edit' in user_permissions %}
        <a href="{% url 'sales:edit' invoice.pk %}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-yellow-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-yellow-600 text-sm">✏️ ویرایش</a>
        {% endif %}
        {% if 'invoices.delete' in user_permissions %}
        <a href="{% url 'sales:delete' invoice.pk %}" class="px-4 py-2 bg-red-500 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-red-600 text-sm">🗑 حذف</a>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
</div>

<!-- هدر فاکتور -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 mb-6">
    <div class="flex justify-between items-start">
        <div>
            <div class="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-1">شماره فاکتور</div>
            <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 font-mono" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.number }}</div>

            <div class="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2">
                {% if invoice.status == 'draft' %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
                {% elif invoice.status == 'issued' %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-700">{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
                {% elif invoice.status == 'paid' %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
                {% else %}
                    <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
                {% endif %}
                <span class="px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-purple-100 text-purple-700">{{ invoice.get_payment_type_display }}</span>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="text-left">
            <div class="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-1">مبلغ نهایی</div>
            <div class="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-700" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.total|floatformat:0 }}</div>
            <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 text-left">تومان</div>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- مشتری -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 mb-6">
    <div class="flex justify-between items-start">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-green-100 text-green-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">👤</span>
            مشتری
        </h2>
        {% if 'calls.add' in user_permissions %}
        <a href="{% url 'calls:create' %}?customer={{ invoice.customer.pk }}"
           class="text-xs px-3 py-1.5 bg-green-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-green-700 flex items-center gap-1">
            📞 ثبت تماس
        </a>
        {% endif %}
    </div>
    <a href="{% url 'customers:detail' invoice.customer.pk %}" class="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 -m-3 rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-50 transition">
        <div class="w-14 h-14 bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xl">
            {{ invoice.customer.name|first|upper }}
        </div>
        <div class="flex-1">
            <div class="font-bold text-gray-800">{{ invoice.customer.name }}</div>
            <div class="text-sm text-gray-500 font-mono" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.customer.mobile }}</div>
            {% if invoice.customer.email %}
            <div class="text-xs text-gray-400" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.customer.email }}</div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
        <span class="text-xs text-blue-600 font-medium">مشاهده پروفایل ←</span>
    </a>
</div>

<!-- اقلام فاکتور -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-hidden mb-6">
    <div class="px-6 py-4 border-b border-gray-100">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="w-7 h-7 bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-600 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center text-sm">📦</span>
            اقلام فاکتور
        </h2>
    </div>
    <table class="w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">#</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">کالا</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">تعداد</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">قیمت واحد</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium">جمع</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for item in items %}
            <tr>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-gray-500 text-xs text-right">{{ forloop.counter }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <div class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ item.product.name }}</div>
                    <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono" dir="ltr">{{ item.product.code }}</div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-700">{{ item.quantity }} {{ item.product.unit }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-700" dir="ltr">{{ item.unit_price|floatformat:0 }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ item.total_price|floatformat:0 }}</td>
            </tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

<!-- مبالغ -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4">اطلاعات فاکتور</h2>
        <dl class="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">تاریخ صدور:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.issue_date|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</dd>
            </div>
            {% if invoice.due_date %}
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">مهلت پرداخت:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.due_date|jdate:"Y/m/d" }}</dd>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">ایجادکننده:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800">
                    {% if invoice.created_by %}
                        {{ invoice.created_by.get_full_name|default:invoice.created_by.username }}
                    {% else %}
                        —
                    {% endif %}
                </dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">تاریخ ایجاد:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800 text-xs">{{ invoice.created_at|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</dd>
            </div>
        </dl>
    </div>

    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6">
        <h2 class="font-bold text-gray-700 mb-4">خلاصه مالی</h2>
        <dl class="space-y-3 text-sm">
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">جمع اقلام:</dt>
                <dd class="text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.subtotal|floatformat:0 }} تومان</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">تخفیف:</dt>
                <dd class="text-red-600" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.discount|floatformat:0 }} تومان</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between">
                <dt class="text-gray-500">مالیات ({{ invoice.tax_percent }}%):</dt>
                <dd class="text-yellow-600" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.tax_amount|floatformat:0 }} تومان</dd>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between pt-3 border-t border-gray-100">
                <dt class="font-bold text-gray-700">مبلغ نهایی:</dt>
                <dd class="font-bold text-blue-700 text-lg" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.total|floatformat:0 }} تومان</dd>
            </div>
        </dl>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ تاریخچه تغییرات (۷.۹) ═══ -->
```

```html
<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
     JS — autocomplete + add row + live totals (۷.۱۰)
     ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
<script>
(function () {
    'use strict';

    // ═══ دیکشنری کالاها ═══
    const productsData = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('products-data').textContent);

    // ═══ رفرنس‌ها ═══
    const container = document.getElementById('items-container');
    const emptyTpl = document.getElementById('empty-row-template');
    const totalFormsInput = document.querySelector('[name=items-TOTAL_FORMS]');
    const addRowBtn = document.getElementById('add-row-btn');
    const discountInput = document.querySelector('[name=discount]');
    const taxInput = document.querySelector('[name=tax_percent]');

    // ═══ ابزار: فرمت عدد ═══
    const fmt = (n) => Number(n || 0).toLocaleString('en-US');

    // ═══ محاسبه‌ی یک ردیف ═══
    function calcRow(row) {
        const qty = parseFloat(row.querySelector('.item-qty')?.value) || 0;
        const price = parseFloat(row.querySelector('.item-price')?.value) || 0;
        const total = qty * price;
        const cell = row.querySelector('.row-total');
        if (cell) cell.textContent = fmt(total);
        return total;
    }

    // ═══ محاسبه‌ی همه + خلاصه ═══
    function calcAll() {
        let subtotal = 0;
        container.querySelectorAll('.item-row').forEach((row) => {
            // اگه ردیف مخفی/حذف‌شده باشه، نادیده بگیر
            if (row.dataset.removed === '1') return;
            subtotal += calcRow(row);
        });

        const discount = parseFloat(discountInput?.value) || 0;
        const taxPct = parseFloat(taxInput?.value) || 0;
        const afterDiscount = Math.max(subtotal - discount, 0);
        const taxAmount = Math.round(afterDiscount * taxPct / 100);
        const total = afterDiscount + taxAmount;

        document.getElementById('sum-subtotal').textContent = fmt(subtotal);
        document.getElementById('sum-discount').textContent = fmt(discount);
        document.getElementById('sum-tax').textContent = fmt(taxAmount);
        document.getElementById('sum-total').textContent = fmt(total);
    }

    // ═══ پر کردن خودکار قیمت ═══
    function fillPrice(row, product) {
        const priceInput = row.querySelector('.item-price');
        if (!priceInput || !product) return;

        // فقط اگه کاربر قبلاً قیمت دستی وارد نکرده، پر کن
        const currentPrice = parseFloat(priceInput.value) || 0;
        if (currentPrice === 0) {
            priceInput.value = product.price;
        }
        calcAll();
    }

    // ═══ مخفی کردن select اصلی + init search input ═══
    function initRow(row) {
        const wrapper = row.querySelector('.product-autocomplete');
        if (!wrapper) return;

        const select = wrapper.querySelector('select');
        const searchInput = wrapper.querySelector('.product-search');
        if (!select || !searchInput) return;

        // اگه مقدار انتخاب‌شده داره، در input نمایش بده
        const selectedOpt = select.options[select.selectedIndex];
        if (selectedOpt && selectedOpt.value) {
            searchInput.value = selectedOpt.textContent.trim();
        }

        // پاک کردن مقدار input در ردیف‌های خالی (جلوگیری از placeholder عجیب)
        if (!select.value && !searchInput.value) {
            searchInput.value = '';
        }
    }

    // ═══ رندر لیست پیشنهادها ═══
    function renderSuggestions(row, query) {
        const wrapper = row.querySelector('.product-autocomplete');
        const box = wrapper.querySelector('.product-suggestions');
        const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();

        if (!q) {
            box.classList.add('hidden');
            box.innerHTML = '';
            return;
        }

        const matches = productsData.filter((p) => {
            return p.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) || p.code.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        }).slice(0, 10);

        if (matches.length === 0) {
            box.innerHTML = '<div class="px-3 py-2 text-xs text-gray-400">کالایی یافت نشد</div>';
            box.classList.remove('hidden');
            return;
        }

        box.innerHTML = matches.map((p) => `
            <div class="product-suggestion px-3 py-2 hover:bg-blue-50 cursor-pointer border-b border-gray-100 last:border-b-0"
                 data-id="${p.id}"
                 data-price="${p.price}">
                <div class="flex justify-between items-center gap-2">
                    <div class="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <div class="font-medium text-gray-800 text-sm truncate">${escapeHtml(p.name)}</div>
                        <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono" dir="ltr">${escapeHtml(p.code)}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-xs text-blue-600 font-bold whitespace-nowrap" dir="ltr">${fmt(p.price)}</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        `).join('');

        box.classList.remove('hidden');
    }

    // ═══ escape HTML ═══
    function escapeHtml(str) {
        const div = document.createElement('div');
        div.textContent = str;
        return div.innerHTML;
    }

    // ═══ انتخاب پیشنهاد ═══
    function selectSuggestion(row, suggestionEl) {
        const wrapper = row.querySelector('.product-autocomplete');
        const select = wrapper.querySelector('select');
        const searchInput = wrapper.querySelector('.product-search');
        const box = wrapper.querySelector('.product-suggestions');

        const id = suggestionEl.dataset.id;
        const price = parseFloat(suggestionEl.dataset.price);
        const product = productsData.find((p) => String(p.id) === String(id));

        if (!product) return;

        select.value = id;
        searchInput.value = product.name;

        // Trigger change event برای سازگاری
        select.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));

        // پر کردن قیمت
        fillPrice(row, product);

        box.classList.add('hidden');
        box.innerHTML = '';
    }

    // ═══ اضافه کردن سطر جدید ═══
    function addRow() {
        if (!emptyTpl || !totalFormsInput) return;

        const newIndex = parseInt(totalFormsInput.value);
        const html = emptyTpl.innerHTML.replace(/__prefix__/g, newIndex);
        const tbody = container;
        const temp = document.createElement('tbody');
        temp.innerHTML = html.trim();
        const newRow = temp.firstElementChild;

        if (!newRow) return;

        tbody.appendChild(newRow);
        totalFormsInput.value = newIndex + 1;
        initRow(newRow);

        // فوکوس روی input جستجو
        const searchInput = newRow.querySelector('.product-search');
        if (searchInput) searchInput.focus();

        calcAll();
    }

    // ═══ حذف سطر ═══
    function removeRow(row) {
        // اگه سطر ذخیره‌شده (دارای pk) بود، DELETE رو تیک بزن و مخفی کن
        const deleteBox = row.querySelector('input[name$="-DELETE"]');
        if (deleteBox) {
            deleteBox.checked = true;
            row.dataset.removed = '1';
            row.style.display = 'none';
            calcAll();
            return;
        }

        // اگه سطر جدید بود، کاملاً حذف کن
        row.remove();
        calcAll();
    }

    // ═══ Event Delegation — کلیک روی پیشنهاد ═══
    container.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        // کلیک روی suggestion
        const suggestion = e.target.closest('.product-suggestion');
        if (suggestion) {
            const row = suggestion.closest('.item-row');
            if (row) selectSuggestion(row, suggestion);
            return;
        }

        // کلیک روی remove-row
        const removeBtn = e.target.closest('.remove-row');
        if (removeBtn) {
            const row = removeBtn.closest('.item-row');
            if (row) removeRow(row);
            return;
        }
    });

    // ═══ Event Delegation — input روی search ═══
    container.addEventListener('input', (e) => {
        // جستجوی کالا
        if (e.target.classList.contains('product-search')) {
            const row = e.target.closest('.item-row');
            if (row) renderSuggestions(row, e.target.value);
            return;
        }

        // تغییر تعداد یا قیمت → محاسبه
        if (e.target.classList.contains('item-qty') || e.target.classList.contains('item-price')) {
            calcAll();
        }
    });

    // ═══ مخفی کردن پیشنهادها وقتی کاربر فوکوس رو از دست می‌ده ═══
    container.addEventListener('focusout', (e) => {
        if (e.target.classList.contains('product-search')) {
            setTimeout(() => {
                const row = e.target.closest('.item-row');
                if (!row) return;
                const box = row.querySelector('.product-suggestions');
                if (box) {
                    box.classList.add('hidden');
                    box.innerHTML = '';
                }
            }, 200);
        }
    });

    // ═══ پاک کردن input → پاک کردن select ═══
    container.addEventListener('focusin', (e) => {
        if (e.target.classList.contains('product-search')) {
            // اگه input خالی شد، پیشنهادها رو نشون بده
            if (!e.target.value.trim()) {
                const row = e.target.closest('.item-row');
                if (row) {
                    const select = row.querySelector('.product-autocomplete select');
                    if (select) select.value = '';
                }
            }
        }
    });

    // ═══ discount/tax input → محاسبه ═══
    if (discountInput) discountInput.addEventListener('input', calcAll);
    if (taxInput) taxInput.addEventListener('input', calcAll);

    // ═══ دکمه‌ی افزودن سطر ═══
    if (addRowBtn) addRowBtn.addEventListener('click', addRow);

    // ═══ Init — همه‌ی ردیف‌های اولیه ═══
    container.querySelectorAll('.item-row').forEach(initRow);
    calcAll();

})();
</script>

{% endblock %}
```

#### `templates/sales/list.html` _(16,875 bytes, text)_

```html
{% extends 'base.html' %}
{% load query_helpers %}

{% block title %}فاکتورها{% endblock %}
{% block mobile_title %}فاکتورها{% endblock %}

{% block content %}

{% load fa_numbers %}

<!-- Header -->
<div class="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:justify-between md:items-center gap-4 mb-6">
    <div>
        <h1 class="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800">فاکتورها</h1>
        <p class="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">مدیریت فاکتورهای فروش</p>
    </div>
    {% if 'invoices.add' in user_permissions %}
    <div class="action-buttons-hidden-mobile"><a href="{% url 'sales:create' %}"
       class="px-5 py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg hover:bg-blue-700 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
        <svg class="w-5 h-5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
        </svg>
        فاکتور جدید
    </a></div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<!-- Stat cards -->
<div class="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-5 gap-3 md:gap-4 mb-6">
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-gray-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs md:text-sm">کل فاکتورها</div>
        <div class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.total }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-gray-400">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs md:text-sm">پیش‌نویس</div>
        <div class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.draft }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-blue-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs md:text-sm">صادر شده</div>
        <div class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.issued }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-green-500">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs md:text-sm">پرداخت شده</div>
        <div class="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">{{ stats.paid }}</div>
    </div>
    <div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 shadow-sm border-t-4 border-purple-500 col-span-2 md:col-span-1">
        <div class="text-gray-500 text-xs md:text-sm">مجموع فروش</div>
        <div class="text-base md:text-lg font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1" dir="ltr">{{ stats.total_amount|floatformat:0 }}</div>
        <div class="text-xs text-gray-400">تومان</div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- Filters -->
<div class="bg-white rounded-xl p-4 shadow-sm mb-6">
    <form method="get" class="space-y-3">
        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row flex-wrap gap-3 sm:items-center">
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
                <input type="text" name="q" value="{{ search }}"
                       placeholder="جستجو شماره فاکتور یا نام مشتری..."
                       class="w-full px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm">
            </div>

            <select name="status" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
                <option value="">همه وضعیت‌ها</option>
                {% for value, label in status_choices %}
                    <option value="{{ value }}" {% if current_status == value %}selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>
                {% endfor %}
            </select>

            <select name="payment_type" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
                <option value="">همه پرداخت‌ها</option>
                {% for value, label in payment_choices %}
                    <option value="{{ value }}" {% if current_payment == value %}selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>
                {% endfor %}
            </select>

            <select name="employee" class="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500">
                <option value="">همه کارمندان</option>
                {% for emp in employees %}
                    <option value="{{ emp.id }}" {% if current_employee == emp.id|stringformat:"s" %}selected{% endif %}>
                        {{ emp.get_full_name|default:emp.username }}
                    </option>
                {% endfor %}
            </select>
        </div>

        <div class="flex flex-col sm:flex-row flex-wrap gap-3 sm:items-center">
            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <label class="text-xs text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap">از تاریخ:</label>
                <input type="text" name="from_date" value="{{ from_date }}" data-jdp
                       placeholder="۱۴۰۵/۰۱/۰۱" autocomplete="off"
                       class="flex-1 sm:flex-none sm:w-32 px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm" dir="ltr">
            </div>

            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <label class="text-xs text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap">تا تاریخ:</label>
                <input type="text" name="to_date" value="{{ to_date }}" data-jdp
                       placeholder="۱۴۰۵/۱۲/۲۹" autocomplete="off"
                       class="flex-1 sm:flex-none sm:w-32 px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm" dir="ltr">
            </div>

            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <label class="text-xs text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap">از مبلغ:</label>
                <input type="text" name="amount_min" value="{{ amount_min }}"
                       placeholder="۰" autocomplete="off"
                       class="flex-1 sm:flex-none sm:w-32 px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm" dir="ltr">
            </div>

            <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
                <label class="text-xs text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap">تا مبلغ:</label>
                <input type="text" name="amount_max" value="{{ amount_max }}"
                       placeholder="۹۹۹۹۹۹۹" autocomplete="off"
                       class="flex-1 sm:flex-none sm:w-32 px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm" dir="ltr">
            </div>

            <button type="submit" class="px-5 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm hover:bg-blue-700">
                اعمال فیلتر
            </button>

            {% if has_filters %}
            <a href="{% url 'customers:hub' %}?tab=invoice" class="text-sm text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 text-center sm:text-right">پاک کردن فیلترها</a>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </form>

    {% if filtered_stats %}
    <div class="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-4 text-sm">
        <span class="text-gray-500">نتیجه‌ی فیلتر:</span>
        <span class="font-bold text-blue-700">{{ filtered_stats.count }} فاکتور</span>
        <span class="text-gray-400 hidden sm:inline">|</span>
        <span class="text-gray-500">مجموع:</span>
        <span class="font-bold text-purple-700" dir="ltr">{{ filtered_stats.total|floatformat:0 }} تومان</span>
    </div>
    {% endif %}
</div>

<!-- Desktop: table -->
<div class="hidden md:block bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm overflow-x-auto">
    <table class="w-full text-sm">
        <thead class="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
            <tr class="text-gray-600">
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">شماره</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">مشتری</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">اقلام</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">مبلغ نهایی</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">وضعیت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">پرداخت</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">تاریخ صدور</th>
                <th class="text-right px-4 py-3 font-medium whitespace-nowrap">عملیات</th>
            </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody class="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {% for invoice in page_obj %}
            <tr class="hover:bg-gray-50 transition">
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-mono text-xs">
                    <a href="{% url 'sales:detail' invoice.pk %}" class="text-blue-600 hover:underline" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.number }}</a>
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                    <div class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ invoice.customer.name }}</div>
                    <div class="text-xs text-gray-400 font-mono" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.customer.mobile }}</div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600 text-xs">{{ invoice.items_count }} قلم</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.total|floatformat:0 }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                    {% if invoice.status == 'draft' %}
                        <span class="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-700">{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% elif invoice.status == 'issued' %}
                        <span class="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-blue-100 text-blue-700">{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% elif invoice.status == 'paid' %}
                        <span class="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700">{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% else %}
                        <span class="inline-block px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs bg-red-100 text-red-700">{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
                    {% endif %}
                </td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-600 text-xs">{{ invoice.get_payment_type_display }}</td>
                <td class="px-4 py-3 text-right text-gray-500 text-xs" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.issue_date|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</td>

                        {% if 'invoices.print' in user_permissions %}
                        <a href="{% url 'sales:print' invoice.pk %}" target="_blank" class="text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-800 text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded hover:bg-gray-50">چاپ</a>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                </td>
            </tr>
            {% empty %}
            <tr>
                <td colspan="8" class="text-center py-12 text-gray-400">فاکتوری یافت نشد</td>
            </tr>
            {% endfor %}
        </tbody>
    </table>
</div>

<!-- ===== MOBILE CARDS START ===== -->
<div class="md:hidden space-y-3">
    {% for invoice in page_obj %}
    <article class="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <!-- Header -->
        <header class="px-4 py-3 flex items-start gap-3 border-b border-gray-100">
            <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400 font-mono mb-1" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.number }}</div>
                <div class="font-bold text-gray-900 truncate">{{ invoice.customer.name }}</div>
                <div class="text-xs text-gray-500 font-mono truncate" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.customer.mobile }}</div>
            </div>
            {% if invoice.status == 'draft' %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-gray-50 text-gray-700 border border-gray-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-gray-500"></span>{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
            {% elif invoice.status == 'issued' %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500"></span>{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
            {% elif invoice.status == 'paid' %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-green-50 text-green-700 border border-green-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-green-500"></span>{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
            {% else %}
                <span class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-medium bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200 whitespace-nowrap flex-shrink-0"><span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-red-500"></span>{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
            {% endif %}
        </header>
        <!-- Hero: Total -->
        <div class="px-4 py-3 bg-gradient-to-br from-purple-50 to-purple-100/50 border-b border-purple-100">
            <div class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-wider text-purple-700 font-semibold mb-1">مبلغ نهایی</div>
            <div class="text-xl font-bold text-purple-800" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.total|floatformat:0 }} <span class="text-xs font-normal">تومان</span></div>
        </div>
        <!-- Meta -->
        <div class="px-4 py-2 space-y-1.5">
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs gap-3">
                <span class="text-gray-400">اقلام</span>
                <span class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ invoice.items_count }} قلم</span>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs gap-3">
                <span class="text-gray-400">نوع پرداخت</span>
                <span class="font-medium text-gray-800">{{ invoice.get_payment_type_display }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="flex justify-between text-xs gap-3">
                <span class="text-gray-400">تاریخ صدور</span>
                <span class="font-medium text-gray-800" dir="ltr">{{ invoice.issue_date|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i" }}</span>
            </div>
        </div>
        <!-- Actions -->
        <div class="px-4 py-3 border-t border-gray-100 flex gap-2">
            <a href="{% url 'sales:detail' invoice.pk %}" class="flex-1 text-center py-2.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-medium active:bg-blue-700 transition">جزئیات</a>
            {% if 'invoices.print' in user_permissions %}
            <a href="{% url 'sales:print' invoice.pk %}" target="_blank" class="flex-1 text-center py-2.5 bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 rounded-xl text-sm font-medium active:bg-gray-200 transition">چاپ</a>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </article>
    {% empty %}
    <div class="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 p-8 text-center text-gray-400 text-sm">فاکتوری یافت نشد</div>
    {% endfor %}
</div>
<!-- ===== MOBILE CARDS END ===== -->


{% if page_obj.has_other_pages %}
<div class="flex justify-center mt-6 gap-2 flex-wrap">
    {% if page_obj.has_previous %}
        <a href="?{% querystring page=page_obj.previous_page_number %}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 text-sm">قبلی</a>
    {% endif %}
    <span class="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded-lg text-sm">صفحه {{ page_obj.number }} از {{ page_obj.paginator.num_pages }}</span>
    {% if page_obj.has_next %}
        <a href="?{% querystring page=page_obj.next_page_number %}"
           class="px-4 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-300 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50 text-sm">بعدی</a>
    {% endif %}
</div>
{% endif %}

{% endblock %}

{% block fab %}
{% if 'invoices.add' in user_permissions %}
<a href="{% url 'sales:create' %}" class="app-fab" title="فاکتور جدید" aria-label="فاکتور جدید">
    <svg class="w-6 h-6" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24">
        <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-width="2" d="M12 4v16m8-8H4"/>
    </svg>
</a>
{% endif %}
{% endblock %}
```

```html
{% load static %}
{% load fa_numbers %}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fa" dir="rtl">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>فاکتور {{ invoice.number }}</title>
    <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/rastikerdar/vazirmatn@v33.003/Vazirmatn-font-face.css" rel="stylesheet" />
    <style>
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        body {
            font-family: 'Vazirmatn', sans-serif;
            background: #f0f2f5;
            padding: 30px 15px;
            color: #2c3e50;
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .invoice-container {
            max-width: 850px;
            margin: 0 auto;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 12px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .invoice-header {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e3a5f 0%, #2E86AB 100%);
            color: white;
            padding: 30px 40px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .invoice-header::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -50%; left: -10%;
            width: 300px; height: 300px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .invoice-header::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -100px; right: -50px;
            width: 250px; height: 250px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .header-left {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 20px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .logo-box {
            width: 80px; height: 80px;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 16px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 10px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
        }

        .logo-box img {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: 100%;
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        .logo-placeholder {
            font-size: 36px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #2E86AB;
        }

        .company-info h1 {
            font-size: 22px;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .company-info p { font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.9; }

        .header-right {
            text-align: left;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        .invoice-title {
            font-size: 30px;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
        }

        .invoice-number {
            font-family: monospace;
            font-size: 16px;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
            padding: 6px 14px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: inline-block;
            direction: ltr;
        }

        .invoice-meta {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 0;
            border-bottom: 2px solid #e9ecef;
        }

        .meta-section { padding: 20px 30px; }
        .meta-section:first-child { border-left: 1px solid #e9ecef; }

        .meta-section h3 {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #7f8c8d;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            font-weight: normal;
        }

        .meta-item {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        .meta-item .label { color: #95a5a6; }
        .meta-item .value { color: #2c3e50; font-weight: 500; }

        .items-section { padding: 0; }

        .items-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; }
        .items-table thead { background: #f8f9fa; }

        .items-table th {
            padding: 14px 15px;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #495057;
            border-bottom: 2px solid #dee2e6;
            text-align: right;
        }

        .items-table th:first-child { text-align: center; width: 50px; }
        .items-table th:nth-child(3),
        .items-table th:nth-child(4),
        .items-table th:nth-child(5) { text-align: center; }

        .items-table td {
            padding: 14px 15px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #f1f3f5;
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .items-table td:first-child {
            text-align: center;
            color: #95a5a6;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .items-table td:nth-child(3),
        .items-table td:nth-child(4),
        .items-table td:nth-child(5) { text-align: center; }

        .items-table tbody tr:hover { background: #f8f9fa; }

        .product-name {
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #2c3e50;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .product-code {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: #95a5a6;
            font-family: monospace;
            direction: ltr;
        }

        .price-cell {
            font-family: monospace;
            direction: rtl;
        }

        .total-cell {
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #2E86AB;
        }

        .summary-section {
            padding: 25px 30px;
            background: #f8f9fa;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-start;
            gap: 30px;
        }

        .notes-box {
            flex: 1;
            background: white;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 15px 20px;
            border-right: 3px solid #2E86AB;
        }

        .notes-box h4 {

<body>

<div class="invoice-container">

    <!-- ═══ هدر ═══ -->
    <div class="invoice-header">
        <div class="header-left">
            <div class="logo-box">
                {% if company.logo_path %}
                    <img src="{% static company.logo_path %}" alt="{{ company.name }}"
                         onerror="this.style.display='none'; this.nextElementSibling.style.display='block';">
                    <span class="logo-placeholder" style="display: none;">D</span>
                {% else %}
                    <span class="logo-placeholder">D</span>
                {% endif %}
            </div>
            <div class="company-info">
                <h1>{{ company.name }}</h1>
                <p>{{ company.slogan }}</p>
            </div>
        </div>

        <div class="header-right">
            <div class="invoice-title">فاکتور فروش</div>
            <div class="invoice-number">{{ invoice.number }}</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ═══ اطلاعات مشتری و فاکتور ═══ -->
    <div class="invoice-meta">
        <div class="meta-section">
            <h3>مشخصات خریدار</h3>
            <div class="meta-item">
                <span class="label">نام:</span>
                <span class="value">{{ invoice.customer.name }}</span>
            </div>
            {% if invoice.customer.national_id %}
            <div class="meta-item">
                <span class="label">کد ملی:</span>
                <span class="value" style="font-family: monospace; direction: ltr;">{{ invoice.customer.national_id|fa_digits }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
            <div class="meta-item">
                <span class="label">شماره تماس:</span>
                <span class="value" style="font-family: monospace; direction: ltr;">{{ invoice.customer.mobile|fa_digits }}</span>
            </div>
            {% if invoice.customer.email %}
            <div class="meta-item">
                <span class="label">ایمیل:</span>
                <span class="value" style="font-family: monospace; direction: ltr;">{{ invoice.customer.email }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
            {% if invoice.customer.address %}
            <div class="meta-item">
                <span class="label">آدرس:</span>
                <span class="value" style="max-width: 200px; text-align: left; font-size: 11px;">{{ invoice.customer.address }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>

        <div class="meta-section">
            <h3>مشخصات فاکتور</h3>
            <div class="meta-item">
                <span class="label">تاریخ صدور:</span>
                <span class="value" style="direction: rtl;">{{ invoice.issue_date|jdate:"Y/m/d H:i"|fa_digits }}</span>
            </div>
            {% if invoice.due_date %}
            <div class="meta-item">
                <span class="label">مهلت پرداخت:</span>
                <span class="value" style="direction: rtl;">{{ invoice.due_date|jdate:"Y/m/d"|fa_digits }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
            <div class="meta-item">
                <span class="label">نوع پرداخت:</span>
                <span class="value">{{ invoice.get_payment_type_display }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="meta-item">
                <span class="label">وضعیت:</span>
                <span class="value">{{ invoice.get_status_display }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="meta-item">
                <span class="label">تعداد اقلام:</span>
                <span class="value">{{ items|length|fa_num }} قلم</span>
            </div>
            {% if invoice.created_by %}
            <div class="meta-item">
                <span class="label">صادرکننده:</span>
                <span class="value">{{ invoice.created_by.get_full_name|default:invoice.created_by.username }}</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ═══ جدول اقلام ═══ -->
    <div class="items-section">
        <table class="items-table">
            <thead>
                <tr>
                    <th>#</th>
                    <th>شرح کالا / خدمات</th>
                    <th>تعداد</th>
                    <th>قیمت واحد</th>
                    <th>جمع کل</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
                {% for item in items %}
                <tr>
                    <td>{{ forloop.counter|fa_num }}</td>
                    <td>
                        <div class="product-name">{{ item.product.name }}</div>
                        {% if item.product.code %}
                        <div class="product-code">{{ item.product.code }}</div>
                        {% endif %}
                    </td>
                    <td>
                        {{ item.quantity|fa_num }}
                        {% if item.product.unit %}<span style="font-size: 11px; color: #95a5a6;">{{ item.product.unit }}</span>{% endif %}
                    </td>
                    <td class="price-cell">{{ item.unit_price|fa_num }}</td>
                    <td class="price-cell total-cell">{{ item.total_price|fa_num }}</td>
                </tr>
                {% endfor %}
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>

    <!-- ═══ جمع کل ═══ -->
    <div class="summary-section">
        <div class="notes-box">
            <h4>📝 توضیحات</h4>
            {% if invoice.notes %}
                <p>{{ invoice.notes }}</p>
            {% else %}
                <p>شرایط پرداخت: طبق توافق طرفین</p>
            {% endif %}
        </div>

        <div class="totals-box">
            <div class="total-row">
                <span class="label">جمع اقلام:</span>
                <span class="value">{{ invoice.subtotal|fa_num }} تومان</span>
            </div>

            {% if invoice.discount %}
            <div class="total-row discount">
                <span class="label">تخفیف:</span>
                <span class="value">- {{ invoice.discount|fa_num }} تومان</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            {% if invoice.tax_amount %}
            <div class="total-row tax">
                <span class="label">مالیات ({{ invoice.tax_percent|floatformat:0|fa_digits }}٪):</span>
                <span class="value">+ {{ invoice.tax_amount|fa_num }} تومان</span>
            </div>
            {% endif %}

            <div class="total-row final">
                <span class="label">مبلغ قابل پرداخت:</span>
                <span class="value">{{ invoice.total|fa_num }} تومان</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ═══ اطلاعات بانکی ═══ -->
    {% if company.bank_info %}
    <div class="bank-section">
        <h4>🏦 اطلاعات حساب بانکی</h4>
        <div class="bank-grid">
            <div class="bank-item">
                <span class="label">بانک:</span>
                <span class="value">{{ company.bank_info.bank_name }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="bank-item">
                <span class="label">صاحب حساب:</span>
                <span class="value">{{ company.bank_info.account_holder }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="bank-item">
                <span class="label">شماره حساب:</span>
                <span class="value">{{ company.bank_info.account_number }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="bank-item">
                <span class="label">شماره کارت:</span>
                <span class="value">{{ company.bank_info.card_number }}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="bank-item" style="grid-column: 1 / -1;">
                <span class="label">شماره شبا:</span>
                <span class="value">{{ company.bank_info.iban }}</span>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    {% endif %}

    <!-- ═══ امضا ═══ -->
    <div class="signature-section">
        <div class="signature-box">
            <div class="title">مهر و امضای فروشنده</div>
            <div class="signature-line">{{ company.name }}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="signature-box">
            <div class="title">مهر و امضای خریدار</div>
            <div class="signature-line">{{ invoice.customer.name }}</div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ═══ فوتر ═══ -->
    <div class="invoice-footer">
        <div class="thanks">از خرید شما سپاسگزاریم 🌹</div>
        <div class="company-footer-info">
            <span>📍 {{ company.address }}</span>
            <span>📞 {{ company.phone }}</span>
            <span>✉️ {{ company.email }}</span>
            <span>🌐 {{ company.website }}</span>
        </div>
    </div>
</div>

<!-- ═══ دکمه‌های عملیات ═══ -->
<div class="print-actions">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="window.print()">
        🖨 چاپ / ذخیره PDF
    </button>
    <a href="{% url 'sales:detail' invoice.pk %}" class="btn btn-secondary">
        ← بازگشت
    </a>
</div>

<!-- ═══ کیبورد شورتکات ═══ -->
<script>
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if ((e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) && e.key === 'p') {
            e.preventDefault();
            window.print();
        }
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            window.history.back();
        }
    });
</script>

</body>
</html>
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Major Upgrade: Customer Hub with 5 Tabs (Info, Call, Followup, Visit, Invoice).
Applies DB changes, new views, new UI, and updates RBAC.
"""
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BACKUP_DIR = BASE / f'.upgrade_hub_backup_{datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")}'

def backup_file(path):
    if not path.exists(): return
    rel = path.relative_to(BASE)
    dest = BACKUP_DIR / rel
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(path, dest)

def patch_file(rel_path, replacements):
    p = BASE / rel_path
    if not p.exists(): return
    backup_file(p)
    content = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    for old, new in replacements:
        if new not in content:
            content = content.replace(old, new)
    p.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8')
    print(f"  OK Patched: {rel_path}")

def write_file(rel_path, content):
    p = BASE / rel_path
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if p.exists(): backup_file(p)
    p.write_text(content.lstrip("\n"), encoding='utf-8')
    print(f"  OK Created/Updated: {rel_path}")

    with open(BASE / 'customers/hub_views.py', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:

from django.contrib.auth.decorators import login_required
from django.contrib import messages
from django.db.models import Q
from django.utils import timezone
from accounts.permissions import require_permission
from .models import Customer, Visit
from .forms import HubCallForm, HubVisitForm
from calls.models import Call
from sales.models import Invoice

@login_required
@require_permission('customers.view')
def customer_hub(request):
    tab = request.GET.get('tab', 'info')
    
    customers = Customer.objects.all().order_by('-created_at')
    search = request.GET.get('q', '').strip()
    if search:
        customers = customers.filter(Q(name__icontains=search) | Q(mobile__icontains=search))
    
    followups = Call.objects.filter(is_followed_up=False, follow_up_date__isnull=False).order_by('follow_up_date')
    
    context = {
        'active_tab': tab,
        'customers': customers[:50],
        'followups': followups,
        'invoices': Invoice.objects.all().order_by('-created_at')[:20],
        'call_form': HubCallForm(),
        'visit_form': HubVisitForm(),
    }
    return render(request, 'customers/hub.html', context)

@login_required
@require_permission('customers.add')
def hub_submit_call(request):
    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = HubCallForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            mobile = form.cleaned_data['mobile']
            customer = Customer.objects.filter(mobile=mobile).first()
            is_new = False
            
            if not customer:
                is_new = True
                customer = Customer.objects.create(
                    mobile=mobile, 
                    name=form.cleaned_data['name'] or 'ناشناس',
                    status='lead',
                    created_by=request.user
                )
            
            # Update customer details based on call
            customer.customer_type = form.cleaned_data['customer_type']
            customer.installments_count = form.cleaned_data['installments_count']
            customer.cheques_count = form.cleaned_data['cheques_count']
            
            if form.cleaned_data['status'] == 'active':
                customer.is_lead = True
                customer.status = 'active'
                follow_up = None
            else:
                customer.status = 'lead'
                follow_up = form.cleaned_data['follow_up_date']
                
            customer.save()
            
            # Create Call Record
            Call.objects.create(
                customer=customer,
                caller_name=customer.name,
                call_number=mobile,
                call_type=form.cleaned_data['call_type'],
                purpose='sale',
                status='answered',
                notes=form.cleaned_data['notes'],
                called_by=request.user,
                created_by=request.user,
                follow_up_date=follow_up
            )

            return redirect(f"{request.path_info}?tab=followup" if follow_up else f"{request.path_info}?tab=info")
    messages.error(request, 'خطا در ثبت تماس.')
    return redirect('customers:hub')

@login_required
@require_permission('customers.add')
def hub_submit_visit(request):
    if request.method == 'POST':
        form = HubVisitForm(request.POST)
        if form.is_valid():
            visit = form.save(commit=False)
            visit.created_by = request.user
            visit.save()
            if visit.is_successful:

                return redirect('customers:hub') # Replace with actual file page later
            messages.success(request, 'مراجعه ثبت شد.')
            return redirect(f"{request.path_info}?tab=visit")
    return redirect('customers:hub')
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Major Upgrade V2: Premium Customer Hub (5 Tabs) + Route Merging & UI/UX Polish.
"""
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BACKUP_DIR = BASE / f'.hub_v2_backup_{datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d_%H%M%S")}'

def backup_file(path):
    if not path.exists(): return
    rel = path.relative_to(BASE)
    dest = BACKUP_DIR / rel
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copy2(path, dest)

def patch_file(rel_path, replacements):
    p = BASE / rel_path
    if not p.exists(): return
    backup_file(p)
    content = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
    for old, new in replacements:
        if new not in content:
            content = content.replace(old, new)
    p.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8')
    print(f"  OK Patched: {rel_path}")

def write_file(rel_path, content):
    p = BASE / rel_path
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if p.exists(): backup_file(p)
    p.write_text(content.lstrip("\n"), encoding='utf-8')
    print(f"  OK Created/Updated: {rel_path}")

        f.write("""

from django.http import JsonResponse
from django.views.decorators.http import require_GET

@login_required
@require_GET
def hub_check_customer(request):
    mobile = request.GET.get('mobile', '').strip()
    if len(mobile) < 10:
        return JsonResponse({'exists': False})
    customer = Customer.objects.filter(mobile=mobile).first()
    if customer:
        return JsonResponse({
            'exists': True,
            'name': customer.name,
            'type': customer.get_customer_type_display(),
            'status': customer.get_status_display()
        })
    return JsonResponse({'exists': False})
""")
```
